# 05 — Kiến trúc triển khai tới field lá

Phiên bản leader-field-contracts-20261013-r2. Đầu ra lần này là đặc tả triển khai và prompt, chưa phải bản phát hành DBTool đã nghiệm thu DWG/PDF.

23 đề xuất NR-01..23 đã được DucBao chấp thuận trực tiếp ngày 13/10/2026 (OWNER-APPROVAL-23-20261013). Không yêu cầu duyệt lại các đề xuất này. ApprovedProposal xác nhận lựa chọn đã mô tả; không tạo ra giá trị nguồn chưa có trong đề xuất. Binding sản phẩm/shape/đơn vị/tolerance thiếu dữ liệu trả `RULE_BINDING_DATA_MISSING` có field/source/debug; không hỏi giữa chừng và không tự bịa.

Pipeline có một chuỗi S0–S11. DTO envelope tích lũy giữ roots đã tính immutable; OUT của stage N bằng IN của N+1. Đây là thay đổi hợp đồng phần mềm được ghi trong NR-IO-001. Drawing chỉ nhận Domain/Drawing payload, Application adapter sở hữu envelope; không tạo dependency Drawing→Application. S8 dùng registry nhóm, không đo glyph để tính chiều dài; thứ tự thực thi chuẩn vẫn đặt S8 sau S7 để kiểm tính liên tục I/O.

## 1. Module, luồng và gate

| Stage | Nhiệm vụ | Owner | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| S0 | Template/approval preflight | Application.TemplateContractValidator + AutoCAD.TemplateManifestReader/TemplateAssetImporter | assets/rules immutable exact signatures; approval header/source version consistent |
| S1 | Excel snapshot | Infrastructure.Excel.WorkbookImporter/Vhg32Schema | raw OOXML types/formulas/cache/source retained; no original workbook save |
| S2 | Effective inputs/datums | Application.ManholeValidator + AccessoryInputMapper | all active fields parsed; explicit selected aperture and contact graph; no fixture fallback |
| S3 | Concrete assemblies/openings | Application.GeometryStageAdapter + Domain.Geometry | owned voids,optional Pad,joints,catch and frame100; real loops/depths |
| S4 | Physical steel/canonical | Application.FullRebarStage + Domain.Rebar planners | every requested feature Ready or explicit failure; full-path support; pair holes; length conservation |
| S5 | Presentation groups | Drawing.PresentationGroupPlanner + Application stage adapter | one primary accounting group per member;exact compatibility;rawsum/mean and scoped marks |
| S6 | Projection/targets | Drawing.ViewBuilder/PlanProjector/SectionProjector/CatchAssemblyProjector/AssemblyBoundaryEmitter | exact source IDs/frames,real member targets,shared material regions |
| S7 | Annotation/ink | Drawing.AnnotationLaneAllocator + DIM/collector/material planners | all labels target real members;finite fit;true native ink,not char-count estimates |
| S8 | Native TK/bending | Drawing.NativeSteelSchedulePlanner/SchematicPresentationPlanner | exact INSERT/ATTRIB tags;raw quantity aggregation;fixed schematic glyph |
| S9 | Sheet pagination | Drawing.SheetLayoutPlanner | every required view placed once;all ink contained;scale change rebuilds pure stages |
| S10 | DWG write/readback | AutoCAD.CadGenerationWriter/NativeReadbackVerifier | owned transaction commit state accurate;save/reopen actual native checks;UpdateB preservesA |
| S11 | Plot/acceptance/batch | Application.AcceptanceEvidenceAssembler/BatchGenerationOrchestrator | every selected row has verdict;actual native/vectorPDF/review;no missing row and no fabricated Passed |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
 S0 --> G0[Gate S0] --> S1
 S1 --> G1[Gate S1] --> S2
 S2 --> G2[Gate S2] --> S3
 S3 --> G3[Gate S3] --> S4
 S4 --> G4[Gate S4] --> S5
 S5 --> G5[Gate S5] --> S6
 S6 --> G6[Gate S6] --> S7
 S7 --> G7[Gate S7] --> S8
 S8 --> G8[Gate S8] --> S9
 S9 --> G9[Gate S9] --> S10
 S10 --> G10[Gate S10] --> S11
 S11 --> Delivery
```

## 2. Ngữ pháp, context và lỗi

```text
Notation is executable specification: each StageAdapter.Execute creates local helper closures, never static global state.
Input alias bindings: current=input;context=input.context;request=input.request;current_job=UNIQUE(request.jobs,id=context.job_id);
rules=input.rules and entries=rules.entries where S>=1;assets=input.assets where S>=1;
e=effective=input.effective where S>=3;g=input.geometry where S>=4;p=input.projection where S>=7.
M=context.manhole_id;tol=geometry_tol=geometry_tolerance=rules.geometry_tolerance_mm;
length_tolerance=rules.length_tolerance_mm;angle_tol=rules.angle_tolerance_rad;approved_area_tolerance=rules.area_tolerance_mm2.
Each tolerance alias calls REQUIRE_TOLERANCE only when the operation needs it; no null tolerance becomes0.
S3 declares plan/nx0/nx1/ny0/ny1 before H03 calls. Helpers used within a row receive the same e/geometry/rules snapshot.
dimensions in H13 is the already computed dims argument of S7; current_view is that S7/S6 iteration view.
S0 binds e/g/p absent, not null defaults; it passes decoded rules/assets to helpers after loading them.
Records in outputs use EXACT declared fields. Pseudocode local dictionary types have only the named members in their constructor.
NEW/copy notation copies every schema field by exact name and preserves unknown-null semantics; generated constructors below are authoritative.
Each helper condition written REQUIRE/ASSERT c ELSE RAISE expands to IF !c THEN the given RAISE ELSE NO_OP ENDIF.
SELECT UNIQUE returns one only; 0/many ALWAYS raises *_MISSING or *_AMBIGUOUS with key/actual count/source IDs.
All array/set joins use exact IDs. SORT uses ordinal UTF-8 ID ordering; path/corner/role arrays keep declared topology order.
All numeric formulas use registered F01..F49. 0/1/2/pi and axis vectors in algorithms are definitions/topology (F25/F26), never fixture dimensions.
Every unknown selector, shape, unit, enum or operator must raise its named code; no closest-name or nearest-shape fallback.
Ready stage output is immutable; S4 partial preview is persisted separately and does not satisfy the S5 input type gate.
RUN_STAGE calls body with a new append-only Context copy. Business payload roots are shared immutable references.
External ports perform actual file/font/native/plot reads. The port table specifies input, output, binding and failure; no simulated Passed.
Approval header NR01..23 is already signed via OWNER-APPROVAL-23-20261013. Missing payload values raise RULE_BINDING_DATA_MISSING.

NO_OP means do nothing and execute the next statement after ENDIF. CONTINUE means skip to next iteration of the explicitly enclosing loop. They are never interchangeable.

HASH_STATE excludes the entire context.receipts array, so appending own receipt cannot invalidate output_hash. Hash a root payload excluding its own self-hash slot only;dependent/source hashes remain included.

Bare vocabulary labels in branch tables (Line,Arc,profile IDs,unit IDs and kind labels) mean their exact string literals;they are not undeclared variables. NO_OP has no side effect;CONTINUE is only a loop jump.
```

| Port | IN | OUT | Adapter / cách thực hiện | Lỗi |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IWorkbookBytesReader | JobV2.workbook_bytes/hash/receipt | OOXML cells including formula and cached type; receipt certificate | WorkbookImporter existing decoder;read-only byte stream | WORKBOOK_SNAPSHOT_HASH_MISMATCH/FORMULA_CACHE_UNVERIFIED |
| ITemplateMetricsReader | Request template manifest path/hash | AssetsV2 exact field schema | TemplateManifestReader,NativeAssetSignatures;glyph-only extents and actual font metric provider | TEMPLATE_NATIVE_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH/FONT_GLYPH_METRIC_MISSING |
| IRuleSnapshotReader | Request rule path/hash + owner approval record | RulesV2 exact typed scope/header/parameter/expression/recipe fields | RuleApprovalRegistry;never generate geometry from proposal prose | RULE_BINDING_DATA_MISSING/RULE_SCOPE_MISMATCH |
| INativeGenerationPort | S9StateV2 + intent list + exact generation expectations | NativeV2 or FailureV2 with commit-state recovery artifact | CadGenerationWriter/CadWriteSession/GenerationRepository;one document lock/transaction | NATIVE_FAILURE_AFTER_COMMIT/NATIVE_WRITE_ROLLED_BACK |
| IPlotEvidencePort | savedDWG,SheetFrameV2,approved plot profile,shared session ID | actual PlotPageV2 fields and measured PDF mapping | Headless/AutoCAD host adapter;PSTYLEMODE matched CTB/STB;full transcript | PLOT_SESSION_MISSING/PLOT_PROFILE_INCOMPATIBLE/HOST_UNHEALTHY |
| IVisualReviewReader | actualPDF hash,ReferenceBundle ID,frame ID | reviewer,reviewed_regions,per-region verdict + paths | Read actual saved review receipt;absent→NotRun,not auto Passed | VISUAL_REVIEW_NOT_RUN/REFERENCE_BUNDLE_MISMATCH |
| IArtifactStore | context.artifact_directory,actual bytes/records | path/hash of real artifact | Create output only in named run folder;temp file+atomic rename for JSON;DWG commit semantics remain separate | ARTIFACT_WRITE_FAILED/OUTPUT_PATH_SOURCE_CONFLICT |

## Typed rule binding: giá trị có sẵn và dữ liệu bắt buộc

Các header NR01..23 dưới đây đã Approved. Seed chỉ điền những giá trị xuất hiện trong đề xuất/nguồn đã duyệt; các tolerance, radius basis, contact/stack/shape expressions, product measurements và font/plot hashes chưa có giá trị nguồn giữ null/absent. Junior implement đầy đủ nhánh validate;không hỏi để điền và không coi seed là một case Final sẵn chạy. | ScheduleHeadingV2.attributes[].value_kind | string | — | TENLUOI or TIEUDE literal from source owner label; fixed header empty array. / Text/Length/Metres/Mass/Count/Diameter/Pitch/SizePair/UnitMass. |
| ScheduleHeadingV2.attributes[].raw_number | double? | unit field | TENLUOI or TIEUDE literal from source owner label; fixed header empty array. / Unrounded numeric value when scalar; text/pair=null. |
| ScheduleHeadingV2.attributes[].unit | string | — | TENLUOI or TIEUDE literal from source owner label; fixed header empty array. / mm/m/kg/count/kg_per_m/none, explicit per binding. |
| ScheduleHeadingV2.attributes[].source_ids[] | string[] | — | TENLUOI or TIEUDE literal from source owner label; fixed header empty array. / Group/input/rule values that produced text. |
| ScheduleHeadingV2.insertion.x_mm | double | mm | Source-backed heading offset relative first row or bending origin, 05B-F15/F41. / Tọa độ ngang trong frame đã ghi, 05B-F26/F38. |
| ScheduleHeadingV2.insertion.y_mm | double | mm | Source-backed heading offset relative first row or bending origin, 05B-F15/F41. / Tọa độ dọc trong frame đã ghi, 05B-F26/F38. |
| ScheduleHeadingV2.asset_scale | double | dimensionless | S/100 native annotation baseline, 05B-F14. |
| ScheduleHeadingV2.ink.min_x_mm | double | mm | Actual native fixed stroke+ATTRIB ink, 05B-F40/F42. / min của ink/curve X sau transform; 05B-F42. |
| ScheduleHeadingV2.ink.min_y_mm | double | mm | Actual native fixed stroke+ATTRIB ink, 05B-F40/F42. / min của ink/curve Y sau transform; 05B-F42. |
| ScheduleHeadingV2.ink.max_x_mm | double | mm | Actual native fixed stroke+ATTRIB ink, 05B-F40/F42. / max của ink/curve X sau transform; 05B-F42. |

### FailureV2 — DBTool.Application

| Field lá | Kiểu | Đơn vị | Định nghĩa chính xác |
|---|---|---|---|
| FailureV2.diagnostic.code | string | — | Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Mã RAISE được ghi trực tiếp trong pseudocode. |
| FailureV2.diagnostic.stage | string | — | Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / S0..S11 hoặc PRECHECK. |
| FailureV2.diagnostic.manhole_id | string? | — | Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Pass-through context.manhole_id nếu đã có. |
| FailureV2.diagnostic.subject_id | string? | — | Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Component/occurrence/group/view/field bị lỗi; null chỉ lỗi trước xác định subject. |
| FailureV2.diagnostic.field_paths[] | string[] | — | Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Paths cụ thể đã kiểm, không một thông báo chung. |
| FailureV2.diagnostic.expected_text | string | — | Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Literal invariant/expected field value từ phép kiểm. |
| FailureV2.diagnostic.actual_text | string | — | Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Serialize actual values bị lỗi, culture invariant. |
| FailureV2.diagnostic.source_ids[] | string[] | — | Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / IDs của các input gây lỗi, tra context.sources[]. |
| FailureV2.diagnostic.needsrule_ids[] | string[] | — | Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / NR-01..23 hoặc NR-IO-* liên quan; không tự tạo numeric fallback. |
| FailureV2.diagnostic.severity | string | — | Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Block/Warning/Info từ call RAISE/REPORT, không đổi khi render. |
| FailureV2.receipt.stage | string | — | Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Tên stage vừa thực hiện. |
| FailureV2.receipt.run_id | string | — | Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Pass-through context.run_id. |
| FailureV2.receipt.manhole_id | string | — | Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Pass-through context.manhole_id. |
| FailureV2.receipt.status | string | — | Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Ready/Partial/Blocked/Cancelled theo diagnostic và cancellation. |
| FailureV2.receipt.input_hash | string | — | Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Hash canonical input state trước stage, 05B-F46. |
| FailureV2.receipt.output_hash | string? | — | Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Hash ready payload; lỗi trước payload = null. |
| FailureV2.receipt.started_utc | string | UTC | Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Clock UTC lúc bắt đầu; không dùng làm freshness workbook. |
| FailureV2.receipt.finished_utc | string | UTC | Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Clock UTC lúc kết thúc stage, ghi kể cả lỗi. |

## 8. Thuật toán dùng chung

Mỗi hàm dưới đây nằm trong cùng tài liệu. Không lấy câu “theo policy” để thay nội dung triển khai. Operator SELECT/JOIN/HASH/FRAME là các phép đã định nghĩa, tham số vật lý luôn đi qua typed rule binding.

### H00-RUN-AND-ERROR

```text
RUN_STAGE(stage:string, input:StageInput, body:function) -> ReadyState | Failure:
    started_utc:string := UTC_NOW()
    ASSERT_COMPLETE_INPUT(input)  # mỗi required leaf và nullable-parent có bảng ngay trong tài liệu này
    input_hash:string := HASH_STATE(input)  // 05B-F46; exclude entire context.receipts and root self-hash slot
    IF input.context.cancel_requested THEN
        RETURN FAIL("RUN_CANCELLED", stage, input.context.manhole_id, ["context.cancel_requested"],
                    "false", "true", [], [], started_utc, input_hash)
    ELSE
        TRY
            working:=input with context=COPY_APPEND_ONLY_CONTEXT(input.context)
            output:StageOutput := body(working)
            ASSERT_COMPLETE_OUTPUT(output)
            ASSERT_CARRY_EQUAL(input, output)  # business payload cũ equal; context chỉ append
            output_hash:string := HASH_STATE(output)  // 05B-F46
            APPEND output.context.receipts ReceiptV2(
                stage=stage,run_id=input.context.run_id,manhole_id=input.context.manhole_id,
                status="Ready",input_hash=input_hash,output_hash=output_hash,
                started_utc=started_utc,finished_utc=UTC_NOW())
            RETURN output
        CATCH StageFault e
            RETURN FAIL(e.code,stage,e.subject,e.fields,e.expected,e.actual,e.sources,e.nr,
                        started_utc,input_hash)
        CATCH OperationCanceledException e
            RETURN FAIL("RUN_CANCELLED",stage,input.context.manhole_id,[],"completed",e.message,
                        [],[],started_utc,input_hash)
        CATCH Exception e
            RETURN FAIL("STAGE_UNEXPECTED_EXCEPTION",stage,input.context.manhole_id,[],
                        "no exception",e.type+":"+e.message,[],[],started_utc,input_hash)
        ENDTRY
    ENDIF

RAISE(code, subject, fields, expected, actual, sources=[], nr=[]):
    THROW StageFault(code,subject,fields,INVARIANT_TEXT(expected),INVARIANT_TEXT(actual),sources,nr)

FAIL(code,stage,subject,fields,expected,actual,sources,nr,started,input_hash):
    diagnostic := DiagnosticV2(code,stage,context.manhole_id,subject,fields,expected,actual,sources,nr,"Block")
    receipt := ReceiptV2(stage,context.run_id,context.manhole_id,"Cancelled" IF code=="RUN_CANCELLED"
                         ELSE "Blocked",input_hash,null,started,UTC_NOW())
    PERSIST failure diagnostic and receipt to run/<run_id>/<manhole_id>/<stage>.json
    RETURN FailureV2(diagnostic,receipt)  # Failure tuyệt đối không có ready payload

ASSERT_CARRY_EQUAL(before,after):
    FOR root in before.business_payload_roots:
        IF CANONICAL_BYTES(before[root]) != CANONICAL_BYTES(after[root]) THEN
            RAISE("STAGE_CARRY_MUTATED",root,[root],HASH(before[root]),HASH(after[root]),[],["NR-IO-001"])
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    FOR list_name in ["sources","diagnostics","receipts"]:
        IF after.context[list_name].prefix(before.context[list_name].Count) != before.context[list_name] THEN
            RAISE("CONTEXT_NOT_APPEND_ONLY",list_name,["context."+list_name],"preserved prefix","changed",[],[])
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR


ASSERT_COMPLETE_INPUT/OUTPUT(value):
    WALK(value,record_type,"state")
WALK(value,record_type,path):
    fields:=TYPE_REGISTRY[record_type].fields
    FOR property IN SERIALIZED_PROPERTIES(value):
        IF property.name NOT IN fields.names THEN RAISE("IO_FIELD_UNKNOWN",path,[path+"."+property.name],fields.names,property.name)
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    FOR field IN fields:
        p:=path+"."+field.name // 05B-F46
        IF property absent THEN RAISE("IO_FIELD_MISSING",p,[p],field.type,"absent") ELSE
            item:=value[field.name]
            IF item IS null THEN
                IF field.type nullable THEN CONTINUE ELSE RAISE("IO_REQUIRED_NULL",p,[p],field.type,"null") ENDIF
            ELSE IF field.type array THEN
                CHECK_RESOURCE_COUNT(item.Count,request.max_numeric_count,p)
                FOR index IN 0..item.Count-1: VALIDATE_ELEMENT(item[index],element_type,p+"["+index+"]") ENDFOR // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            ELSE VALIDATE_ELEMENT(item,field.type,p) ENDIF ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
VALIDATE_ELEMENT(item,type,path):
    IF type is declared record THEN WALK(item,type,path) ELSE
        IF runtime primitive type differs THEN RAISE("IO_PRIMITIVE_TYPE",path,[path],type,TYPE(item)) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        IF type==double AND !IS_FINITE(item) THEN RAISE("IO_NONFINITE",path,[path],"finite",item) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDIF
    # Array counts are resource limits; no minimum engineering count is invented.
```

### H01-IDENTITY-RULE-EXPRESSION

```text
ENCODE(parts:string[]) -> string:
    RETURN CONCAT(FOR p in parts: UTF8_BYTE_LENGTH(p)+":"+p)  // 05B-F46; no ambiguous name concatenation

RULE(entries:RuleV2[],id,profile,component,shape) -> RuleV2:
    matches := entries WHERE r.id==id AND SCOPE_CONTAINS(r.profiles,profile) AND SCOPE_CONTAINS(r.components,component)
                            AND SCOPE_CONTAINS(r.shape_kinds,shape)
    IF matches.Count != 1 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        RAISE("RULE_SCOPE_MISMATCH",id,["rules.entries"],"one scoped rule",matches.Count,[],[id])
    ELSE
        r := matches[0] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        IF r.status!="Approved" OR r.approver IS null OR r.approved_at_utc IS null THEN
            RAISE("RULE_UNAPPROVED",id,["rules.entries.status"],"Approved with signer/time",r.status,r.source_ids,[id])
        ELSE RETURN r ENDIF
    ENDIF

PARAM(rule,key,kind,unit):
    values := rule.parameters WHERE p.key==key
    IF values.Count!=1 THEN RAISE("RULE_BINDING_DATA_MISSING",rule.id,[key],"one",values.Count,rule.source_ids,[rule.id]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE
        p := values[0] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        IF p.kind!=kind OR p.unit!=unit OR p.source_ids.Count==0 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            RAISE("RULE_PARAMETER_TYPE",rule.id,[key],kind+"/"+unit,p.kind+"/"+p.unit,p.source_ids,[rule.id])
        ELSE RETURN p.number IF kind=="Number" ELSE p.text IF kind=="Text" ELSE p.flag ENDIF
    ENDIF

EVAL(rule,node_id,environment,visiting:set<string>) -> (double value,string unit):
    IF node_id IN visiting THEN RAISE("RULE_EXPRESSION_CYCLE",rule.id,[node_id],"acyclic",visiting,rule.source_ids,[rule.id])
    ELSE visiting.ADD(node_id) ENDIF
    n := UNIQUE(rule.expressions,id=node_id) ELSE RAISE("RULE_EXPRESSION_NODE_MISSING",rule.id,[node_id],"present","missing",rule.source_ids,[rule.id])
    args := [EVAL(rule,a,environment,visiting) FOR a IN n.arg_ids]
    SWITCH n.op:
      CONST: require arity0 and finite n.constant and nonempty n.source_ids; value:=n.constant; unit:=n.unit
      REF: require arity0 and environment has exact n.ref_path; (value,unit):=environment[n.ref_path]
      ADD/SUB: require arity2 and same args units; value:=a0+a1 or a0-a1; unit:=a0.unit // 05B-F45
      MUL: require arity2; value:=a0*a1; unit:=UNIT_PRODUCT(a0.unit,a1.unit) // 05B-F45
      DIV: require arity2 and a1.value!=0; value:=a0/a1; unit:=UNIT_QUOTIENT(a0.unit,a1.unit) // 05B-F45
      MIN/MAX: require >=1 args all same unit; value:=min/max args; unit:=args[0].unit // 05B-F45
      SQRT: require arity1 and a0>=0 and square unit; value:=sqrt(a0); unit:=UNIT_SQRT(a0.unit) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      SIN/COS/TAN: require arity1 unit rad; value:=sin/cos/tan(a0); unit:="dimensionless" // 05B-F45
      ATAN2: require arity2 same unit; value:=atan2(a0,a1); unit:="rad"
      CEIL/FLOOR: require arity1 unit dimensionless; value:=ceil/floor(a0); unit:="dimensionless" // 05B-F45
      ROUND: require arity2; a1 unit dimensionless and exact integer precision;
             require n.rounding_mode in {ToEven,AwayFromZero}; value:=ROUND_DECIMAL(a0,a1,n.rounding_mode);unit:=a0.unit

      MOD: require arity2, both dimensionless exact integers, a1>0; value:=a0-floor(a0/a1)*a1;unit:="dimensionless" // 05B-F45
      EQ/NE/LT/LE/GT/GE: require arity2 same unit; value:=1 IF comparison true ELSE 0;unit:="dimensionless" // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      AND/OR: require arity2 each dimensionless value0/1;value:=1 IF Boolean operator true ELSE 0;unit:="dimensionless" // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      NOT: require arity1 dimensionless value0/1;value:=1-a0;unit:="dimensionless" // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      DEFAULT: RAISE("RULE_OPERATOR_UNSUPPORTED",rule.id,[node_id],"declared operator",n.op,n.source_ids,[rule.id])
    ENDSWITCH
    # require ở SWITCH là cùng operation dưới đây, không câu hỏi để junior tự chọn:
    # REQUIRE(c): IF !c THEN RAISE("RULE_EXPRESSION_INVALID",rule.id,[node_id],expected,actual,n.source_ids,[rule.id]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF unit!=n.unit OR !IS_FINITE(value) THEN
        RAISE("RULE_EXPRESSION_RESULT_INVALID",rule.id,[node_id],n.unit+" finite",unit+":"+value,n.source_ids,[rule.id])
    ELSE visiting.REMOVE(node_id); RETURN(value,unit) ENDIF
    // Tất cả phép số học trong EVAL dùng 05B-F45; CONST không có nguồn bị từ chối.
```

### H02-FRAMES-CURVES-PRISMS

```text
POINT(x_mm:double,y_mm:double,z_mm:double) -> Point3V2:
    IF any value nonfinite THEN RAISE("POINT_NONFINITE",null,["x_mm","y_mm","z_mm"],"finite",[x_mm,y_mm,z_mm])
    ELSE RETURN Point3V2(x_mm,y_mm,z_mm) ENDIF

FRAME(id,origin,u,v,n) -> FrameV2:
    basis_tol:=REQUIRE_TOLERANCE(rules,"basis_tolerance","NR-18")
    IF abs(norm(u)-1)>basis_tol OR abs(norm(v)-1)>basis_tol OR abs(norm(n)-1)>basis_tol OR // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
       abs(dot(u,v))>basis_tol OR abs(dot(u,n))>basis_tol OR abs(dot(v,n))>basis_tol THEN
        RAISE("FRAME_NOT_ORTHONORMAL",id,["axis_u","axis_v","normal"],"unit perpendicular basis",[u,v,n],[],["NR-18"])
    ELSE RETURN FrameV2(id,origin,u,v,n,sign(dot(cross(u,v),n))) ENDIF  // 05B-F26

WORLD(f,u_mm,v_mm,w_mm):
    RETURN POINT(f.origin.x_mm+u_mm*f.axis_u.x+v_mm*f.axis_v.x+w_mm*f.normal.x,
                 f.origin.y_mm+u_mm*f.axis_u.y+v_mm*f.axis_v.y+w_mm*f.normal.y,
                 f.origin.z_mm+u_mm*f.axis_u.z+v_mm*f.axis_v.z+w_mm*f.normal.z)  // 05B-F26

WALL_FRAME(wall,L,B,z0,center_x=0,center_y=0): // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    SWITCH wall:  // 05B-F26: FRAME-001 basis; definitions ±1/0, not fixture dimensions
      T1: o:=(center_x,center_y+B/2,z0); left:=(-1,0,0);out:=(0,1,0) // 05B-F26
      T2: o:=(center_x+L/2,center_y,z0); left:=(0,1,0);out:=(1,0,0) // 05B-F26
      T3: o:=(center_x,center_y-B/2,z0); left:=(1,0,0);out:=(0,-1,0) // 05B-F26
      T4: o:=(center_x-L/2,center_y,z0); left:=(0,-1,0);out:=(-1,0,0) // 05B-F26
      DEFAULT: RAISE("WALL_ID_INVALID",wall,["wall"],"T1/T2/T3/T4",wall)
    ENDSWITCH
    RETURN FRAME(wall,o,left,out,(0,0,1)) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default

LINE(id,a:Point3V2,b:Point3V2,role) -> CurveV2:
    IF distance(a,b)<=tol THEN RAISE("CURVE_ZERO_LENGTH",id,["start","end"],">tol",[a,b],[],["NR-18"])
    ELSE RETURN CurveV2(id,"Line",a,b,null,null,null,null,role) ENDIF  // 05B-F31/F35

ARC(id,a,b,center,normal,radius,sweep,role):
    IF radius<=0 OR !finite(sweep) OR abs(sweep)<=angle_tol THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        RAISE("ARC_INVALID",id,["radius_mm","sweep_rad"],"radius>0,nonzero sweep",[radius,sweep]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE RETURN CurveV2(id,"Arc",a,b,center,normal,radius,sweep,role) ENDIF  // 05B-F35

RECT_LOOP(id,x0,y0,x1,y1,z,role):
    IF x1<=x0 OR y1<=y0 THEN RAISE("RECT_BOUNDS_INVALID",id,["x0","y0","x1","y1"],"positive span",[x0,y0,x1,y1])
    ELSE
        pts := [POINT(x0,y0,z),POINT(x1,y0,z),POINT(x1,y1,z),POINT(x0,y1,z)]
        IF role=="Inner" THEN REVERSE pts ELSE KEEP pts ENDIF
        curves := [LINE(ENCODE(id,i),pts[i],pts[(i+1) MOD 4],"Outline") FOR i=0..3] // 05B-F26
        RETURN LoopV2(id,role,curves,true,SIGNED_AREA(curves))  // 05B-F27/F37;4 is rectangle topology
    ENDIF

ADD_PRISM(g:GeometryV2,key,kind,assembly,material,frame,loops,depth0,depth1,sources):
    IF depth1<=depth0 THEN RAISE("SOLID_DEPTH_INVALID",key,["depth0","depth1"],"depth1>depth0",[depth0,depth1],sources)
    ELSE
        id := ENCODE(M,key); part := SolidPartV2(ENCODE(id,"Blank"),"Union",frame,loops,depth0,depth1)
        vertices := endpoints and arc extrema of loops at both depths via WORLD  // 05B-F26/F27/F42
        z0 := min(vertices.z_mm);z1 := max(vertices.z_mm) // 05B-F26
        patches := EXTRUSION_PATCHES(id,part,sources)  # helper defined immediately below

        material_role:=MATERIAL_ROLE_FOR_COMPONENT(kind,key)
        material_field:=EXACT_MATERIAL_FIELD(material_role,e,rules) # role mapping in NR17, no grade guessed
        grade:=FIELD_TEXT(e,material_field);material_id:=ENCODE(material,grade)
        thickness:=e.wall_mm IF kind=="Wall" ELSE e.neck_wall_mm IF kind=="Neck" ELSE
                   e.catch.base_mm IF key=="Catch/Base" ELSE e.catch.wall_mm IF kind=="Catch" ELSE
                   EVAL(NR05,"support_thickness_expr",ENV(e,key),{}).value IF kind=="Haunch" ELSE depth1-depth0
        component := ComponentV2(id,kind,assembly,material_id,frame,loops,z0,z1,thickness,
                                  patches,[],sources,[part],key,material_role)

        APPEND g.components component
        RETURN component
    ENDIF

EXTRUSION_PATCHES(owner,part,sources):
    out := []
    FOR end IN [part.depth_min_mm,part.depth_max_mm]:
        normal := -part.frame.normal IF end==part.depth_min_mm ELSE part.frame.normal
        loops_local := part.loops # patch.frame origin at cap depth; loops remain local XY
        role := "Bottom" IF end==part.depth_min_mm ELSE "Top"
        APPEND out PatchV2(ENCODE(owner,role),owner,role,frame_at_depth(part.frame,end,normal),
                           loops_local,NET_AREA(loops_local),null,sources)
    ENDFOR
    FOR loop IN part.loops:
        FOR curve IN loop.curves:
            IF curve.kind=="Line" THEN
                a0:=WORLD(part.frame,curve.start.x_mm,curve.start.y_mm,part.depth_min_mm)
                b0:=WORLD(part.frame,curve.end.x_mm,curve.end.y_mm,part.depth_min_mm)
                a1:=WORLD(part.frame,curve.start.x_mm,curve.start.y_mm,part.depth_max_mm)
                tangent:=normalize(b0-a0); up:=part.frame.normal; normal:=part.frame.handedness*normalize(cross(tangent,up)) // 05B-F26
                # Inner loop ordering already reverses normal; no color-based test.
                side_loop := RECT_LOOP(ENCODE(owner,loop.id,curve.id,"Side"),0,0, // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                                       length(curve),part.depth_max_mm-part.depth_min_mm,0,"Outer") // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                APPEND out PatchV2(ENCODE(owner,loop.id,curve.id),owner,
                                  "Inner" IF loop.role=="Inner" ELSE "Outer",
                                  FRAME(ENCODE(owner,curve.id,"Frame"),a0,tangent,up,normal),[side_loop],length(curve)*(part.depth_max_mm-part.depth_min_mm),
                                  null,sources)
            ELSE
                # Curved extrusion side remains analytic CSG; planar Patch list must not fake a rectangle.
                KEEP part.loops[].curves[] Arc unchanged for analytic side projection at S6; no planar Patch emitted.
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    RETURN out  // area/line lengths 05B-F27/F35/F37
```

### H03-SEAT-FRAME-PANEL-HAUNCH

```text
DATUM(e,id) -> double:
    values:=e.datums WHERE surface_id==id
    IF values.Count!=1 THEN RAISE("ASSEMBLY_DATUM_UNRESOLVED",e.id,["datums."+id],"one resolved surface",values.Count,e.source_ids,["NR-IO-003"]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE RETURN values[0].z_mm ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default

FIELD(e,key) -> ParsedFieldV2:
    matches:=e.parsed_fields WHERE field_key==key AND row_index IS null
    IF matches.Count!=1 THEN RAISE("EFFECTIVE_FIELD_MISSING",e.id,[key],"one config scalar",matches.Count,e.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE RETURN matches[0] ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default

SOURCES(e,keys): RETURN DISTINCT(FOR k IN keys: FIELD_OR_MAIN(e,k).source_ids)
FIELD_BOOL(e,key): REQUIRE FIELD(e,key).kind=="Bool"; RETURN FIELD(e,key).flag
FIELD_BOOL_IF_PRESENT(e,key): RETURN null IF no such config key ELSE FIELD_BOOL(e,key)
FIELD_NUM(e,key): REQUIRE kind Number/Integer and active; RETURN number or integer without coercion
FIELD_TEXT(e,key): REQUIRE kind Text and active; RETURN text
FIELD_TUPLE(e,key,n): REQUIRE kind Tuple and active and tuple_mm.Count==n; RETURN tuple_mm
# REQUIRE failure here always RAISE("EFFECTIVE_FIELD_TYPE",e.id,[key],expected,actual,field.source_ids).
# FIELD_OR_MAIN uses row_index==context.row_index for main keys, null for config; never first matching catalog row.

ADD_SEAT_CUT_IF_ACTIVE(neck,e):
    IF FIELD_BOOL(e,"NeckHaunchFlag")==false THEN RETURN neck ELSE
        [expansion,height]:=FIELD_TUPLE(e,"NeckHaunchSize",2) // source AxB two roles,05B-F27
        IF expansion<=0 OR height<=0 OR expansion>=e.neck_wall_mm OR height>e.neck_height_mm THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            RAISE("NECK_SEAT_INVALID",neck.id,["NeckHaunchSize"],"positive; fits neck",[expansion,height],SOURCES(e,["NeckHaunchSize"]))
        ELSE
            seat_kind:=PARAM(RULE(entries,"NR-19",e.profile,"Neck","Seat"),"seat_kind","Text","none")
            IF seat_kind=="Step" THEN
                cut_loop := rectangle centered e.neck_center, width=e.neck_clear_x_mm+2*expansion, // 05B-F27
                            height=e.neck_clear_y_mm+2*expansion  // RECT_LOOP /05B-F27
                APPEND neck.solid_parts SolidPartV2(ENCODE(neck.id,"SeatCut"),"Subtract",plan,[cut_loop],
                                 DATUM(e,"NeckTop")-height,DATUM(e,"NeckTop"))
            ELSE IF seat_kind=="Slope" THEN
                # Four triangular subtractive prisms, local width expands linearly upwards.
                FOR wall IN [T1,T2,T3,T4]:
                    f:=WALL_FRAME(wall,e.neck_clear_x_mm,e.neck_clear_y_mm,DATUM(e,"NeckTop")-height,
                                  e.neck_center.x_mm,e.neck_center.y_mm)
                    cross_plane:=FRAME(ENCODE(neck.id,wall,"SeatSlope"),f.origin,f.axis_v,f.normal,f.axis_u)
                    triangle:=CLOSED_LINES([(0,0),(expansion,height),(0,height)],"Inner") // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    length:=e.neck_clear_x_mm IF wall IN[T1,T3] ELSE e.neck_clear_y_mm
                    APPEND neck.solid_parts SolidPartV2(ENCODE(neck.id,wall,"SeatCut"),"Subtract",cross_plane,[triangle],
                                                       -length/2-expansion,length/2+expansion) //05B-F27
                ENDFOR
            ELSE RAISE("NECK_SEAT_KIND_UNAPPROVED",neck.id,["seat_kind"],"Step/Slope",seat_kind,[],["NR-19"]) ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

ADD_FRAME_AND_SELECTED_COVER(g,e,assets):
    IF e.cover_kind=="None" THEN
        RETURN g # selected no-cover aperture/contact already validated in S2; no fictitious product
    ELSE
        fx0:=e.neck_center.x_mm-e.frame_outer_x_mm/2;fx1:=e.neck_center.x_mm+e.frame_outer_x_mm/2 // 05B-F27
        fy0:=e.neck_center.y_mm-e.frame_outer_y_mm/2;fy1:=e.neck_center.y_mm+e.frame_outer_y_mm/2 //05B-F02/F27
        frame_loops:=[RECT_LOOP("OwnerFrame/Outer",fx0,fy0,fx1,fy1,0,"Outer"), // 05B-F27
                      RECT_LOOP("OwnerFrame/Inner",nx0,ny0,nx1,ny1,0,"Inner")] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ADD_PRISM(g,"OwnerFrame","Frame",ENCODE(e.id,"Frame"),"Concrete",plan,frame_loops,
                  DATUM(e,"FrameBottom"),DATUM(e,"FrameTop"),e.source_ids)
        IF abs(DATUM(e,"FrameTop")-DATUM(e,"FrameBottom")-e.frame_height_mm)>tol OR
           abs(DATUM(e,"FrameBottom")-DATUM(e,"NeckTop"))>tol THEN
            RAISE("FRAME_DATUM_MISMATCH",e.id,["FrameBottom","NeckTop","FrameTop"],
                  "FrameBottom=NeckTop; height=owner100",e.datums,e.source_ids,["NR-IO-003"])
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF //05B-F02/F28; CONTRACT C01: cổ kết thúc dưới khung
        IF e.cover_kind=="Purchased" THEN
            p:=UNIQUE(assets.products,code=e.cover_code) ELSE RAISE("COVER_CATALOG_MISSING",e.id,["cover_code"],"exact product",e.cover_code,e.source_ids)
            offset_xy:=ROTATE_2D(p.registration_offset,e.product_rotation_rad) //05B-F26
            anchor:=POINT(e.neck_center.x_mm+offset_xy.x_mm,e.neck_center.y_mm+offset_xy.y_mm, // 05B-F27
                          DATUM(e,p.placement_surface_id)+p.registration_offset.z_mm) //05B-F26/F28
            APPEND g.products ProductPlacementV2(ENCODE(e.id,p.id,"PurchasedCover"),p.id,anchor,
                            e.product_rotation_rad,1,p.plan_asset,p.section_aa_asset,p.section_bb_asset,p.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ELSE
            ASSERT e.cover_kind=="Panel" ELSE RAISE("COVER_KIND_INVALID",e.id,["cover_kind"],"Purchased/Panel",e.cover_kind)
            # Panel solids are generated below, no fake purchased product.
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

ADD_PANEL_INSTANCES(g,e):
    IF e.panel IS null THEN RETURN g ELSE
        n:int:=e.panel.count; gap:double:=e.panel.gap_mm
        IF n<1 OR gap<0 THEN RAISE("PANEL_INPUT_INVALID",e.id,["panel.count","panel.gap_mm"],"n>=1,gap>=0",[n,gap],e.panel.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ELSE
            support_x:=e.neck_clear_x_mm+2*(e.panel.seat_expansion_mm IF e.panel.support_mode=="Recess" ELSE e.neck_wall_mm) // 05B-F27
            support_y:=e.neck_clear_y_mm+2*(e.panel.seat_expansion_mm IF e.panel.support_mode=="Recess" ELSE e.neck_wall_mm) //05B-F12/F27
            axis:=e.panel.split_axis
            IF n==1 AND axis IS null THEN axis:="X"  # one rectangle; axis is inactive representation only, source EX-047 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            ELSE IF axis NOT IN["X","Y"] THEN RAISE("PANEL_DIRECTION_INVALID",e.id,["panel.split_axis"],"X/Y when n>1",axis,e.panel.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            ELSE NO_OP ENDIF ENDIF
            span:=support_x IF axis=="X" ELSE support_y
            
            IF e.panel.support_mode=="Recess" THEN gap_count:=n+1;edge_gap:=gap;cross_gap:=gap // 05B-F27
            ELSE IF e.panel.support_mode=="OverOuter" THEN gap_count:=n-1;edge_gap:=0;cross_gap:=0 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            ELSE RAISE("PANEL_SUPPORT_BINDING_MISSING",e.id,["panel.support_mode"],"Recess/OverOuter",e.panel.support_mode,e.panel.source_ids,["NR-23"]) ENDIF ENDIF
            piece:=(span-gap_count*gap)/n //05B-F12

            IF piece<=0 THEN RAISE("PANEL_NO_CLEAR_SPAN",e.id,["panel.count","panel.gap_mm"],">0 panel size",piece,e.panel.source_ids,["NR-23"]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            ELSE
                FOR index:int IN 0..n-1: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    split0:=-span/2+edge_gap+index*(piece+gap);split1:=split0+piece //05B-F12
                    IF axis=="X" THEN
                        x0:=e.neck_center.x_mm+split0;x1:=e.neck_center.x_mm+split1 // 05B-F27
                        y0:=e.neck_center.y_mm-support_y/2+cross_gap;y1:=e.neck_center.y_mm+support_y/2-cross_gap // 05B-F27
                    ELSE
                        y0:=e.neck_center.y_mm+split0;y1:=e.neck_center.y_mm+split1 // 05B-F27
                        x0:=e.neck_center.x_mm-support_x/2+cross_gap;x1:=e.neck_center.x_mm+support_x/2-cross_gap // 05B-F27
                    ENDIF //05B-F12/F27
                    ADD_PRISM(g,"Panel/"+index,"Panel",ENCODE(e.id,"Panel",index),"Concrete",plan,
                         [RECT_LOOP("Panel/"+index+"/Outer",x0,y0,x1,y1,0,"Outer")], // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                         DATUM(e,"PanelBottom"),DATUM(e,"PanelBottom")+e.panel.thickness_mm,e.panel.source_ids)
                    CHECK_PANEL_BEARING(x0,y0,x1,y1,e.panel.contract_id) # exact contact surfaces from approved NR23, not minimum guessed
                ENDFOR
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

ADD_HAUNCHES(g,e):
    FOR (owner,raw_value,z_surface) IN [("Base",e.base_haunch_mm,"BaseTop"),("Roof",e.top_haunch_mm,"RoofBottom")]:
        IF raw_value==0 THEN CONTINUE ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            rule:=RULE(entries,"NR-05",e.profile,owner,"HaunchGeometry")
            width:=EVAL(rule,PARAM(rule,"width_expr","Text","none"),{"input_mm":raw_value},{}).value
            height:=EVAL(rule,PARAM(rule,"height_expr","Text","none"),{"input_mm":raw_value},{}).value //05B-F27/F45
            # Legacy assumes width=height; source note is scalar. Never reproduce that assumption without explicit rule.
            IF width<=0 OR height<=0 OR width>min(e.clear_x_mm,e.clear_y_mm)/2 OR height>e.clear_h_mm THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                RAISE("HAUNCH_GEOMETRY_INVALID",e.id,[owner+"Haunch"],"fits clear support",[width,height],e.source_ids,["NR-05","NR-IO-007"])
            ELSE
                FOR wall IN[T1,T2,T3,T4]:
                    wf:=WALL_FRAME(wall,e.clear_x_mm,e.clear_y_mm,DATUM(e,z_surface))
                    tri:=CLOSED_LINES([(-width,0),(0,0),(0,height IF owner=="Base" ELSE -height)],"Outer") // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    plane:=FRAME(ENCODE(e.id,owner,wall,"HaunchPlane"),wf.origin,wf.axis_v,wf.normal,wf.axis_u)
                    span:=e.clear_x_mm IF wall IN[T1,T3] ELSE e.clear_y_mm
                    assembly:=ENCODE(e.id,"Monolithic") IF e.profile=="GaThamLienKhoi" ELSE ENCODE(e.id,"Body" IF owner=="Base" ELSE "Roof")
                    ADD_PRISM(g,owner+"/Haunch/"+wall,"Haunch",assembly,"Concrete",plane,[tri],-span/2,span/2,e.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                ENDFOR
                # Same assembly wedges remain CSG Union; corner overlap removed by shared section region union H06.
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR

ADD_PURCHASED_COLLAR_IF_ACTIVE(g,e,rules):
    IF e.cover_kind!="Purchased" OR !FIELD_BOOL(e,"CoverHaunchFlag") THEN RETURN g ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    plan:FrameV2:=FRAME(ENCODE(e.id,"CollarPlan"),POINT(0,0,0),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(0,0,1)) # 05B-F25/F26;world XY identity basis
    [width,height]:=FIELD_TUPLE(e,"CoverHaunchSize",2) # EX042/043: Gang-only BxH,not panel thickness or G11neckseat // 05B-F27
    r:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-23",e.profile,"Collar","ContactProfile")
    env:=ENV(e,null,null)+{"collar_width_mm":width,"collar_height_mm":height} // 05B-F27
    ox:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"collar_outer_x_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
    oy:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"collar_outer_y_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
    ix:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"collar_inner_x_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
    iy:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"collar_inner_y_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
    z0:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"collar_z_min_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
    z1:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"collar_z_max_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
    IF width<=0 OR height<=0 OR ox<=ix OR oy<=iy OR ix<=0 OR iy<=0 OR z1<=z0 THEN RAISE("COLLAR_CONTACT_PROFILE_INVALID",e.id,["CoverHaunchSize"],"positive source-backed ring profile",[ox,oy,ix,iy,z0,z1],r.source_ids,["NR-23"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    loops:=[RECT_LOOP("Collar/Outer",e.neck_center.x_mm-ox/2,e.neck_center.y_mm-oy/2,e.neck_center.x_mm+ox/2,e.neck_center.y_mm+oy/2,0,Outer), // 05B-F27
            RECT_LOOP("Collar/Inner",e.neck_center.x_mm-ix/2,e.neck_center.y_mm-iy/2,e.neck_center.x_mm+ix/2,e.neck_center.y_mm+iy/2,0,Inner)] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    assembly:=PARAM(r,"collar_assembly_id","Text","none") # exact currentManhole scoped assembly,not a source fixture ID
    ADD_PRISM(g,"Collar","Collar",assembly,"Concrete",plan,loops,z0,z1,r.source_ids+SOURCES(e,["CoverHaunchFlag","CoverHaunchSize"]))
    frame_height:=DATUM(e,"FrameTop")-DATUM(e,"FrameBottom")
    length_tol:double:=rules.length_tolerance_mm # mm;NR18 source-backed required field validated at S0
    IF abs(frame_height-100)>length_tol THEN RAISE("FRAME_HEIGHT_OWNER_RULE",e.id,["FrameBottom","FrameTop"],100,frame_height,r.source_ids) ELSE RETURN g ENDIF //CONTRACTC01;collar never changes ownerframe100
```

### H04-PIPE-AND-OWNER

```text
PIPE_CONTOURS(p:PipeSpecV2) -> (LoopV2[] inner,LoopV2[] outer,LoopV2[] cutout):
    IF p.kind=="Round" THEN
        ri:=p.inner_width_mm/2;ro:=ri+p.wall_thickness_mm;rc:=ro+p.mortar_mm //05B-F06
        center:=POINT(p.offset_u_mm,p.invert_mm+ri,0) //05B-F06; invert refers INNER bottom
        inner:=[CIRCLE_LOOP(p.id+"/Clear",center,ri,"Inner")] // 05B-F31
        outer:=[CIRCLE_LOOP(p.id+"/PipeOuter",center,ro,"Outer")] // 05B-F31
        cutout:=[CIRCLE_LOOP(p.id+"/ConcreteCut",center,rc,"Inner")] // 05B-F31
    ELSE IF p.kind IN["Box","DoubleBox"] THEN
        x0:=p.offset_u_mm-p.inner_width_mm/2;x1:=p.offset_u_mm+p.inner_width_mm/2 // 05B-F31
        y0:=p.invert_mm;y1:=y0+p.inner_height_mm //05B-F31
        inner:=[CHAMFERED_RECT_LOOP(x0,y0,x1,y1,p.chamfer_x_mm,p.chamfer_y_mm)]
        t:=p.wall_thickness_mm;m:=p.mortar_mm
        outer:=[RECT_LOOP(p.id+"/PipeOuter",x0-t,y0-t,x1+t,y1+t,0,"Outer")] // 05B-F31
        cutout:=[RECT_LOOP(p.id+"/ConcreteCut",x0-t-m,y0-t-m,x1+t+m,y1+t+m,0,"Inner")] //05B-F31;PipeCrossSectionBuilder exact rectangular external contour,inner chamfer stays inner only
        IF p.kind=="DoubleBox" THEN
            IF p.web_mm IS null OR p.web_mm<=0 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                RAISE("DOUBLE_BOX_WEB_UNRESOLVED",p.id,["web_mm"],"sourced positive web",p.web_mm,p.source_ids,["NR-20"])
            ELSE
                web_center:=p.offset_u_mm;left_x1:=web_center-p.web_mm/2;right_x0:=web_center+p.web_mm/2 //05B-F31
                IF left_x1<=x0 OR right_x0>=x1 THEN RAISE("DOUBLE_BOX_WEB_NO_ROOM",p.id,["web_mm"],"two positive chambers",p.web_mm,p.source_ids,["NR-20"])
                ELSE inner:=[CHAMFERED_RECT_LOOP(x0,y0,left_x1,y1,p.chamfer_x_mm,p.chamfer_y_mm),
                             CHAMFERED_RECT_LOOP(right_x0,y0,x1,y1,p.chamfer_x_mm,p.chamfer_y_mm)] ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ELSE RAISE("PIPE_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED",p.id,["kind"],"Round/Box/DoubleBox",p.kind,p.source_ids,["NR-20"]) ENDIF ENDIF
    RETURN(inner,outer,cutout)

CIRCLE_LOOP(id,center,r,role):
    IF r<=0 THEN RAISE("CIRCLE_RADIUS_INVALID",id,["radius_mm"],">0",r) ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        a:=POINT(center.x_mm+r,center.y_mm,0) // 05B-F31
        sign:=-1 IF role=="Inner" ELSE 1 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        curve:=ARC(id+"/Arc",a,a,center,(0,0,1),r,sign*2*pi,"Opening") //05B-F25/F31/F37
        RETURN LoopV2(id,role,[curve],true,sign*pi*r*r)
    ENDIF

CHAMFERED_RECT_LOOP(x0,y0,x1,y1,cx,cy):
    IF cx==0 AND cy==0 THEN RETURN RECT_LOOP(ENCODE(x0,y0,x1,y1),x0,y0,x1,y1,0,"Outer") ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        IF cx<=0 OR cy<=0 OR 2*cx>x1-x0 OR 2*cy>y1-y0 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            RAISE("BOX_CHAMFER_INVALID",null,["chamfer_x_mm","chamfer_y_mm"],"fits profile",[cx,cy])
        ELSE RETURN CLOSED_LINES([(x0+cx,y0),(x1-cx,y0),(x1,y0+cy),(x1,y1-cy),
                                  (x1-cx,y1),(x0+cx,y1),(x0,y1-cy),(x0,y0+cy)],"Outer") ENDIF //05B-F31
    ENDIF

PARTITION_OWNERS(g,opening):
    owned:=[]
    FOR c IN g.components WHERE c.material_id=="Concrete":
        intersection:=CSG_SECTION_INTERSECTION(c,opening) # H06 exact contour/depth, 05B-F32/F37
        IF intersection.has_positive_interior THEN APPEND owned c ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    IF owned spans incompatible assembly/material without approved NR20 ownership scope THEN
        RAISE("OPENING_CROSS_ASSEMBLY_UNAPPROVED",opening.id,["host_ids"],"approved partition",owned.ids,opening.source_ids,["NR-20"])
    ELSE RETURN owned ENDIF
```

### H05-CATCH

```text
ADD_CATCH(g,e):
    s:=e.catch
    host_key:="Wall/"+s.wall IF s.owner=="Body" ELSE "Neck" // 05B-F30
    host:=UNIQUE(g.components,local_key=host_key) ELSE RAISE("CATCH_HOST_MISSING",e.id,["catch.owner","catch.wall"],"existing host",host_key,s.source_ids)
    top:=host.z_max_mm
    clear_span:=e.clear_x_mm IF s.wall IN[T1,T3] ELSE e.clear_y_mm
    thick:=e.wall_mm;cx:=0;cy:=0 //05B-F25/F30: body frame origin
    IF s.owner=="Neck" THEN
        clear_span:=e.neck_clear_x_mm IF s.wall IN[T1,T3] ELSE e.neck_clear_y_mm
        thick:=e.neck_wall_mm;cx:=e.neck_center.x_mm;cy:=e.neck_center.y_mm
        IF s.position!="Center" THEN RAISE("CATCH_NECK_CENTER_REQUIRED",e.id,["catch.position"],"Center effective",s.position,s.source_ids)
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF # S2 already applied sourced HDSD p13 override, raw preserved
    ELSE
        ASSERT s.owner=="Body" ELSE RAISE("CATCH_OWNER_INVALID",e.id,["catch.owner"],"Body/Neck",s.owner,s.source_ids)
    ENDIF
    wf:=WALL_FRAME(s.wall, e.clear_x_mm IF s.owner=="Body" ELSE e.neck_clear_x_mm,
                          e.clear_y_mm IF s.owner=="Body" ELSE e.neck_clear_y_mm,0,cx,cy) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default

    IF s.position!="Center" THEN
        side_basis:=PARAM(RULE(entries,"NR-19",e.profile,"Catch","Placement"),"side_basis","Text","none")
        IF side_basis NOT IN["InsideLookingOut","OutsideLookingIn"] THEN RAISE("CATCH_SIDE_BASIS_MISSING",e.id,["side_basis"],"explicit observer basis",side_basis,s.source_ids,["NR-19"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ELSE side_basis:="InsideLookingOut" ENDIF # Center is invariant under observer reversal
    side_sign:=1 IF side_basis=="InsideLookingOut" ELSE -1 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    SWITCH s.position:
      Left: center_u:=side_sign*(clear_span/2-s.opening_width_mm/2)+s.offset_u_mm // 05B-F30
      Right: center_u:=-side_sign*(clear_span/2-s.opening_width_mm/2)+s.offset_u_mm // 05B-F30
      Center: center_u:=s.offset_u_mm
      DEFAULT: RAISE("CATCH_POSITION_INVALID",e.id,["catch.position"],"Left/Center/Right",s.position,s.source_ids)
    ENDSWITCH //05B-F30; FRAME-001 Left coordinate positive, source EX-088
    u0:=center_u-s.opening_width_mm/2;u1:=center_u+s.opening_width_mm/2 // 05B-F30
    opening_bottom:=top-s.opening_height_mm
    floor_top:=top-s.clear_height_mm
    floor_bottom:=floor_top-s.base_mm //05B-F30; NOTE-0411 clear height, no base thickness subtracted from clear
    IF u0 < -clear_span/2-tol OR u1>clear_span/2+tol OR opening_bottom<host.z_min_mm-tol OR // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
       s.clear_height_mm<s.opening_height_mm THEN
        RAISE("CATCH_OPENING_OUTSIDE_HOST",host.id,["catch.opening_width_mm","catch.opening_height_mm","catch.clear_height_mm"],
              "opening inside host/clear chamber",[u0,u1,opening_bottom,floor_top],s.source_ids)
    ELSE
        opening_frame:=FRAME(ENCODE(e.id,"CatchOpeningPlane"),wf.origin,wf.axis_u,wf.normal,wf.axis_v)
        cut:=RECT_LOOP("Catch/Open",u0,opening_bottom,u1,top,0,"Inner") // 05B-F30
        o:=OpeningV2(ENCODE(e.id,"CatchOpening"),"Catch",[host.id],opening_frame,[cut],[],[cut],0,thick,null,"NR-01",s.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        APPEND g.openings o; APPEND host.void_ids o.id
    ENDIF
    v0:=thick;v1:=thick+s.clear_depth_mm;half:=s.opening_width_mm/2;t:=s.wall_mm //05B-F30
    rectangles:=[
      ("Catch/Base",center_u-half-t,v0,center_u+half+t,v1+t,floor_bottom,floor_top),
      ("Catch/Left",center_u+half,v0,center_u+half+t,v1,floor_top,top),
      ("Catch/Right",center_u-half-t,v0,center_u-half,v1,floor_top,top),
      ("Catch/Front",center_u-half-t,v1,center_u+half+t,v1+t,floor_top,top)] //05B-F30
    FOR (key,a,b,c,d,z0,z1) IN rectangles:
        ADD_PRISM(g,key,"Catch",host.assembly_id,"Concrete",wf,
                  [RECT_LOOP(key+"/Outer",a,b,c,d,0,"Outer")],z0,z1,s.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ENDFOR
    IF s.pad_mm>0 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        p:=s.pad_expansion_mm
        ADD_PRISM(g,"Catch/Pad","Pad",ENCODE(e.id,"CatchPad"),"Bedding",wf,
             [RECT_LOOP("Catch/Pad/Outer",center_u-half-t-p,v0-p,center_u+half+t+p,v1+t+p,0,"Outer")], // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
             floor_bottom-s.pad_mm,floor_bottom,s.source_ids) //05B-F30
    ELSE ASSERT s.pad_mm==0 ELSE RAISE("CATCH_PAD_NEGATIVE",e.id,["catch.pad_mm"],">=0",s.pad_mm,s.source_ids) ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF s.product_code IS null THEN RAISE("CATCH_PRODUCT_CONTRACT_REQUIRED",e.id,["catch.product_code"],"compatible approved product","null",s.source_ids,["NR-09"])
    ELSE
        r:=RULE(entries,"NR-09",e.profile,"Catch","ProductFit");p:=UNIQUE(assets.products,code=s.product_code AND approved=true) ELSE RAISE("CATCH_PRODUCT_CONTRACT_MISSING",e.id,["catch.product_code"],"one approved exact product",s.product_code,s.source_ids,["NR-09"]);CHECK_APERTURE_CONTACT_MATCH(p,s,r)
        anchor_local:=p.registration_offset + (center_u,v0,top) //05B-F26/F30
        anchor_world:=WORLD(wf,anchor_local.x_mm,anchor_local.y_mm,anchor_local.z_mm)
        APPEND g.products ProductPlacementV2(ENCODE(e.id,p.id,"CatchProduct"),p.id,anchor_world,p.rotation_rad,1, // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                                             p.plan_asset,p.section_aa_asset,p.section_bb_asset,p.source_ids)
    ENDIF
```

### H06-ANALYTIC-BOOLEAN-AND-COLLISION

```text
# Coordinate rule: solid/patch/opening LoopV2 uses local XY of its owning frame; occurrence.path uses world XYZ.
# Only native ProductPlacement is a reference to source geometry. It never becomes a bbox concrete solid.

CURVE_INTERSECTIONS(a,b):  // 05B-F31, all solutions filtered by actual segment/arc domains
    IF both Line THEN
        d:=a.end-a.start;e:=b.end-b.start;den:=cross2(d,e)
        IF abs(den)>approved_area_tolerance THEN
            t:=cross2(b.start-a.start,e)/den;u:=cross2(b.start-a.start,d)/den // 05B-F37
            RETURN [(t,u)] IF both parameters in closed [0,1] ELSE [] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ELSE
            IF not collinear under approved distance tolerance THEN RETURN [] ELSE
                # Project endpoints onto nonzero dominant axis; return shared interval endpoints, not one guessed hit.
                RETURN endpoints of overlap of the two projected intervals mapped to both parameters
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ELSE IF one Line and one Arc THEN
        line:=the Line;circle:=the Arc;d:=line.end-line.start;f:=line.start-circle.center
        A:=dot(d,d);B:=2*dot(f,d);C:=dot(f,f)-circle.radius_mm^2 // 05B-F35
        discriminant:=B*B-4*A*C // 05B-F37
        IF discriminant<0 outside derived numerical bound THEN RETURN [] ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            IF discriminant is tangent within approved bound THEN roots:=[-B/(2*A)] // 05B-F37
            ELSE roots:=[(-B-sqrt(discriminant))/(2*A),(-B+sqrt(discriminant))/(2*A)] ENDIF // 05B-F37
            RETURN each root t in[0,1] whose point lies on signed arc sweep; preserve tangent once // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ENDIF
    ELSE IF both Arc THEN
        d:=distance(a.center,b.center) // 05B-F37
        IF d==0 under approved geometry tolerance THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            IF abs(a.radius_mm-b.radius_mm)>geometry_tolerance THEN RETURN [] ELSE
                RETURN endpoints of overlapping signed-angle intervals on same circle
            ENDIF
        ELSE IF d>a.radius_mm+b.radius_mm OR d<abs(a.radius_mm-b.radius_mm) outside tolerance THEN RETURN [] ELSE
            x:=(a.radius_mm^2-b.radius_mm^2+d^2)/(2*d);h2:=a.radius_mm^2-x^2 // 05B-F35
            base:=a.center+x*(b.center-a.center)/d // 05B-F37
            roots:=[base] IF h2 tangent ELSE [base+sqrt(h2)*perp((b.center-a.center)/d),base-sqrt(h2)*perp((b.center-a.center)/d)] // 05B-F37
            RETURN roots contained in both signed arc sweeps, de-duplicated by approved geometry tolerance
        ENDIF ENDIF
    ELSE RAISE("CURVE_INTERSECTION_KIND_UNSUPPORTED",null,["kind"],"Line/Arc",[a.kind,b.kind]) ENDIF ENDIF

INTERSECT_RUN_REGION(run,frame,loops):
    local_a:=TO_LOCAL(frame,run.start);local_b:=TO_LOCAL(frame,run.end) //05B-F26
    ts:=[0,1] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    FOR boundary IN all loops.curves: APPEND_ALL ts CURVE_INTERSECTIONS(local_run,boundary).line_parameters ENDFOR
    ts:=SORT_UNIQUE(ts,derived_parameter_tolerance)  # parameter tolerance=geometry_tol/run_length,05B-F31
    inside_intervals:=[]
    FOR i=0..ts.Count-2: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        m:=(ts[i]+ts[i+1])/2 // 05B-F37
        IF INSIDE_REGION(local_a+m*(local_b-local_a),loops) THEN
            APPEND inside_intervals [ts[i]*run.length_mm,ts[i+1]*run.length_mm] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN inside_intervals //05B-F31/F32

INSIDE_REGION(point,loops):
    # Exact analytic winding: horizontal ray crosses Lines and circle intersections at this y.
    # Half-open vertex rule: count lower endpoint, exclude upper endpoint, tangent contributes0.
    winding:=0 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    FOR curve IN loops.curves:
        FOR crossing IN intersections of ray (point,+X) with curve:
            IF crossing.x>point.x AND crossing is non-tangent AND half_open_endpoint_condition THEN
                winding:=winding+sign(curve tangent.y at crossing) // 05B-F37
            ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    RETURN winding!=0 //05B-F31/F37; on-boundary handling uses approved topology tolerance separately

UNION_AND_COMPLEMENT(intervals,support=[s0,s1]):
    valid:=[]
    FOR [a,b] IN intervals:
        low:=max(s0,min(a,b));high:=min(s1,max(a,b)) // 05B-F37
        IF high-low>length_tolerance THEN APPEND valid [low,high] ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    sorted:=SORT(valid,key=(start,end));merged:=[]
    FOR item IN sorted:
        IF merged empty OR item.start>merged.last.end+length_tolerance THEN APPEND merged item
        ELSE merged.last.end:=max(merged.last.end,item.end);merged.last.opening_ids:=UNION_ID_SETS(merged.last.opening_ids,item.opening_ids) ENDIF // 05B-F37
    ENDFOR
    retained:=[];cursor:=s0
    FOR item IN merged:
        IF item.start>cursor+length_tolerance THEN APPEND retained [cursor,item.start] ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        cursor:=max(cursor,item.end) // 05B-F37
    ENDFOR
    IF cursor<s1-length_tolerance THEN APPEND retained [cursor,s1] ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    all_ids:=SORT_UNIQUE(intervals.opening_ids)
    FOR interval IN retained: interval.opening_ids:=all_ids;interval.left_cut_ids:=merged immediately preceding interval .opening_ids or [];interval.right_cut_ids:=merged immediately following interval .opening_ids or [] ENDFOR
    RETURN merged,retained //05B-F32; provenance is never dropped by complement

REGION_BOOLEAN(regions,operation):
    pieces:=all region boundary Line/Arc pieces split at every CURVE_INTERSECTIONS solution // 05B-F37
    retained:=[]
    FOR piece IN pieces:
        midpoint,tangent:=ANALYTIC_MIDPOINT_AND_TANGENT(piece)
        left/right occupancy:=WINDING_LIMIT_ON_EACH_SIDE(midpoint,tangent,all regions)
        # Side test uses directed boundary membership plus exact winding of other regions;
        # no hardcoded sampling distance. Coincident boundaries grouped by geometric support and signed winding.
        out_left:=BOOL_EXPRESSION(operation,left occupancy)
        out_right:=BOOL_EXPRESSION(operation,right occupancy)
        IF out_left==out_right THEN CONTINUE ELSE
            APPEND retained piece oriented so occupied result lies to its left
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    vertices:=cluster endpoints only within approved geometry tolerance
    loops:=[]
    WHILE unused retained edges exist:
        start:=lexicographically smallest unused directed edge
        follow:=start;chain:=[]
        REPEAT:
            append follow to chain;mark follow used
            candidates:=unused outgoing edges at follow.end
            IF follow.end==start.start THEN EXIT REPEAT ELSE
                IF candidates empty THEN RAISE("BOOLEAN_BOUNDARY_OPEN",follow.id,["end"],"closed loop",follow.end)
                ELSE follow:=candidate with smallest positive occupied-left turn angle ENDIF
            ENDIF
        UNTIL edges processed would exceed retained.Count
        IF chain not closed THEN RAISE("BOOLEAN_BOUNDARY_CYCLE_INVALID",start.id,["curves"],"finite closed cycle",chain.ids)
        ELSE APPEND loops LoopV2(ENCODE(operation,chain.ids),"Outer" IF SIGNED_AREA(chain)>0 ELSE "Inner",chain,true,SIGNED_AREA(chain)) ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ENDWHILE
    RETURN loops //05B-F37; negative-area inner loops preserved for hatch+outline

SECTION_PART(part,view_frame,plane_offset):
    n:=view_frame.normal;f:=part.frame
    a:=dot(n,f.axis_u);b:=dot(n,f.axis_v);c:=dot(n,f.normal)
    d:=dot(n,f.origin-view_frame.origin)-plane_offset //05B-F26/F38
    IF abs(a)<=basis_tol AND abs(b)<=basis_tol THEN
        IF abs(c)<=basis_tol THEN RAISE("SECTION_FRAME_DEGENERATE",part.id,["frame"],"valid normal",[a,b,c]) ELSE
            w:=-d/c // 05B-F37
            IF w outside [part.depth_min_mm,part.depth_max_mm] THEN RETURN [] ELSE
                RETURN TRANSFORM_LOOPS_TO_VIEW(part.loops,part.frame,w,view_frame)
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ELSE IF abs(c)<=basis_tol THEN
        # Section plane parallel to extrusion: intersect footprint region with line a*u+b*v+d=0.
        q:=-d*(a,b)/(a*a+b*b);direction:=normalize((-b,a)) //05B-F31
        intervals:=INTERSECT_INFINITE_LINE_REGION(q,direction,part.loops) # same intersection+midpoint logic, bounds from finite exact region // 05B-F37
        out:=[]
        FOR [t0,t1] IN intervals:
            u0,v0:=q+t0*direction;u1,v1:=q+t1*direction // 05B-F37
            world_vertices:=[WORLD(f,u0,v0,part.depth_min_mm),WORLD(f,u1,v1,part.depth_min_mm),
                             WORLD(f,u1,v1,part.depth_max_mm),WORLD(f,u0,v0,part.depth_max_mm)]
            APPEND out CLOSED_LINES(project each world_vertex to view_frame,"Outer")
        ENDFOR
        RETURN out
    ELSE
        # Occupied source concrete prisms have polygon footprints. Oblique plane through them remains polygonal.
        IF any part.loops.curves.kind=="Arc" THEN
            RAISE("OBLIQUE_CURVED_SECTION_UNSUPPORTED",part.id,["frame","view_frame"],
                  "supported analytic section; no polygonized ellipse",[a,b,c],[],["NR-20"])
        ELSE
            faces:=EXTRUSION_POLYHEDRON_FACES(part) # two caps + one quad per boundary line, 05B-F27
            intersections:=[]
            FOR edge IN unique faces.edges:
                da:=dot(n,edge.start-view_frame.origin)-plane_offset;db:=dot(n,edge.end-view_frame.origin)-plane_offset
                IF da*db<0 THEN APPEND intersections edge.start+(da/(da-db))*(edge.end-edge.start) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                ELSE IF abs(da)<=geometry_tol THEN APPEND intersections edge.start ELSE NO_OP ENDIF ENDIF
            ENDFOR
            # Convex pieces handled separately; concave footprint is decomposed by finite edge-line arrangement first.
            RETURN ordered closed polygon of intersections for each convex piece projected into view
        ENDIF
    ENDIF ENDIF

SECTION_CSG(component,opening_list,view_frame,offset):
    occupied:=[]
    FOR part IN component.solid_parts in stored operation order:
        section:=SECTION_PART(part,view_frame,offset)
        occupied:=REGION_BOOLEAN([occupied,section],"Union" IF part.operation=="Union" ELSE "Difference")
    ENDFOR
    void_regions:=[]
    FOR o IN opening_list WHERE component.id IN o.host_ids:
        # Opening is an extrusion of concrete_cutout over depth_min..max in its own frame.
        APPEND_ALL void_regions SECTION_PART(OPENING_AS_EXTRUSION(o),view_frame,offset)
    ENDFOR
    RETURN REGION_BOOLEAN([occupied,REGION_BOOLEAN(void_regions,"Union")],"Difference")

HAS_OCCUPIED_INTERIOR(component,openings):
    z_events:=all world vertex Z of component solid parts + opening extent extrema // 05B-F37
    planes:=all intervals' mid-Z plus each nonzero depth component's own face-normal midplane
    FOR plane IN planes:
        section:=SECTION_CSG(component,openings,plane.frame,plane.offset)
        IF NET_AREA(section)>approved_area_tolerance THEN RETURN true ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN false # no volume number asserted; source 3D CSG and 2D sections remain exact

CSG_CONTAINS_SWEPT_CURVE(parts,curve,required_distance):
    # Build the exposed planar boundary of occupied CONCRETE union before checking cover.
    # Concrete source parts have polygonal footprints; native products are not cast-concrete parts.
    boundary:=EXPOSED_POLYHEDRAL_CSG_FACES(parts)
    # Construction: split every prism face by every other prism plane; classify each convex cell midpoint
    # using ordered Union/Subtract membership. Keep only cells with occupied on one side, empty on the other.
    # Retain face polygon vertices/world frame; dedup coincident cells. Internal same-pour seams are removed.
    work:=[parameter interval 0..1];visited:=0 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    WHILE work not empty:
        interval:=POP(work);visited:=visited+1 // 05B-F37
        IF visited>request.max_numeric_count THEN RAISE("COLLISION_RESOURCE_LIMIT",curve.id,["max_numeric_count"],"certified result before limit",visited) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        mid:=(interval.start+interval.end)/2;p:=CURVE_POINT(curve,mid) // 05B-F37
        distance:=MIN_DISTANCE_POINT_TO_FACE_POLYGONS(p,boundary)
        signed_distance:=distance IF INSIDE_POLYHEDRAL_CSG(p,parts) ELSE -distance
        half_length:=CURVE_LENGTH(curve)*(interval.end-interval.start)/2 //05B-F35/F36; signed distance is 1-Lipschitz
        lower:=signed_distance-half_length;upper:=signed_distance+half_length // 05B-F37
        IF lower>=required_distance-geometry_tol THEN CONTINUE ELSE
            IF upper<required_distance-geometry_tol THEN RETURN false ELSE
                IF interval midpoint equals either endpoint in floating representation THEN
                    RAISE("COLLISION_PROOF_INCONCLUSIVE",curve.id,["path"],"certified lower bound",[lower,upper],[],["NR-18"])
                ELSE PUSH [interval.start,mid] and [mid,interval.end] ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDWHILE
    RETURN true //05B-F36; no endpoint-only or arbitrary sample-count acceptance

CSG_INTERSECTS_SWEPT_CURVE(openings,curve,radius):
    # Distance point-to-extruded void: sqrt(distance_to_closed_profile_2D^2 + outside_depth_distance^2).
    # 2D distance uses exact point-to-Line/Arc minima and inside winding; multiple voids take minimum.
    # Same bounded interval traversal as above; lower=distance(mid)-half_length, upper=distance(mid)+half_length.
    # lower>=radius-geometry_tol -> that interval clear; upper<radius-geometry_tol -> collision;
    # ambiguous -> bisect, same resource/precision errors; no guessed clearance.
    RETURN collision IDs/curve intervals or certified no-collision from that traversal
```

### H07-SUPPORT-STATIONS-REGIONS

```text
SUPPORT_FRAME_AND_BOUNDS(host,s,rules):
    patches:=SELECT_SEMANTIC_SUPPORT_PATCHES(host,s,e,rules)  # full semantic face; no nearest-label test
    IF patches empty THEN RAISE("REBAR_SUPPORT_FACE_MISSING",s.id,["face"],"matching patch",s.face,s.source_ids)
    ELSE
        stack:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-19",effective.profile,s.component_kind,"LayerStack")
        expr_key:="offset."+s.component_kind+"."+s.face+"."+s.layer+"."+s.direction // 05B-F36
        expr_id:=PARAM(stack,expr_key,"Text","none")
        offset:=EVAL(stack,expr_id,{"cover_mm":s.cover_mm,"diameter_mm":s.diameter_mm,
                                   "host_thickness_mm":host.thickness_mm},{}).value //05B-F45/F36
        IF offset<s.cover_mm+s.diameter_mm/2 OR offset>host.thickness_mm-s.cover_mm-s.diameter_mm/2 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            RAISE("LAYER_STACK_NO_ROOM",s.id,[expr_key],"centreline fits cover envelope",offset,s.source_ids,["NR-19"])
        ELSE
            canonical:=HOST_CANONICAL_SUPPORT_FRAME(host,s,e,patches);frame:=FRAME(canonical.id,canonical.origin-canonical.normal*offset,canonical.axis_u,canonical.axis_v,canonical.normal)  //05B-F26
            region:=UNION_PATCH_REGIONS(patches projected into frame) //H06/F37 // 05B-F36
            RETURN {frame:frame,region:region,bounds:EXACT_BOUNDS(region),offset_mm:offset,host:host}
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

MEMBER_STATIONS(s,e,support,rules):
    IF s.family=="MainMesh" THEN
        across:="V" IF s.direction=="U" ELSE "U"
        span:=support.bounds.max[across]-support.bounds.min[across] //05B-F08
        pitch:=s.requested_pitch_mm+s.pitch_delta_mm //05B-F33; delta assigned only horizontal wall/neck specs in S2
        IF pitch<=0 THEN RAISE("MESH_PITCH_INVALID",s.id,["requested_pitch_mm","pitch_delta_mm"],">0",pitch,s.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ELSE
            positions:=DISTRIBUTE(span,s.cover_mm,s.diameter_mm,pitch,s.spacing_mode,rules) # H08/F08 // 05B-F36
            RETURN [{original_index:i,coordinate_mm:support.bounds.min[across]+positions[i],
                     actual_gap_mm:null IF i==0 ELSE positions[i]-positions[i-1]} FOR i IN 0..positions.Count-1] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ENDIF
    ELSE IF s.family=="Ladder" THEN
        [drop,pitch]:=FIELD_TUPLE(e,"Ladder.E",2) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        r:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-19",e.profile,"Ladder","LadderPlacement")
        top_id:=PARAM(r,"ladder_top_surface_id","Text","none") # NR-IO-006: note says đỉnh ga; legacy uses different tops
        bottom_expr:=PARAM(r,"ladder_min_z_expr","Text","none")
        z_first:=DATUM(e,top_id)-drop;z_min:=EVAL(r,bottom_expr,ENV(e,s,support),{}).value //05B-F11/F45
        IF pitch<=0 OR z_first<z_min THEN RAISE("LADDER_NO_VALID_STATION",s.id,["Ladder.E","ladder_min_z_expr"],"pitch>0, first>=min",[pitch,z_first,z_min],s.source_ids,["NR-19","NR-IO-006"]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ELSE
            count:=floor((z_first-z_min)/pitch)+1 //05B-F11
            CHECK_RESOURCE_COUNT(count,request.max_numeric_count,s.id)
            RETURN [{original_index:i,coordinate_mm:z_first-i*pitch,actual_gap_mm:null IF i==0 ELSE pitch} FOR i=0..count-1] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ENDIF
    ELSE IF s.family=="Tie" THEN
        r:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-03",e.profile,s.component_kind,"TieStations")
        nu:=EXACT_INT(EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"count_u_expr","Text","none"),ENV(e,s,support),{}).value)
        nv:=EXACT_INT(EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"count_v_expr","Text","none"),ENV(e,s,support),{}).value) //05B-F45
        CHECK_RESOURCE_COUNT(nu*nv,request.max_numeric_count,s.id)
        out:=[]
        FOR i=0..nu-1:FOR j=0..nv-1: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            env:=ENV(e,s,support)+{"i":i,"j":j,"requested_pitch_mm":s.requested_pitch_mm} // 05B-F36
            keep:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"keep_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
            IF keep==0 THEN CONTINUE ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                IF keep!=1 THEN RAISE("TIE_KEEP_NOT_BOOLEAN",s.id,["keep_expr"],"0/1",keep,r.source_ids,["NR-03"]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                ELSE
                    u:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"u_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
                    v:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"v_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
                    APPEND out {original_index:i*nv+j,original_key:ENCODE(s.id,i,j),u_mm:u,v_mm:v,coordinate_mm:u,actual_gap_mm:null} //05B-F25/F46
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR ENDFOR
        # A sourced zero-count result is suppressed with reason; no minimum1 tie.
        RETURN out
    ELSE
        r:=RULE_FOR_SHAPE(s.shape_recipe_id)
        count:=s.count IF s.spacing_mode=="CountBased" ELSE EXACT_INT(EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"station_count_expr","Text","none"),ENV(e,s,support),{}).value)
        CHECK_RESOURCE_COUNT(count,request.max_numeric_count,s.id)
        out:=[]
        FOR i=0..count-1: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            env:=ENV(e,s,support)+{"i":i,"count":count} // 05B-F36
            u:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"station_u_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
            v:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"station_v_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
            APPEND out {original_index:i,u_mm:u,v_mm:v,coordinate_mm:u,actual_gap_mm:null}
        ENDFOR
        RETURN out
    ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF

STRAIGHT_SUPPORT_RUN(s,support,station):
    IF s.direction=="U" THEN
        a:=WORLD(support.frame,support.bounds.min_x_mm,station.coordinate_mm,0) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        b:=WORLD(support.frame,support.bounds.max_x_mm,station.coordinate_mm,0) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE IF s.direction=="V" THEN
        a:=WORLD(support.frame,station.coordinate_mm,support.bounds.min_y_mm,0) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        b:=WORLD(support.frame,station.coordinate_mm,support.bounds.max_y_mm,0) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE RAISE("MAIN_DIRECTION_INVALID",s.id,["direction"],"U/V",s.direction,s.source_ids) ENDIF ENDIF
    # Trim parent against support region eroded by cover+Ø/2, not just bounding rectangle.
    intervals:=INTERSECT_RUN_REGION(LINE(s.id+"/Parent",a,b,"StraightRun"),support.frame, // 05B-F36
                                   OFFSET_CONTOUR(support.region,s.cover_mm+s.diameter_mm/2,"Inner")) //05B-F36
    IF intervals.Count!=1 THEN RAISE("MAIN_SUPPORT_FRAGMENTED",s.id,["support.region"],"one parent run before opening clip",intervals,s.source_ids,["NR-19"]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE pa:=a+(b-a)*intervals[0].start/distance(a,b);pb:=a+(b-a)*intervals[0].end/distance(a,b);RETURN {start:pa,end:pb,length_mm:distance(pa,pb),direction:s.direction,frame:support.frame} ENDIF //05B-F31/F35

REGION_FROM_END_ROLES(parent,interval,cuts,direction):
    ordered_holes:=unique opening IDs in cuts sorted along parent parameter
    IF ordered_holes.Count==0 THEN RETURN "Uncut" ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        before:=opening intervals strictly after this retained interval
        after:=opening intervals strictly before this retained interval
        IF before nonempty AND after nonempty THEN RETURN "Middle" ELSE
            IF ordered_holes.Count>1 THEN RETURN "Multiple" ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                # Parent tangent is stored host U/V orientation; use coordinate ordering, not vertex enumeration after mirror.
                center:=opening geometric center projected on parent host coordinate
                mid:=midpoint(interval)
                IF direction=="U" THEN RETURN "Left" IF mid.host_u>center.host_u ELSE "Right"
                ELSE RETURN "Above" IF mid.host_v>center.host_v ELSE "Below" ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDIF //05B-F32/F49; owner T1A/B left/right, T2A/B above/below later in S5

CHECK_BAR_SUPPORT_AND_VOIDS(bar,g,rules):
    r:=bar.diameter_mm/2 //05B-F36
    FOR segment IN bar.path:
        # Analytic swept disk along Line/Arc, no endpoint-only collision test.
        member:=UNIQUE(e.members,id=bar.spec_id) ELSE RAISE("BAR_SPEC_MISSING",bar.id,["spec_id"],"exact member spec",bar.spec_id)
        support_parts:=g.components WHERE assembly_id==bar.assembly_id AND material_role IN["BodyConcrete","NeckConcrete","PanelConcrete","CatchConcrete"] AND material_id==UNIQUE(g.components,id=bar.host_id).material_id
        support_ok:=CSG_CONTAINS_SWEPT_CURVE(support_parts,segment,r+member.cover_mm) // 05B-F36
        collisions:=CSG_INTERSECTS_SWEPT_CURVE(g.openings,segment,r)
        IF !support_ok THEN RAISE("BAR_OUTSIDE_SUPPORT",bar.id,["path"],"full path including legs inside cover envelope",segment,bar.source_ids,["NR-19"])
        ELSE IF collisions nonempty THEN RETURN {bar_id:bar.id,opening_ids:collisions.opening_ids,segment_id:segment.id}
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN null

BUILD_ANGLE_ITEMS(s,e,host,rules):
    code:=FIELD_TEXT(e,"Panel.AngleSteelCode") IF host.kind=="Panel" ELSE FIELD_TEXT(e,"AngleCode")
    row:=UNIQUE parsed CF.Data rows where exact Catalog.Angle.Code==code
    IF row missing OR row.unit_mass_kg_per_m<=0 THEN RAISE("ANGLE_CATALOG_MISSING",s.id,["Catalog.Angle.Code","Catalog.Angle.UnitMass"],"exact code with positive kg/m",code,s.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE
        recipe:=FIND_SHAPE_RECIPE(rules,s.shape_recipe_id,e.profile,s.component_kind,"Angle")
        result:=[]
        FOR physical frame position from approved AnglePosition set or panel 1/2 frames: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            path,roles:=BUILD_PHYSICAL_SHAPE(recipe,s,e,host,position,null,null,rules)
            total:=SUM_CURVE_LENGTHS(path);mass:=total/1000*row.unit_mass_kg_per_m //05B-F01/F20/F35
            APPEND result AngleOccurrenceV2(ENCODE(e.id,host.id,position,"Angle"),host.id,
               host.id IF host.kind=="Panel" ELSE null,code,row.unit_mass_kg_per_m,path,total,mass,recipe.id,
               DISTINCT(s.source_ids+row.source_ids+recipe.source_ids),s.id,roles)
        ENDFOR
        RETURN result
    ENDIF
```
