### H08-DISTRIBUTION-BENDS-AND-OCCURRENCES

```text
DISTRIBUTE(span,cover,diameter,pitch,mode,rules) -> double[]:
    IF any input nonfinite OR span<=0 OR cover<0 OR diameter<=0 OR pitch<=0 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        RAISE("DISTRIBUTION_INVALID_INPUT",null,["span","cover","diameter","pitch"],"finite positive except cover>=0",[span,cover,diameter,pitch]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE
        q:=cover+diameter/2;usable:=span-2*q //05B-F08
        IF usable<0 THEN RAISE("DISTRIBUTION_NO_CLEAR_SPAN",null,["span","cover","diameter"],">=0 usable",usable) ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            IF usable==0 THEN RETURN[q] ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                ratio:=usable/pitch;nearest:=ROUND_TO_EVEN(ratio,0) # only numerical integer-nearness, not quantity display;05B-F08
                IF nearest>=1 AND abs(usable-nearest*pitch)<=rules.length_tolerance_mm THEN ratio:=nearest ELSE KEEP ratio ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                IF mode=="Equalized" THEN k:=ceil(ratio)
                ELSE IF mode=="ByPitch" THEN k:=floor(ratio)
                ELSE RAISE("DISTRIBUTION_MODE_INVALID",null,["mode"],"Equalized/ByPitch",mode) ENDIF ENDIF
                CHECK_RESOURCE_COUNT(k+1,request.max_numeric_count,null) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                IF k==0 THEN RETURN[span/2] ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    gap:=usable/k IF mode=="Equalized" ELSE pitch // 05B-F08
                    first:=q IF mode=="Equalized" ELSE q+(usable-k*gap)/2 //05B-F08
                    positions:=[first+i*gap FOR i=0..k] // 05B-F08
                    IF mode=="Equalized" THEN positions[k]:=span-q ELSE KEEP positions ENDIF
                    IF any consecutive gap<=0 OR Equalized gap>pitch+rules.length_tolerance_mm THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                        RAISE("DISTRIBUTION_PRECISION_LOSS",null,["positions"],"strictly increasing valid gaps",positions)
                    ELSE RETURN positions ENDIF
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDIF

BUILD_PHYSICAL_SHAPE(recipe,s,e,support,station,start,end,rules):
    env:=ENV(e,s,support)+STATION_ENV(station) // 05B-F35
    IF start IS NOT null AND end IS NOT null THEN
        env.ADD("run_start",TO_LOCAL(support.frame,start));env.ADD("run_end",TO_LOCAL(support.frame,end))
        env.ADD("run_length_mm",distance(start,end)) //05B-F26/F35
    ELSE KEEP env ENDIF
    IF s.hook_pattern IS NOT null THEN
        hook_mode:=FIELD_TEXT(e,"HookMode")
        IF hook_mode=="Theo KC" THEN hook_mm:=support.host.thickness_mm-2*s.cover_mm // 05B-F35
        ELSE IF hook_mode=="Theo ĐK" THEN hook_mm:=FIELD_NUM(e,"HookMultiple")*s.diameter_mm // 05B-F35
        ELSE RAISE("HOOK_MODE_INVALID",s.id,["HookMode"],"Theo KC/Theo ĐK",hook_mode,s.source_ids) ENDIF ENDIF //05B-F09
        env.ADD("hook_nominal_mm",hook_mm)
        IF hook_mm<0 THEN RAISE("HOOK_NO_ROOM",s.id,["cover_mm","host_thickness_mm"],">=0 hook nominal",hook_mm,s.source_ids,["NR-19"]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ELSE KEEP env ENDIF
    corners:=[];roles:=[]
    FOR c IN recipe.corners in stored topology order:
        x:=EVAL(rule_for(recipe),c.x_expr,env,{});y:=EVAL(rule_for(recipe),c.y_expr,env,{});z:=EVAL(rule_for(recipe),c.z_expr,env,{})
        IF any output unit !="mm" THEN RAISE("SHAPE_CORNER_UNIT_INVALID",s.id,[c.role],"mm",[x.unit,y.unit,z.unit],recipe.source_ids)
        ELSE APPEND corners POINT(x.value,y.value,z.value) ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    IF corners.Count<2 THEN RAISE("SHAPE_TOPOLOGY_EMPTY",s.id,["recipe.corners"],">=2",corners.Count,recipe.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE
        tangency_before:=array zero length corners.Count;tangency_after:=array zero length corners.Count
        arcs:=map<int,CurveV2>()
        FOR i=1..corners.Count-2: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            c:=recipe.corners[i]
            IF c.bend_radius_mm IS null THEN
                # Sharp corner is allowed only when recipe explicitly marks sharp; missing bend data never means straight.
                ASSERT APPROVED_PARAM(recipe,"sharp."+c.role)==true ELSE RAISE("BEND_RADIUS_UNRESOLVED",s.id,[c.role],"approved radius/sharp",null,recipe.source_ids,["NR-02","NR-04","NR-19"])
            ELSE
                r:=c.bend_radius_mm+s.diameter_mm/2 IF c.radius_basis=="Inner" ELSE c.bend_radius_mm // 05B-F35
                IF c.radius_basis NOT IN["Inner","Centreline"] THEN RAISE("BEND_BASIS_INVALID",s.id,[c.role],"Inner/Centreline",c.radius_basis,recipe.source_ids,["NR-02"])
                ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                before:=normalize(corners[i]-corners[i-1]);after:=normalize(corners[i+1]-corners[i]) // 05B-F35
                turn:=atan2(norm(cross(before,after)),dot(before,after));t:=r*tan(turn/2) //05B-F35
                IF t>=distance(corners[i],corners[i-1])-tangency_after[i-1] OR t>=distance(corners[i+1],corners[i]) THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    RAISE("BEND_NO_ROOM",s.id,[c.role],"tangent lengths fit runs",t,recipe.source_ids,["NR-19"])
                ELSE
                    a:=corners[i]-before*t;b:=corners[i]+after*t // 05B-F35
                    n:=normalize(cross(before,after));center:=a+cross(n,before)*r // 05B-F35
                    arcs[i]:=ARC(ENCODE(s.id,station.original_index,c.role),a,b,center,n,r,turn,"Bend")
                    tangency_before[i]:=t;tangency_after[i]:=t
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
        path:=[]
        FOR i=0..corners.Count-2: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            tangent:=normalize(corners[i+1]-corners[i]) // 05B-F35
            a:=corners[i]+tangent*tangency_after[i];b:=corners[i+1]-tangent*tangency_before[i+1] //05B-F35
            IF distance(a,b)>rules.length_tolerance_mm THEN APPEND path LINE(ENCODE(s.id,station.original_index,"Run",i),a,b,"StraightRun")
            ELSE IF distance(a,b)>0 THEN RAISE("SHAPE_RUN_UNDER_TOLERANCE",s.id,["corners"],"constructable run",distance(a,b),recipe.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            ELSE NO_OP ENDIF ENDIF
            IF arcs has key i+1 THEN APPEND path arcs[i+1] ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            APPEND roles RoleValueV2(recipe.corners[i].role,distance(corners[i],corners[i+1]),recipe.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ENDFOR
        # Convert ALL local endpoints/centres/normals through the SAME support.frame, including bend normals.
        world_path:=TRANSFORM_PATH(path,support.frame) //05B-F26/F35
        RETURN world_path,roles
    ENDIF

MAKE_OCCURRENCE(parent_id,ordinal,s,station,host,openings,region,path,roles,recipe,e,rules):
    length_line:=sum(distance(c.start,c.end) FOR c.kind=="Line") // 05B-F35
    length_all:=sum(distance(c.start,c.end) IF c.kind=="Line" ELSE c.radius_mm*abs(c.sweep_rad) FOR c IN path) //05B-F35
    env:=ENV(e,s,host)+ROLE_ENV(roles)+{"straight_run_mm":length_line,"physical_path_mm":length_all} // 05B-F35
    schedule:=EVAL(rule_for(recipe),recipe.length_expr_id,env,{}) //05B-F45
    IF schedule.unit!="mm" OR schedule.value<=0 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        RAISE("SCHEDULE_LENGTH_INVALID",parent_id,["length_expr_id"],"positive mm",schedule,recipe.source_ids)
    ELSE
        IF recipe.fabrication_basis!="Centreline" THEN
            RAISE("FABRICATION_BASIS_DATA_MISSING",parent_id,["recipe.fabrication_basis"],"approved Centreline",recipe.fabrication_basis,recipe.source_ids,["NR-02","NR-19"])
        ELSE fabrication:=length_all;status:="Known" ENDIF
        RETURN OccurrenceV2(
          id=ENCODE(parent_id,ordinal),parent_id=parent_id,host_id=s.host_id,assembly_id=host.assembly_id,
          panel_instance_id=host.id IF host.kind=="Panel" ELSE null,face=s.face,layer=s.layer,direction=s.direction,family=s.family,
          station_index=station.original_index,station_mm=station.coordinate_mm,diameter_mm=s.diameter_mm,
          requested_pitch_mm=s.requested_pitch_mm,actual_gap_mm=station.actual_gap_mm,opening_ids=SORT_UNIQUE(openings),
          region_role=region,path=path,role_values=roles,straight_run_mm=length_line,fabrication_length_mm=fabrication,
          schedule_length_mm=schedule.value,measurement_basis=recipe.measurement_basis,length_status=status,
          shape_recipe_id=recipe.id,source_ids=DISTINCT(s.source_ids+recipe.source_ids),
          spec_id=s.id,station_key=station.original_key IF provided ELSE ENCODE(s.id,station.original_index),
          fabrication_basis=recipe.fabrication_basis)
    ENDIF
```

### H09-DOWELS

```text
BUILD_DOWEL_PAIRS(s,e,g,rules):
    r:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-06",e.profile,"Joint","Dowel")
    q:=PARAM(r,"pitch_quantum_mm","Number","mm")
    IF q!=50 THEN RAISE("DOWEL_ROUNDING_QUANTUM_SOURCE_CONFLICT",s.id,["pitch_quantum_mm"],"50 from EX-167",q,r.source_ids,["NR-06"])
    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF //05B-F18; quantum sourced, not all requested pitch forced50
    joint:=UNIQUE(g.joints,dowel_required=true) ELSE RAISE("DOWEL_JOINT_MISSING",s.id,["joints"],"one approved host joint",g.joints.ids,s.source_ids)
    host_loop:=CLOSED_JOINT_SUPPORT_LOOP(joint,g) # inner/outer offset expression from r, never fixture stations // 05B-F34
    perimeter:=SUM_CURVE_LENGTHS(host_loop.curves)
    pitch:=q*ROUND_WITH_MODE(s.requested_pitch_mm/q,PARAM(r,"pitch_midpoint_mode","Text","none")) //05B-F18
    IF pitch<=0 THEN RAISE("DOWEL_EFFECTIVE_PITCH_INVALID",s.id,["requested_pitch_mm","pitch_quantum_mm"],">0",pitch,s.source_ids,["NR-06"]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    rule_env:=ENV(e,s,host_loop)+{"perimeter_mm":perimeter,"effective_pitch_mm":pitch} // 05B-F34
    count:=EXACT_INT(EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"station_count_expr","Text","none"),rule_env,{}).value)
    CHECK_RESOURCE_COUNT(count,request.max_numeric_count,s.id)
    lower_embed:=PARAM(r,"lower_embed_mm","Number","mm");upper_embed:=PARAM(r,"upper_embed_mm","Number","mm")
    hole_depth:=PARAM(r,"hole_depth_mm","Number","mm");hole_dia:=FIELD_NUM(e,"DowelHoleDia")
    bars:=[];pairs:=[]
    FOR i=0..count-1: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        station_distance:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"station_distance_expr","Text","none"),rule_env+{"i":i},{}).value // 05B-F34
        IF station_distance<0 OR station_distance>=perimeter THEN RAISE("DOWEL_STATION_OUTSIDE_LOOP",s.id,["station_distance_expr"],"[0,perimeter)",station_distance,r.source_ids,["NR-06"]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ELSE
            xy:=POINT_AT_DISTANCE_ON_CLOSED_LOOP(host_loop,station_distance)
            z0:=DATUM(e,"WallTop")-lower_embed;z1:=DATUM(e,"RoofBottom")+upper_embed //05B-F34
            IF abs((z1-z0)-FIELD_NUM(e,"DowelLength"))>rules.length_tolerance_mm OR hole_dia<=s.diameter_mm OR hole_depth<upper_embed THEN
                RAISE("DOWEL_PAIR_DIMENSION_MISMATCH",s.id,["DowelLength","DowelHoleDia","hole_depth_mm"],
                      "embed+joint length matches input; hole fits",[z0,z1,hole_dia,hole_depth],s.source_ids,["NR-06"])
            ELSE
                path:=[LINE(ENCODE(s.id,i,"Straight"),POINT(xy.x_mm,xy.y_mm,z0),POINT(xy.x_mm,xy.y_mm,z1),"StraightRun")]
                # Dowel uses one straight approved recipe; never nominal main-mesh hooks.
                bar:=MAKE_OCCURRENCE(ENCODE(s.id,i),0,s,STATION(i,station_distance),UNIQUE(g.components,local_key="Roof"),[],"Uncut",path, // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                                    [RoleValueV2("Length",z1-z0,s.source_ids)],DOWEL_STRAIGHT_RECIPE(r),e,rules)
                hole_id:=ENCODE(joint.id,i,"Hole")
                pair:=DowelPairV2(ENCODE(joint.id,i),joint.id,bar.id,hole_id,
                    POINT(xy.x_mm,xy.y_mm,DATUM(e,"RoofBottom")),hole_dia,hole_depth,
                    Vector3V2(0,0,1),DATUM(e,"RoofBottom"),DATUM(e,"RoofBottom")+hole_depth,s.source_ids+r.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                collisions:=CHECK_DOWEL_AND_HOLE_ENVELOPES(bar,pair,g) # H06 swept curve & hole extrusion, includes Catch opening
                IF collisions empty THEN APPEND bars bar;APPEND pairs pair ELSE
                    relocation:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-21",e.profile,"Joint","DowelCollision")
                    candidates:=APPROVED_FINITE_RELOCATION_STATIONS(relocation,i,host_loop)
                    replacement:=FIRST candidate for which BOTH bar and paired hole pass support/void checks // 05B-F34
                    IF replacement none THEN RAISE("DOWEL_CATCH_COLLISION",bar.id,["path","hole_id"],"valid station or approved relocation",collisions,s.source_ids,["NR-21"])
                    ELSE APPEND bars replacement.bar;APPEND pairs replacement.pair ENDIF
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN bars,pairs
```

### H10-CANONICAL-AND-MASS

```text
UNIT_MASS(diameter_mm,rules,profile,component):
    r:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-14",profile,component,"Mass")
    mode:=PARAM(r,"round_mass_mode","Text","none")
    IF mode=="DiameterSquared" THEN divisor:=PARAM(r,"diameter_squared_divisor","Number","dimensionless");RETURN diameter_mm^2/divisor // 05B-F20
    ELSE IF mode=="Density" THEN density:=PARAM(r,"density_kg_per_m3","Number","kg_per_m3");RETURN density*pi*diameter_mm^2/4/1000000 // 05B-F01
    ELSE RAISE("MASS_POLICY_UNAPPROVED",component,["NR14.round_mass_mode"],"DiameterSquared/Density",mode,r.source_ids,["NR-14"]) ENDIF ENDIF
    //05B-F20; values162/7850 not defaults; SI area conversion05B-F01/F25

BUILD_CANONICAL(bars,rules):
    rows:=[]
    FOR partition IN GROUP_BY_EXACT(bars,key=(host assembly,shape topology,diameter_mm,fabrication_basis,
                       canonical ordered role values,canonical fabrication_length_mm,canonical schedule_length_mm)):
        ids:=SORT_UNIQUE(partition.ids);single:=partition[0].fabrication_length_mm // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        IF any member has null fabrication length OR length_status!="Known" OR exact serialized fabrication length!=single THEN
            RAISE("CANONICAL_LENGTH_UNRESOLVED",partition.key,["fabrication_length_mm"],"known identical fabrication lengths",partition.ids,partition.source_ids)
        ELSE
            quantity:=ids.Count;total:=quantity*single //05B-F04
            mass_rule:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-14",e.profile,partition[0].host_id,"Mass") // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            length_basis:=PARAM(mass_rule,"mass_length_basis","Text","none")
            IF length_basis=="Fabrication" THEN accounted:=total
            ELSE IF length_basis=="Schedule" THEN accounted:=SUM(partition.schedule_length_mm) // 05B-F20
            ELSE RAISE("MASS_LENGTH_BASIS_UNAPPROVED",partition.key,["NR14.mass_length_basis"],"Fabrication/Schedule",length_basis,mass_rule.source_ids,["NR-14"]) ENDIF ENDIF
            mass:=accounted/1000*UNIT_MASS(partition[0].diameter_mm,rules,e.profile,partition[0].host_id) //05B-F01/F20
            APPEND rows CanonicalRowV2(HASH(partition.key),ids,partition[0].diameter_mm,single,quantity,total,mass, // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                                      "FabricationCentreline",accounted,length_basis)
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN rows
```

### H11-COLLECTORS-AND-LANES

```text
BUILD_COLLECTORS(group,targets,projected_curves,view,recipe,rules):
    members:=projected_curves WHERE group_id==group.id AND view_id==view.id
    # Collector is perpendicular to projected straight-run direction. No longest physical member chosen as representative.
    axis:=PARAM(recipe,"collector_axis","Text","none") # Horizontal/Vertical, scoped per view/direction // 05B-F39
    candidates:=sorted unique member interval endpoints and midpoints on axis perpendicular coordinate //05B-F39
    branches:=[];uncovered:=SET(group.member_ids visible in this view)
    FOR coordinate IN candidates sorted by recipe distance to preferred side, then coordinate:
        line:=infinite line at coordinate along collector axis
        hits:=all exact Line/Arc intersections with members; reject points inside concrete voids // 05B-F39
        hits:=DEDUP_BY(member_id,point,approved geometry tolerance)
        hits:=hits WHERE member_id IN uncovered
        IF hits empty THEN CONTINUE ELSE
            # Split at every void crossing/forbidden route gap; do not tick a removed bar.
            ordered:=SORT(hits,along collector axis)
            pieces:=SPLIT_COLLECTOR_AT_VOID_INTERVALS(ordered,projection.regions,projection.opening_map)
            FOR piece IN pieces containing >=1 actual member: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                APPEND branches {points:[first hit,last hit],hits:piece.hits}
                uncovered.REMOVE_ALL(piece.hits.member_ids)
            ENDFOR
        ENDIF
        IF uncovered empty THEN BREAK ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    IF uncovered nonempty THEN
        # Per-member short branch is deterministic fallback, attached to this actual member/target.
        FOR id IN SORT(uncovered):
            c:=UNIQUE(members,source_id=id AND approved target curve role)
            q:=CURVE_POINT(c,PARAM(recipe,"fallback_curve_parameter","Number","dimensionless"))
            APPEND branches {points:[q],hits:[{member_id:id,point:q}]}
        ENDFOR
    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    RETURN branches


LANES_FROM_EXPLICIT_RECIPE(view,p,recipe,anchor_points:Point2V2[]):
    IF anchor_points empty THEN RAISE("ANNOTATION_ANCHOR_SET_EMPTY",view.id,["anchor_points"],"at least one actual anchor",[],recipe.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    b:Bounds2V2:=EXACT_VIEW_GEOMETRY_BOUNDS(view,p);lanes:=[]
    FOR side IN recipe.allowed_side_parameter_keys in stored priority order:
        offset:=PARAM(recipe,"lane_offset_paper_mm."+side,"Number","paper_mm")*view.scale // 05B-F39
        extent:=PARAM(recipe,"lane_extent_paper_mm."+side,"Number","paper_mm")*view.scale //05B-F14
        IF offset<0 OR extent<0 THEN RAISE("ANNOTATION_LANE_RANGE_INVALID",view.id,[side],">=0 paper offsets",[offset,extent],recipe.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        IF side=="Left" THEN anchor:=(b.min_x_mm-offset,0);direction:=(0,1);allowed:=[b.min_y_mm-extent,b.max_y_mm+extent] // 05B-F39
        ELSE IF side=="Right" THEN anchor:=(b.max_x_mm+offset,0);direction:=(0,1);allowed:=[b.min_y_mm-extent,b.max_y_mm+extent] // 05B-F39
        ELSE IF side=="Bottom" THEN anchor:=(0,b.min_y_mm-offset);direction:=(1,0);allowed:=[b.min_x_mm-extent,b.max_x_mm+extent] // 05B-F39
        ELSE IF side=="Top" THEN anchor:=(0,b.max_y_mm+offset);direction:=(1,0);allowed:=[b.min_x_mm-extent,b.max_x_mm+extent] // 05B-F39
        ELSE RAISE("ANNOTATION_SIDE_INVALID",view.id,["allowed_side_parameter_keys"],"Left/Right/Bottom/Top",side,recipe.source_ids,["NR-22"]) ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
        coordinates:=SORT([dot(q-anchor,direction) FOR q IN anchor_points])
        n:=coordinates.Count;preferred:=coordinates[(n-1)/2] IF n odd ELSE (coordinates[n/2-1]+coordinates[n/2])/2 //05B-F25
        APPEND lanes {id:ENCODE(view.id,recipe.id,side),side:side,anchor:anchor,direction:direction,
                      allowed_interval:allowed,preferred_target_projection:preferred}
    ENDFOR
    RETURN lanes # extension lanes have this same local field schema;no omitted side field

PROJECT_OBSTACLES_TO_LANE(obstacles,lane,gap,ink,scale,rotation_rad,port_native):
    # Parameter t is label PORT position, not insertion. Rotate/scale ink and subtract transformed port first.
    port_delta:=ROTATE(port_native*scale,rotation_rad) // 05B-F39
    relative_box:=TRANSFORM_INK(ink,-port_delta,scale,rotation_rad)
    forbidden:=[]
    FOR obstacle IN obstacles:
        b:=obstacle.bounds
        r:=Bounds2V2(b.min_x_mm-relative_box.max_x_mm-gap,b.min_y_mm-relative_box.max_y_mm-gap,
                    b.max_x_mm-relative_box.min_x_mm+gap,b.max_y_mm-relative_box.min_y_mm+gap) //05B-F39/F40
        hit:=LINE_PARAMETER_INTERVAL_IN_BOX(lane.anchor,lane.direction,r,lane.allowed_interval)
        IF hit IS null THEN NO_OP ELSE APPEND forbidden hit ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    merged,retained:=UNION_AND_COMPLEMENT(forbidden,lane.allowed_interval)
    RETURN merged # disjoint ordered interval pairs

LINE_PARAMETER_INTERVAL_IN_BOX(origin,direction,box,allowed):
    lo:=allowed.start;hi:=allowed.end
    FOR axis IN [X,Y]:
        o:=origin[axis];d:=direction[axis];b0:=box.min[axis];b1:=box.max[axis]
        IF d==0 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            IF o<b0 OR o>b1 THEN RETURN null ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        ELSE
            a:=(b0-o)/d;b:=(b1-o)/d;lo:=max(lo,min(a,b));hi:=min(hi,max(a,b)) //05B-F31
            IF hi<lo THEN RETURN null ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN {start:lo,end:hi,opening_ids:[]} # zero-length tangent remains a forbidden endpoint

CONNECT_COLLECTORS_TO_PORT(collectors,port,lane,recipe,view):
    out:=[];stub:=PARAM(recipe,"stub_paper_mm","Number","paper_mm")*view.scale // 05B-F39
    mode:=PARAM(recipe,"route_mode","Text","none")
    IF stub<0 THEN RAISE("ANNOTATION_STUB_INVALID",view.id,["stub_paper_mm"],">=0",stub,recipe.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    FOR branch IN collectors:
        points:=COPY(branch.points)
        IF points empty THEN RAISE("COLLECTOR_POINTS_EMPTY",view.id,["collectors.points"],"actual target point",[],recipe.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        score(q):=-q.x_mm IF lane.side=="Left" ELSE q.x_mm IF lane.side=="Right" ELSE -q.y_mm IF lane.side=="Bottom" ELSE q.y_mm
        IF score(points.first)>score(points.last) THEN REVERSE points ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        start:=points.last # selected label-side end;preserve collector traversal to every actual hit
        IF lane.side=="Left" THEN elbow:=POINT2(port.x_mm+stub,start.y_mm) // 05B-F39
        ELSE IF lane.side=="Right" THEN elbow:=POINT2(port.x_mm-stub,start.y_mm)
        ELSE IF lane.side=="Bottom" THEN elbow:=POINT2(start.x_mm,port.y_mm+stub) // 05B-F39
        ELSE IF lane.side=="Top" THEN elbow:=POINT2(start.x_mm,port.y_mm-stub)
        ELSE RAISE("ANNOTATION_SIDE_INVALID",view.id,["lane.side"],"Left/Right/Bottom/Top",lane.side,recipe.source_ids) ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF //05B-F39
        IF mode=="DiagonalOneElbow" THEN vertices:=points+[elbow,port] // 05B-F39
        ELSE IF mode=="OrthogonalTwoElbows" THEN
            second:=POINT2(elbow.x_mm,port.y_mm) IF lane.side IN["Left","Right"] ELSE POINT2(port.x_mm,elbow.y_mm)
            vertices:=points+[elbow,second,port] // 05B-F39
        ELSE RAISE("ANNOTATION_ROUTE_MODE_INVALID",view.id,["route_mode"],"DiagonalOneElbow/OrthogonalTwoElbows",mode,recipe.source_ids,["NR-22"]) ENDIF ENDIF
        vertices:=remove only consecutive identical points from vertices
        APPEND out {points:vertices,member_ids:SORT_UNIQUE(branch.hits.member_ids)}
    ENDFOR
    RETURN out
```

```text
MEASURE_ASSET_INK(asset,attributes,assets,rules):
    box:=asset.bounds # immutable glyph stroke envelope; ATTDEF specimen text must be excluded at S0 signature extraction
    FOR bound IN attributes:
        def:=UNIQUE(asset.attributes,tag=bound.tag) ELSE RAISE("ATTRIBUTE_DEF_MISSING",asset.name,[bound.tag],"exact ATTDEF",bound.tag)
        style:=UNIQUE(assets.font_styles,style_id=def.style_id) ELSE RAISE("FONT_STYLE_UNRESOLVED",asset.name,["style_id"],"approved style",def.style_id,asset.source_ids,["NR-16"])
        text:=DECODE_APPROVED_ENCODING(bound.text,style.encoding)  # Unicode/TCVN3/VNI tables from certified FontPolicy, no heuristic mojibake repair // 05B-F40
        text:=REPLACE_KNOWN_NATIVE_ESCAPES(text,{"%%c":"Ø","%%p":"±","%%d":"°"})
        IF contains unknown formatting escape THEN RAISE("TEXT_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED",asset.name,[bound.tag],"plain supported annotation text",bound.text,bound.source_ids,["NR-16"])
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        pen_x:=0;raw_ink:=EMPTY;previous:=null //05B-F25 origin/empty set definitions
        FOR codepoint IN NORMALIZE(text,style.normalization):
            glyph:=UNIQUE(assets.glyphs,glyph.style_id==def.style_id AND glyph.codepoint==codepoint)
                   ELSE RAISE("FONT_GLYPH_METRIC_MISSING",asset.name,[bound.tag],"measured glyph",codepoint,bound.source_ids,["NR-16"])
            factor:=def.height_mm/glyph.reference_height_mm //05B-F40
            IF previous IS NOT null THEN
                pair:=LOOKUP(assets.kerning,def.style_id,previous,codepoint)
                IF pair exists THEN pen_x:=pen_x+pair.adjustment_native_mm*factor*def.width_factor // 05B-F40
                ELSE IF style.kerning_mode IN["None","SparseComplete"] THEN KEEP pen_x
                ELSE RAISE("FONT_KERNING_METRIC_MISSING",asset.name,[bound.tag],"certified pair or complete sparse table",[previous,codepoint],bound.source_ids,["NR-16"]) ENDIF ENDIF
            ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            raw_ink:=UNION_BOUNDS(raw_ink,SCALE_XY(glyph.ink,factor*def.width_factor,factor)+POINT2(pen_x,0)) // 05B-F40
            pen_x:=pen_x+glyph.advance_native_mm*factor*def.width_factor;previous:=codepoint //05B-F40
        ENDFOR
        # justification uses real text advance and vertical baseline/ink, not character count.
        SWITCH def.horizontal_mode:
          Left: shift_x:=0 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
          Center: shift_x:=-pen_x/2 // 05B-F40
          Right: shift_x:=-pen_x
          DEFAULT: RAISE("TEXT_JUSTIFICATION_UNSUPPORTED",asset.name,["horizontal_mode"],"Left/Center/Right or source-verified extension",def.horizontal_mode,asset.source_ids,["NR-16"])
        ENDSWITCH
        SWITCH def.vertical_mode:
          Baseline: shift_y:=0 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
          Bottom: shift_y:=-raw_ink.min_y_mm
          Middle: shift_y:=-(raw_ink.min_y_mm+raw_ink.max_y_mm)/2 // 05B-F40
          Top: shift_y:=-raw_ink.max_y_mm
          DEFAULT: RAISE("TEXT_VERTICAL_MODE_UNSUPPORTED",asset.name,["vertical_mode"],"known native mode",def.vertical_mode,asset.source_ids,["NR-16"])
        ENDSWITCH //05B-F40
        anchor:=def.insertion IF def.horizontal_mode=="Left" AND def.vertical_mode=="Baseline" ELSE def.alignment
        attr_box:=ROTATE_BOUNDS(raw_ink+POINT2(shift_x,shift_y),def.rotation_rad)+XY(anchor) // 05B-F40
        box:=UNION_BOUNDS(box,attr_box)
    ENDFOR
    RETURN box //05B-F42; S10 save/reopen actual native ink comparison can still fail, never guessed Passed
```

```text
MAKE_DIMENSIONS(view,e,p,rules):
    out:=[];recipe:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-22",e.profile,view.role,"Dimensions")
    # Semantic subject table: BodyClearX=(−L/2,0,0)..(+L/2,0,0);
    # BodyClearY=(0,−B/2,0)..(0,+B/2,0);BodyClearH=(0,0,0)..(0,0,H).
    # BodyOuterX/Y: replace half span by half span+wall; BaseOuter by +baseExpansion;
    # PadOuter by +padExpansion only if pad>0. BaseThickness:BaseBottom..BaseTop;
    # RoofThickness:RoofBottom..RoofTop;NeckHeight:NeckBottom..NeckTop;
    # NeckClear/OuterX/Y: neck center±clear/2 (outer adds neck wall);
    # OwnerFrameH:FrameBottom..FrameTop. PanelX/Y/thickness:exact Panel component;
    # Pipe clear/invert:exact Opening.inner and invert_mm;Catch:openW/H,clearDepth/H,wall/base.
    FOR subject_key IN recipe.parameters WHERE key starts "dimension_subject.":
        key:=subject_key.text;subject:=EXACT_SUBJECT_FROM_TABLE(key,e,p,view)
        IF subject inactive by explicit input THEN CONTINUE ELSE
            a:=PROJECT(subject.world_start,subject.projection_frame);b:=PROJECT(subject.world_end,subject.projection_frame)
            axis:=subject.axis;value:=abs(b.x_mm-a.x_mm) IF axis=="X" ELSE abs(b.y_mm-a.y_mm)
            IF abs(value-subject.expected_mm)>rules.length_tolerance_mm THEN RAISE("DIM_PROJECTION_NOT_TRUE_SIZE",subject.id,[key],subject.expected_mm,value,subject.sources) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF //05B-F43
            lane:=PARAM(recipe,"dimension_lane_paper_mm."+key,"Number","paper_mm")*view.scale // 05B-F43
            prefix:=FIELD_TEXT(e,"WallDimPrefix") IF subject.component=="Wall" ELSE FIELD_TEXT(e,"NeckPrefix") IF subject.component=="Neck" ELSE ""
            text:=prefix+FORMAT_VALUE(value,"mm",rules,"Dimension") // 05B-F43
            ink:=NATIVE_DIM_INK_FROM_STYLE(a,b,lane,text,assets,rules)
            APPEND out DimensionV2(ENCODE(view.id,key),view.id,subject.id,a,b,axis,value,prefix,text,lane,ink,subject.sources)
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN out

MAKE_CAO_DO_MATERIAL_TITLE(view,e,p,assets,rules):
    labels:=[];routes:=[]
    FOR role IN ["ViewTitle","BaseTopElevation","FinishedCoverTopElevation","PipeInvertElevation","Material"]:
        r:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-22",e.profile,view.role+"/"+role,"Labels") // 05B-F43
        subjects:=LABEL_SUBJECTS_FOR_VIEW(role,view,e,p,g,r)
        FOR subject IN subjects:
            IF role contains Elevation THEN
                IF e.elevation_mode=="Absolute" THEN text:=FORMAT_VALUE(e.base_elevation_m+subject.z_mm/1000,"m",rules,"Elevation") // 05B-F01
                ELSE
                    key:="Elevation.D" IF subject.surface=="BaseTop" ELSE "Elevation.E" IF subject.surface=="FinishedCoverTop" ELSE {T1:"Elevation.F",T2:"Elevation.G",T3:"Elevation.H",T4:"Elevation.I"}[subject.wall]
                    text:=FIELD_TEXT(e,key)
                ENDIF //05B-F01/F28/F44
            ELSE IF role=="Material" THEN
                key:=EXACT_MATERIAL_FIELD(subject.material_role,e,rules)
                text:=FIELD_TEXT(e,key) # not M75/M250 hardcoded // 05B-F43
            ELSE text:=PARAM(r,"title_literal","Text","none") ENDIF ENDIF
            asset_name:=PARAM(r,"asset."+role,"Text","none");asset:=EXACT_ASSET(assets,asset_name) // 05B-F43
            # Tag names are exact from this asset's TagBinding recipe; every required ATTDEF receives text or explicit literal.
            attrs:=BIND_LABEL_TAGS(asset,role,text,subject,r,e)
            candidate:=ALLOCATE_SINGLE_LABEL(subject,asset,attrs,view,r,existing_ink=labels+dimensions) // 05B-F43
            APPEND labels candidate.label;APPEND_ALL routes candidate.routes
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    RETURN labels,routes

MAKE_HATCH_INTENTS(view,regions,e,assets,rules):
    out:=[];r:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-17",e.profile,view.role,"Hatch")
    FOR region IN regions WHERE region.view_id==view.id:
        requested_key:=PARAM(r,"field_for_material."+region.material_id,"Text","none") // 05B-F43
        requested:=FIELD_TEXT(e,requested_key)
        entries:=exact CF.Data name/scale pairs WHERE name==requested // 05B-F43
        IF entries.Count==1 THEN chosen:=entries[0] ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            fallback:=OPTIONAL_PARAM(r,"default_pattern_exact_name","Text","none")
            IF fallback IS null THEN RAISE("HATCH_PATTERN_BINDING_MISSING",region.id,[requested_key],requested,"not in catalog; no named default",region.component_ids,["NR-17"])
            ELSE chosen:=UNIQUE(exact catalog,name=fallback) ELSE RAISE("HATCH_DEFAULT_NOT_FOUND",region.id,["default_pattern_exact_name"],fallback,"missing",r.source_ids,["NR-17"]) ENDIF
        ENDIF
        factor:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"scale_expr","Text","none"),{"catalog_scale":chosen.scale,"S":view.scale},{}).value
        angle:=PARAM(r,"angle_rad","Number","rad");layer:=PARAM(r,"layer_id","Text","none")
        IF factor<=0 OR chosen.scale<=0 THEN RAISE("HATCH_SCALE_INVALID",region.id,["pattern_scale"],">0",factor,r.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        APPEND out HatchV2(ENCODE(view.id,region.id,chosen.name),view.id,region.id,chosen.name,factor,angle,layer,chosen.sources+r.source_ids)
        # Boundary stays projection.regions[region.id].loops; do not create a bounding rectangle hatch.
    ENDFOR
    RETURN out

FORMAT_VALUE(value,unit,rules,role):
    IF !IS_FINITE(value) THEN RAISE("FORMAT_NONFINITE",role,["value"],"finite",value) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    # Approved NR13 specifies DAI/legs mm0;TDAI m2;KL kg2;AwayFromZero. CT/DIM precision requires named role entry.
    key:=role+"/"+unit;r:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-13",effective.profile,"Display","Format") // 05B-F43
    decimals:=EXACT_INT(PARAM(r,"decimals."+key,"Number","dimensionless")) // 05B-F43
    midpoint:=PARAM(r,"midpoint."+key,"Text","none") // 05B-F43
    culture:=PARAM(r,"culture","Text","none");trailing:=PARAM(r,"trailing_zeros."+key,"Bool","none") // 05B-F43
    IF midpoint!="AwayFromZero" AND role IN["DAI","TDAI","KL","Leg"] THEN RAISE("ROUNDING_APPROVAL_CONFLICT",key,["midpoint"],"AwayFromZero",midpoint,r.source_ids,["NR-13"])
    ELSE rounded:=ROUND_DECIMAL(value,decimals,midpoint);RETURN FORMAT_DECIMAL(rounded,decimals,culture,trailing) ENDIF //05B-F44
```

```text
PARSE_FIELD(raw,binding,active):
    p:=ParsedFieldV2(field_key=binding.field,sheet=raw.sheet,address=raw.address,row_index=raw.main_or_catalog_row,
       active=active,inactive_reason=null,kind=binding.parse_kind,number=null,integer=null,text=null,flag=null,
       tuple_mm=[],diameter_mm=null,pitch_mm=null,length_mm=null,count=null,tokens=[],unit=binding.unit,source_ids=[raw.source_id])
    IF !active THEN RAISE("PARSE_INACTIVE_CALL",raw.field_key,[raw.address],"parse only active fields",false,p.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF raw.kind=="Formula" THEN
        IF !raw.cache_verified OR raw.cache_kind IN["Blank","Error"] THEN RAISE("FORMULA_CACHE_UNVERIFIED",raw.field_key,[raw.address],"matching recalculation receipt",raw.cache_text,p.source_ids)
        ELSE token:=raw.cache_text;kind:=raw.cache_kind ENDIF
    ELSE token:=raw lexical value;kind:=raw.kind ENDIF
    IF kind=="Error" THEN RAISE("EXCEL_CELL_ERROR",raw.field_key,[raw.address],"valid value",token,p.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF token blank AND binding.blank_allowed THEN p.text:=null;RETURN p ELSE
        IF token blank THEN RAISE("ACTIVE_FIELD_BLANK",raw.field_key,[raw.address],binding.parse_kind,"blank",p.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDIF
    # NUM: OOXML numeric uses invariant decimal; text numeric uses job.numeric_culture decimal separator;
    # reject thousands separators, exponent overflow, mixed decimal marks, NaN/Infinity. No locale inference.
    SWITCH binding.parse_kind:
      Number: p.number:=NUM(token,job.numeric_culture);CHECK_RANGE(p.number,binding.min_inclusive,binding.strict_positive,p)
      Integer: value:=NUM(token,job.numeric_culture);IF value!=floor(value) OR value outside Int32 THEN RAISE("INTEGER_NOT_EXACT",p.field_key,[p.address],"Int32",token,p.source_ids) ELSE p.integer:=int(value);CHECK_RANGE(value,binding.min_inclusive,binding.strict_positive,p) ENDIF
      Bool: IF token IN["Có",true] THEN p.flag:=true ELSE IF token IN["Không",false] THEN p.flag:=false ELSE RAISE("BOOL_LITERAL_INVALID",p.field_key,[p.address],"Có/Không",token,p.source_ids) ENDIF ENDIF // 05B-F47
      Text: p.text:=original text;IF binding.enum_values nonempty AND token NOT IN binding.enum_values THEN RAISE("ENUM_LITERAL_INVALID",p.field_key,[p.address],binding.enum_values,token,p.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
      Tuple: parts:=SPLIT_EXACT_DIMENSION_SEPARATORS(token,["x","X","×"]);IF parts.Count!=binding.arity THEN RAISE("TUPLE_ARITY_INVALID",p.field_key,[p.address],binding.arity,parts.Count,p.source_ids) ELSE p.tuple_mm:=[NUM(x,job.numeric_culture) FOR x IN parts];FOR v IN p.tuple_mm:CHECK_RANGE(v,binding.min_inclusive,binding.strict_positive,p) ENDFOR ENDIF
      Mesh: m:=FULL_REGEX(token,"(?i)^D([0-9]+)A([0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)?)$");IF no match THEN RAISE("MESH_SYNTAX",p.field_key,[p.address],"D<int>A<positive number>",token,p.source_ids) ELSE p.diameter_mm:=EXACT_INT(m[1]);p.pitch_mm:=NUM(m[2],job.numeric_culture);REQUIRE_POSITIVE(p.diameter_mm,p.pitch_mm,p) ENDIF // 05B-F47
      Anchor: IF token=="0" OR token numeric0 THEN p.kind:="Anchor";p.count:=0 ELSE m:=FULL_REGEX(token,"(?i)^D([0-9]+)A([0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)?)L([0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)?)$");IF no match THEN RAISE("ANCHOR_SYNTAX",p.field_key,[p.address],"0 or DdAaLl",token,p.source_ids) ELSE p.diameter_mm:=EXACT_INT(m[1]);p.pitch_mm:=NUM(m[2]);p.length_mm:=NUM(m[3]);REQUIRE_POSITIVE(p.diameter_mm,p.pitch_mm,p.length_mm,p) ENDIF ENDIF // 05B-F47
      Counted: m:=FULL_REGEX(token,"(?i)^([0-9]+)D([0-9]+)$");IF no match THEN RAISE("COUNTED_BAR_SYNTAX",p.field_key,[p.address],"nDd",token,p.source_ids) ELSE p.count:=EXACT_INT(m[1]);p.diameter_mm:=EXACT_INT(m[2]);IF p.count NOT IN binding.allowed_counts OR (p.count>0 AND p.diameter_mm<=0) THEN RAISE("COUNTED_BAR_RANGE",p.field_key,[p.address],binding.allowed_counts,token,p.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF ENDIF // 05B-F47
      TokenSet: p.tokens:=characters of invariant token;IF any char NOT IN["1","2","3"] OR duplicate THEN RAISE("ANGLE_POSITION_INVALID",p.field_key,[p.address],"distinct1/2/3",token,p.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F47
      DEFAULT: RAISE("FIELD_PARSER_MISSING",p.field_key,[p.address],"closed parser kind",binding.parse_kind,p.source_ids)
    ENDSWITCH
    RETURN p //05B-F47; aliases use same SourceId, never fuzzy key lookup

INPUT_ACTIVITY(key,parsed,profile,request):
    # First matched group wins; all identifiers below are literal schema keys. Domain OFF differs from unsupported.
    IF key belongs catalog UI helper Catalog.Selection.Stage1/Stage2 THEN RETURN(false,"UI_HELPER_NOT_PHYSICAL") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key==BaseElevationM THEN RETURN(elevation mode Absolute,"ABSOLUTE_MODE") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key IN[NeckOuterMesh,NeckInnerMesh,HookPattern.I,HookPattern.J,Annotation.Prefix.I,Annotation.Prefix.J,NeckSpacingDelta,NeckDiaStepDown] THEN RETURN(NeckHeight>0 AND NeckStructure==BTCT,"NECK_REINFORCED") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF key starts Neck AND key NOT IN[NeckHeight,NeckThickness,NeckSize,NeckPosition] THEN RETURN(NeckHeight>0,"NECK_HEIGHT_POSITIVE") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF key IN[DowelSpec,DowelLength,DowelHoleDia] THEN RETURN(profile!=GaThamLienKhoi AND HasDowel,"DOWEL_ON") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key==LiftingSize THEN RETURN(profile!=GaThamLienKhoi AND LiftingSpec.count>0,"ROOF_LIFTING_ON") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF key==NeckHaunchSize THEN RETURN(NeckHeight>0 AND NeckHaunchFlag,"NECK_SEAT_ON") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF key==CoverHaunchSize THEN RETURN(COVER_KIND_EXACT(CoverType)==Purchased AND CoverHaunchFlag,"PURCHASED_COLLAR_ON") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key IN[Panel.TieRebar,Panel.TieShape] THEN RETURN(CoverType==BTCT AND Panel.TopLayerBarDiameter>0,"PANEL_TWO_LAYERS") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF key IN[CoverHaunchFlag] THEN RETURN(COVER_KIND_EXACT(CoverType)==Purchased,"PURCHASED_COLLAR_FLAG") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key==CoverHeight THEN RETURN(COVER_KIND_EXACT(CoverType) IN[Purchased,Panel],"COVER_INSTALL_OR_PANEL_HEIGHT") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key starts Panel. OR key IN[PanelCount,PanelGap,PanelDirection,CoverHatch] THEN RETURN(CoverType==BTCT,"DESIGNED_PANEL") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key==CoverBlock THEN RETURN(COVER_KIND_EXACT(CoverType)==Purchased,"PURCHASED_COVER") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key starts Catch. THEN RETURN(profile==GaThamThuNapRoi AND (key!=Catch.M OR Catch.L==BTCT),"CATCH_PROFILE_AND_STEEL") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key IN[AnglePosition,Anchor] THEN RETURN(NeckHeight>0 AND NeckHaunchFlag AND AngleCode!="Không","NECK_ANGLE_ON") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF key IN[Ladder.D,Ladder.E,Ladder.F,Ladder.G] THEN RETURN(Ladder.C!="Không","LADDER_ON") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key IN[Pipe.E,Pipe.F,Pipe.G,Pipe.H] THEN RETURN(Pipe.D>0 AND at least one pipe,"PIPE_REINFORCEMENT_ON") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF key IN[RoofRebar.D,RoofRebar.E,RoofRebar.F,RoofRebar.G] THEN RETURN(RoofRebar.C>0,"ROOF_REINFORCEMENT_ON") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF key==HookMultiple THEN RETURN(HookMode=="Theo ĐK","HOOK_BY_DIAMETER") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key starts Hatch. THEN RETURN(key is referenced by active material role mapping,"HATCH_ROLE_USED") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF key starts Material. THEN RETURN(any required component uses mapped material,"MATERIAL_USED") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    RETURN(true,null) # remaining applicable source fields are mandatory; parser reports unsupported/blank rather than guessing

SOLVE_DATUM_GRAPH(equations,anchor,rules):
    values:map<string,double>:={"ReferenceZero":0};sources:map<string,string[]>:={"ReferenceZero":[]} // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    queue:Queue<string>:=["ReferenceZero"]
    WHILE queue not empty:
        id:=DEQUEUE(queue)
        FOR eq IN equations WHERE eq.surface_a==id OR eq.surface_b==id:
            other:=eq.surface_a IF eq.surface_b==id ELSE eq.surface_b
            candidate:=values[id]+eq.delta_mm IF eq.surface_b==id ELSE values[id]-eq.delta_mm // 05B-F47
            IF other IN values THEN
                IF abs(values[other]-candidate)>rules.length_tolerance_mm THEN RAISE("DATUM_EQUATIONS_CONTRADICT",other,[eq.surface_a,eq.surface_b],values[other],candidate,eq.source_ids,["NR-23"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            ELSE values[other]:=candidate;sources[other]:=DISTINCT(sources[id]+eq.source_ids);ENQUEUE(queue,other) ENDIF // 05B-F47
        ENDFOR
    ENDWHILE
    FOR required_id IN required surfaces for active profile/components:
        IF required_id NOT IN values THEN RAISE("DATUM_GRAPH_DISCONNECTED",required_id,[required_id],"connected to BaseTop",equations,[],["NR-23"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN [DatumV2(surface_id=id,z_mm=values[id],symbol=SYMBOL_FOR_SURFACE(id,parsed),source_ids=sources[id]) FOR id IN SORT(values.keys) IF id!="ReferenceZero"] //05B-F28

          source_ids=DISTINCT(product.source_ids+r.source_ids+SOURCE_IDS(parsed,["PanelCount","PanelDirection","PanelGap","CoverHeight","NeckHaunchSize"])),support_mode=mode)

MAKE_CATCH_SPEC(parsed,e,product,rules):

                    face=PARAM(row.rule,"face."+row.key,"Text","none") IF row.face=="SourceBound" ELSE row.face,layer=PARAM(row.rule,"layer."+row.key,"Text","none") IF row.layer=="SourceBound" ELSE row.layer,direction=PARAM(row.rule,"direction."+row.key,"Text","none") IF row.direction=="SourceBound" ELSE row.direction,family=row.family,active=true,suppression_reason=null,

                    diameter_step_down=INTEGER(parsed,row.step_down_key) IF row.step_down_key IS NOT null ELSE 0, // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    hook_pattern=TEXT(parsed,row.hook_key) IF row.hook_key IS NOT null ELSE null,
```

```text
    ELSE IF role starts "Wall/" THEN wf:=WALL_FRAME(exact wall,e.clear_x_mm,e.clear_y_mm,0);u:=-wf.axis_u;v:=wf.normal;n:=wf.axis_v;origin:=wf.origin // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE RAISE("VIEW_FRAME_ROLE_MISSING",id,["role"],"declared view role",role) ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF

        ELSE mode:="TrueSection" IF role IN["AA","BB","NeckAA","NeckBB","PanelAA","PanelBB","Catch11","Catch22"] ELSE "Projection" ENDIF
        IF role IN["NeckAA","PanelAA"] THEN o.x_mm:=e.neck_center.x_mm ELSE IF role IN["NeckBB","PanelBB"] THEN o.y_mm:=e.neck_center.y_mm ELSE NO_OP ENDIF ENDIF
        IF role starts Catch THEN o,u,v,n:=CATCH_VIEW_BASIS(role,e.catch,g) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF

PROJECT_ANALYTIC_CURVE(c,frame,view):
    a:=PROJECT(c.start,frame);b:=PROJECT(c.end,frame)
    IF c.kind=="Line" THEN
        IF distance(a,b)<=rules.length_tolerance_mm THEN RETURN [] # end-on steel point represented by real target node
        ELSE RETURN [ProjectedCurveV2(ENCODE(view.id,c.id),view.id,c.id,null,"Line",a,b,null,null,null,"Visible","Steel",frame.id)] ENDIF
    ELSE IF c.kind=="Arc" THEN
        dotn:=abs(dot(c.normal,frame.normal))
        IF abs(dotn-1)<=rules.basis_tolerance THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            center:=PROJECT(c.center,frame);sign:=sign(dot(c.normal,frame.normal))*frame.handedness // 05B-F38
            RETURN [ProjectedCurveV2(ENCODE(view.id,c.id),view.id,c.id,null,"Arc",a,b,center,c.radius_mm,c.sweep_rad*sign,"Visible","Steel",frame.id)]
        ELSE IF dotn<=rules.basis_tolerance THEN
            ts:=[0,1]+all parameters where derivative of projected arc scalar coordinate=0 // 05B-F38
            points:=[PROJECT(CURVE_POINT(c,t),frame) FOR t IN SORT_UNIQUE(ts)]
            RETURN nonzero line pieces joining consecutive points, IDs ENCODE(view.id,c.id,piece_index), source_id=c.id,
                   group_id=null,center=null,radius_mm=null,sweep_rad=null,visibility="Visible",role="Steel",projection_frame_id=frame.id
        ELSE RAISE("OBLIQUE_ARC_PROJECTION_UNSUPPORTED",c.id,["normal","view.frame.normal"],"parallel or edge-on analytic circle",dotn,[],["NR-20"]) ENDIF ENDIF
    ELSE RAISE("PROJECTION_CURVE_KIND_INVALID",c.id,["kind"],"Line/Arc",c.kind) ENDIF ENDIF //05B-F38

DOWEL_PAIRS_TO_OPENINGS(pairs,g,e):
    out:=[]
    FOR pair IN pairs:
        joint:=UNIQUE(g.joints,id=pair.joint_id)

        f:=FRAME(ENCODE(pair.hole_id,"Plane"),POINT(pair.center.x_mm,pair.center.y_mm,pair.hole_z_min_mm),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(0,0,1)) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        circle:=CIRCLE_LOOP(ENCODE(pair.hole_id,"Profile"),POINT(0,0,0),pair.hole_diameter_mm/2,"Inner") // 05B-F38
        APPEND out OpeningV2(pair.hole_id,"DowelHole",hosts.ids,f,[circle],[],[circle],0, // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
              pair.hole_z_max_mm-pair.hole_z_min_mm,null,null,pair.source_ids)

EMIT_SOURCE_PRODUCT_REFERENCE(out,product,view,physical_scale):
    IF view.role in plan roles THEN name:=product.plan_asset
    ELSE IF view.role in AA roles THEN name:=product.section_aa_asset
    ELSE IF view.role in BB roles THEN name:=product.section_bb_asset
    ELSE RETURN ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
    p:=UNIQUE(assets.products,id=product.contract_id)

        PROJECT(product.anchor,view.frame),rotation,physical_scale,physical_scale,product.source_ids)
    IF physical_scale!=1 THEN RAISE("PRODUCT_PHYSICAL_SCALE_FORBIDDEN",product.id,["scale_x","scale_y"],1,physical_scale,product.source_ids,["NR-09"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default

SIDE_OPENING_PROFILE(opening,frame):
    # Orthogonal extrusion silhouette: project cap boundary curves plus extrusion generators at support extrema.
    part:=OPENING_AS_EXTRUSION(opening);curves:=[]
    FOR depth IN[part.depth_min_mm,part.depth_max_mm]:
        FOR c IN part.loops.curves:APPEND_ALL curves PROJECT_ANALYTIC_CURVE(TRANSFORM_CURVE(c,part.frame,depth),frame,current_view) ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    FOR each exact profile support extremum in projected horizontal/vertical direction:
        APPEND curves LINE(project WORLD(part.frame,u,v,depth_min),project WORLD(part.frame,u,v,depth_max))
    ENDFOR
    RETURN ANALYTIC_ENVELOPE(curves) # split at intersections, keep outermost directed boundary with winding; H06
```

```text
FLATTEN_NATIVE_INTENTS(input):
    out:=[]
    FOR frame IN input.sheet.frames:
        EMIT frame INSERT(frame.frame_asset,request.anchor.xy+frame.origin,frame.scale_denominator/100,0),semantic_id=frame.id // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        FOR placement IN frame.placements:
            T(point):=request.anchor.xy+placement.translation+ROTATE_2D(point,placement.rotation_rad) //05B-F26/F41
            FOR c IN projection.curves WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:
                EMIT Line(T(c.start),T(c.end)) IF c.kind==Line ELSE Arc(T(c.center),c.radius_mm,c.start_angle+placement.rotation_rad,c.sweep_rad),semantic_id=c.id
            ENDFOR
            FOR ref IN projection.native_references WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:
                EMIT INSERT(ref.asset_name,T(ref.insertion),ref.scale_x,ref.scale_y,ref.rotation_rad+placement.rotation_rad,attributes=[]),semantic_id=ref.id
            ENDFOR
            FOR label IN annotations.labels WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:
                EMIT INSERT(label.asset_name,T(label.insertion),label.asset_scale,label.asset_scale,label.rotation_rad+placement.rotation_rad,attributes=label.attributes),semantic_id=label.id
            ENDFOR
            FOR route IN annotations.routes WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:EMIT open LWPOLYLINE(vertices=T(each route.points),bulges=0),semantic_id=route.id ENDFOR // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            FOR tick IN annotations.ticks WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:EMIT INSERT(tick.asset_name,T(tick.point),tick.scale,tick.scale,placement.rotation_rad,[]),semantic_id=tick.id ENDFOR
            FOR dim IN annotations.dimensions WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:EMIT native RotatedDimension(XLine1Point=T(dim.start),XLine2Point=T(dim.end),rotation=0 IF dim.axis==X ELSE pi/2 plus placement.rotation_rad,DimensionText=dim.prefix+"<>",DimLinePoint=T(point on dim.lane_mm),measured_expected=dim.measured_mm),semantic_id=dim.id ENDFOR // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            FOR hatch IN annotations.hatches WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:EMIT native Hatch(exact pattern,scale,angle,layer,all outer+inner loops transformed with T),semantic_id=hatch.id ENDFOR
            FOR row IN schedules.rows WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:EMIT INSERT(row.native_asset,T(row.insertion),row.scale,row.scale,placement.rotation_rad,row.attributes),semantic_id=row.id ENDFOR
            FOR cap IN schedules.captions WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:EMIT INSERT fixed glyph cap.glyph_asset at T(cap.insertion) scale cap.asset_scale; EMIT sourced role dimensions/caption text;EMIT Line(T(cap.underline_start),T(cap.underline_end)); semantic IDs ENCODE(cap.group_id,role) ENDFOR
            FOR heading IN schedules.headings WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:EMIT INSERT(heading.native_asset,T(heading.insertion),heading.asset_scale,heading.asset_scale,placement.rotation_rad,heading.attributes),semantic_id=heading.id ENDFOR
            FOR summary IN schedules.summaries WHERE view_id==placement.view_id:EMIT INSERT(summary.native_asset,T(summary.insertion),summary.asset_scale,summary.asset_scale,placement.rotation_rad,summary.attributes),semantic_id=summary.id ENDFOR
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    RETURN out

WRITE_EXACT_INTENT(intent,tx):
    SWITCH intent.kind:
      Line: create native Line(start,end)
      Arc: create native Arc(center,normal,radius,start_angle,end_angle); preserve directed sweep via normal/orientation
      LWPOLYLINE: create vertices/widths/bulges exactly; set Closed=intent.closed
```

### H17-BATCH-ENTRY-AND-RETRY

```text
GENERATE_BATCH(request:RequestV2,context_factory,ports) -> BatchV2:
    selected:=request.jobs ordered as request then targets ordered as request;results:=[];pages:=[]
    # Validate request before CAD mutation. One healthy shared plot host for the successful batch.
    session:=ports.plot.OpenHealthySession(request.plot_profile_id)
    FOR target IN selected:
        ctx:=context_factory(request,target,prior_row_results=results,prior_plot_pages=pages,plot_session_id=session.id)
        IF cancellation requested THEN
            APPEND results RowVerdictV2(target.job_id,target.row_index,target.manhole_id,"Cancelled",[],[],[explicit RUN_CANCELLED diagnostic])
            CONTINUE # remaining rows also receive a receipt; no silent break
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        attempts:=APPROVED_FINITE_SCALE_LIST for target if Auto ELSE [request.body_scale]
        FOR S IN attempts in declared ascending source order:
            row_request:=request with only body/panel requested denominator replaced for declared retry scope // 05B-F41
            state:=EntryStateV2(ctx,row_request)
            FOR stage IN[S0,S1,S2,S3,S4,S5,S6,S7,S8,S9,S10,S11]:
                result:=RUN_STAGE(stage,state,stage.Execute)
                IF result is FailureV2 THEN BREAK stage loop ELSE state:=result ENDIF
            ENDFOR
            IF failure.code=="LAYOUT_REBUILD_AT_SCALE" AND no stage S10 committed THEN
                record attempt receipt;CONTINUE scale loop # rebuild pure stages with new immutable request; not mutate S7 carry payload
            ELSE BREAK scale loop ENDIF
        ENDFOR
        IF result is FailureV2 THEN
            APPEND results RowVerdictV2(target.job_id,target.row_index,target.manhole_id,
               "Cancelled" IF result.diagnostic.code==RUN_CANCELLED ELSE "Blocked" IF binding/input invalid ELSE "Failed",
               [],[],[result.diagnostic])
            IF native failure after commit THEN attach recovery artifact;do not call rolled back ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        ELSE results:=state.batch.rows;pages:=state.batch.pages ENDIF
        IF session unhealthy THEN close session with transcript;mark all remaining selected rows NotRun with HOST_UNHEALTHY diagnostic;BREAK target loop ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    close healthy session;assert exactly one final RowVerdict for each selected identity
    status:="Complete" IF every row Complete ELSE "Partial"
    result:=BatchV2(results,pages,status,run directory+"/delivery-manifest.json",request.target_dwg_path IF actual saved aggregate exists ELSE null,SHA256(actual aggregate saved bytes) IF exists ELSE null) // 05B-F41
    persist actual result even when no row reaches S11;RETURN result
    # Failure path is a documented root orchestration result, not fake Ready S11. Stage success-chain I/O remains exact.
```

### H18-OFFSET-DISTANCE-AND-CLOSED-OPERATIONS

```text
OFFSET_CONTOUR(loops,distance_mm,side):
    IF distance_mm<0 OR side NOT IN["Outer","Inner"] THEN RAISE("OFFSET_ARGUMENT_INVALID",null,["distance_mm","side"],"d>=0,Outer/Inner",[distance_mm,side]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF distance_mm==0 THEN RETURN immutable copy of loops ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    signed_d:=distance_mm IF side=="Outer" ELSE -distance_mm
    # Normalize to occupied-left boundary using winding, not merely Loop.role string.
    loops:=REGION_BOOLEAN([loops],"Union");candidates:=[]
    FOR loop IN loops:
        FOR c IN loop.curves:
            IF c.kind=="Line" THEN
                t:=normalize(c.end-c.start);right:=(t.y,-t.x)
                APPEND candidates LINE(c.id+"/offset",c.start+signed_d*right,c.end+signed_d*right,c.role)
            ELSE
                r:=c.radius_mm+sign(c.sweep_rad)*signed_d // 05B-F35
                IF r<=0 THEN CONTINUE # collapsed arc contributes no candidate; arrangement decides remaining region // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                ELSE APPEND candidates ARC(c.id+"/offset",c.center+r*normalize(c.start-c.center),c.center+r*normalize(c.end-c.center),c.center,c.normal,r,c.sweep_rad,c.role) ENDIF
            ENDIF //05B-F36
            # Full radius-d vertex circles are candidates. Classification removes the unused sectors exactly.
            APPEND candidates CIRCLE_LOOP(ENCODE(c.id,"OffsetVertex"),c.end,abs(signed_d),"Outer").curves
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    pieces:=SPLIT_ALL_AT_ANALYTIC_INTERSECTIONS(candidates)
    # Keep boundary separating signed-distance(original occupied region)>=-signed_d from its complement.
    # For original interior signed distance positive; dilation accepts outside distance<=d, erosion requires inside distance>=d.
    result:=BOUNDARY_OF_CLASSIFIED_ARRANGEMENT(pieces,predicate=SIGNED_DISTANCE_2D(point,loops)>=-signed_d)
    RETURN result # empty erosion is explicit; consumer raises NO_CLEAR_SPAN instead of a fake single station

SIGNED_DISTANCE_2D(p,loops):
    d:=+infinity // 05B-F36
    FOR c IN loops.curves:
        IF c.kind=="Line" THEN t:=CLAMP(dot(p-c.start,c.end-c.start)/dot(c.end-c.start,c.end-c.start),0,1);q:=c.start+t*(c.end-c.start) // 05B-F36
        ELSE
            theta:=atan2(p.y-c.center.y,p.x-c.center.x)
            q:=c.center+c.radius_mm*(cos(theta),sin(theta)) IF theta in c signed sweep ELSE nearest of c.start,c.end // 05B-F35
        ENDIF
        d:=min(d,distance(p,q)) // 05B-F36
    ENDFOR
    RETURN d IF INSIDE_REGION(p,loops) ELSE -d //05B-F31/F36

EXPOSED_POLYHEDRAL_CSG_FACES(parts):
    faces:=all cap/side polygon faces from EXTRUSION_POLYHEDRON_FACES(each part) // 05B-F36
    out:=[]
    FOR face IN faces:
        cells:=[face.polygon]
        FOR plane IN all other faces.support_planes:
            next:=[]
            FOR cell IN cells:
                # Split convex polygon by n·x+d=0, intersections t=da/(da-db), keep both nonempty sides.
                APPEND_ALL next SPLIT_CONVEX_POLYGON_BY_PLANE(cell,plane)
            ENDFOR
            cells:=next
        ENDFOR
        FOR cell IN cells:
            sample:=mean of cell vertices # convex cell interior, mathematical construction F25
            left,right:=LIMITED_MEMBERSHIP(sample,face.normal,parts)
            IF left==right THEN CONTINUE ELSE APPEND out cell oriented outward of occupied side ENDIF
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    RETURN geometric duplicate cells removed by exact support+boundary identity under NR18 topology tolerance

MIN_DISTANCE_POINT_TO_FACE_POLYGONS(p,faces):
    distances:=[]
    FOR face IN faces:
        h:=dot(p-face.origin,face.normal);q:=p-h*face.normal // 05B-F36
        IF q inside closed face polygon THEN APPEND distances abs(h) ELSE
            FOR edge IN face.boundary:
                t:=CLAMP(dot(p-edge.start,edge.end-edge.start)/dot(edge.end-edge.start,edge.end-edge.start),0,1) // 05B-F36
                APPEND distances distance(p,edge.start+t*(edge.end-edge.start))
            ENDFOR
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    IF distances empty THEN RAISE("SUPPORT_BOUNDARY_EMPTY",null,["faces"],">0",0) ELSE RETURN min(distances) ENDIF //05B-F36

NATIVE_DIM_INK_FROM_STYLE(a,b,lane,text,assets,rules):
    style:=exact approved DIMSTYLE semantic role in template manifest
    IF style or actual font metrics missing THEN RAISE("DIMSTYLE_METRICS_MISSING",null,["dimstyle"],"actual native style metrics","missing",[],["NR-16"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    arrows:=native arrow block stroke bounds placed at both measured ends by style arrow sizes and current S
    text_ink:=MEASURE_TEXT_GLYPHS(text,style.text_style,style.text_height,style.width_factor,assets)
    line_ink:=STROKE_BOUNDS(dimension/extension segments from style offsets and lane,style.lineweight) // 05B-F36
    RETURN UNION_BOUNDS(arrows,text_ink placed using style text alignment,line_ink) //05B-F40/F42

NEW_FRAME(role,page,S,asset,recipe,e):
    if S<=0 THEN RAISE("FRAME_SCALE_INVALID",e.id,["S"],">0",S) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default

    gap:=PARAM(recipe,"page_gap_paper_mm","Number","paper_mm")*S // 05B-F36
    native_window:=(asset.bounds-XY(asset.base_point))*(S/100) // 05B-F36
    origin:=POINT2(0,0) IF out.frames empty ELSE POINT2(max(out.frames.window.max_x_mm)+gap-native_window.min_x_mm,0) // 05B-F36
    window:=native_window+origin // 05B-F36
    content:=Bounds2V2(PARAM(recipe,"content_min_x_paper_mm."+role,"Number","paper_mm")*S, // 05B-F36
        PARAM(recipe,"content_min_y_paper_mm."+role,"Number","paper_mm")*S,
        PARAM(recipe,"content_max_x_paper_mm."+role,"Number","paper_mm")*S,
        PARAM(recipe,"content_max_y_paper_mm."+role,"Number","paper_mm")*S)
    content:=content+origin // 05B-F36
    IF !CONTAINS_BOUNDS(window,content,0) THEN RAISE("FRAME_CONTENT_OUTSIDE_WINDOW",e.id,["content"],window,content,recipe.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    RETURN SheetFrameV2(ENCODE(e.id,role,page),e.id,role,page,S,asset.name,window,content,[],origin) //05B-F41

PHYSICAL_OWNER_BUCKET(group,g,rules):

CHECK_RESOURCE_COUNT(count,maximum,subject):

    IF candidates.Count!=1 THEN RAISE("SHAPE_RECIPE_BINDING_MISSING",id,["shape_recipe_id"],"one exact scoped recipe",candidates.Count,[],["NR-02","NR-04","NR-08"]) ELSE r,s:=candidates[0];RULE(rules.entries,r.id,profile,component,s.shape_kind);RETURN s ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
```

```text
    ELSE RETURN PARAM(RULE(entries,"NR-17",e.profile,role,"Material"),"input_material_field","Text","none") ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF

SELECT_SEMANTIC_SUPPORT_PATCHES(host,s,e,rules):

    IF host.kind IN["Wall","Neck"] THEN

        face:=s.face split '/' first // 05B-F26
        wf:=WALL_FRAME(wall,e.clear_x_mm,e.clear_y_mm,0) IF host.kind==Wall ELSE WALL_FRAME(wall,e.neck_clear_x_mm,e.neck_clear_y_mm,0,e.neck_center.x_mm,e.neck_center.y_mm) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        outward:=wf.axis_v IF face==Outer ELSE -wf.axis_v IF face==Inner ELSE RAISE("SUPPORT_FACE_INVALID",s.id,["face"],"Outer/Inner",s.face,s.source_ids) // 05B-F26
        candidates:=host.patches WHERE dot(patch.frame.normal,outward)>=1-rules.basis_tolerance // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE IF host.kind==Catch THEN
        wf:=WALL_FRAME(e.catch.wall,e.clear_x_mm,e.clear_y_mm,0) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        inward_support_normal:=-wf.axis_u IF host.local_key=="Catch/Left" ELSE wf.axis_u IF host.local_key=="Catch/Right" ELSE -wf.axis_v IF host.local_key=="Catch/Front" ELSE (0,0,1) // 05B-F26
        candidates:=host.patches WHERE dot(patch.frame.normal,inward_support_normal)>=1-rules.basis_tolerance // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE
        patch_id:=PARAM(RULE(entries,"NR-19",e.profile,s.component_kind,s.family),"support_patch_id."+s.id,"Text","none") // 05B-F26
        candidates:=host.patches WHERE id==patch_id
    ENDIF ENDIF
    IF candidates empty THEN RAISE("REBAR_SUPPORT_FACE_MISSING",s.id,["face","host_id"],"exact sourced support face",[s.face,s.host_id],s.source_ids) ELSE RETURN candidates ENDIF

TOPOLOGICAL_INPUT_BINDINGS(profile):
    dependencies:=explicit binding dependency edges;Kahn queue sorted by binding.input_id
    # Main dimensions and CoverType/Elevation.C/NeckHeight first;NeckStructure after NeckHeight;
    # flags after profile/parent activity;dependent sizes/steel after their flag/count/code.
    # Each INPUT_ACTIVITY read is an edge in this table. Missing key yields FIELD_DEPENDENCY_MISSING, never a false default.
    indegree:=number of active dependencies per binding;queue:=all indegree0 in source ordinal order;out:=[]
    WHILE queue not empty:
        b:=pop queue;APPEND out b
        FOR dependent IN b.dependents: decrement indegree;IF becomes0 THEN insert sorted queue ELSE NO_OP ENDIF ENDFOR
    ENDWHILE
    IF out.Count!=applicable bindings.Count THEN RAISE("FIELD_ACTIVITY_CYCLE",profile,["dependencies"],"acyclic",remaining keys) ELSE RETURN out ENDIF

INACTIVE_PARSED_FIELD(cell,binding,reason):

        false,reason,binding.parse_kind,null,null,null,null,[],null,null,null,null,[],binding.unit,[cell.source_id])

PARSE_CATALOG_ROWS(rows,bindings):
    out:=[]
    FOR row IN rows:
        groups:= [Round(B,C),Box(D,E,F,G,H)] IF sheet==CF.Cong ELSE [Angle(B,C),Hatch(D,E,F),CoverBase(I),UI(G,H)] IF sheet==CF.Data ELSE [CoverProduct(A:R)]
        FOR group IN groups:
            IF all its cells blank THEN CONTINUE ELSE
                IF group==UI THEN CONTINUE ELSE
                    FOR required binding IN group:
                        IF optional description/optional sourced extension field absent THEN preserve raw and skip active typed value ELSE APPEND out PARSE_FIELD(exact row cell,binding,true) ENDIF
                    ENDFOR
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    RETURN out # exact sheet+row+key; independent catalog groups may share worksheet row

STATION(i,distance_mm):
    RETURN {original_index:i,original_key:ENCODE(context.manhole_id,"Station",i),coordinate_mm:distance_mm,actual_gap_mm:null}
CHECK_APERTURE_CONTACT_MATCH(product,catch_spec,rule):
    IF product.aperture_x_mm!=catch_spec.opening_width_mm under approved length tolerance OR
       product contact equations cannot resolve selected assembly support THEN
        RAISE("CATCH_PRODUCT_APERTURE_MISMATCH",product.id,["aperture_x_mm","contact_equations"],catch_spec.opening_width_mm,product.aperture_x_mm,product.source_ids,["NR-09"])
    ELSE RETURN ENDIF

HOST_CANONICAL_SUPPORT_FRAME(host,s,e,patches):
    IF host.kind IN["Wall","Neck"] THEN
        wall:=host.local_key last token IF host.kind==Wall ELSE s.face last token
        wf:=WALL_FRAME(wall,e.clear_x_mm,e.clear_y_mm,0) IF host.kind==Wall ELSE WALL_FRAME(wall,e.neck_clear_x_mm,e.neck_clear_y_mm,0,e.neck_center.x_mm,e.neck_center.y_mm) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        t:=e.wall_mm IF host.kind==Wall ELSE e.neck_wall_mm;is_outer:=s.face first token==Outer
        origin:=wf.origin+wf.axis_v*t IF is_outer ELSE wf.origin;normal:=wf.axis_v IF is_outer ELSE -wf.axis_v // 05B-F26
        RETURN FRAME(ENCODE(s.id,"Support"),origin,wf.axis_u,(0,0,1),normal) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE IF s.face IN[Top,Bottom] THEN RETURN FRAME(ENCODE(s.id,"Support"),patches[0].frame.origin,(1,0,0),(0,1,0),patches[0].frame.normal) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE RETURN patches[0].frame ENDIF ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default

ADD_PIPE_SHELL_AND_MORTAR(g,p,opening):
    # Drawing physical window is the wall crossing, not an invented full pipe run outside the chamber.
    shell_loops:=REGION_BOOLEAN([opening.pipe_outer,opening.inner],"Difference")

    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF

LABEL_RECIPE(rules,view_role,family,region_role,material_kind):

    RETURN {rule:r,parameters:r.parameters,source_ids:r.source_ids,
```

```text
    r:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-22",effective.profile,view.role,"Target/Angle") // 05B-F38
    IF !PARAM(r,"show_angle","Bool","none") THEN RETURN out ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    cut:=UNIQUE(view.component_cuts,component_id==a.host_id) ELSE RAISE("ANGLE_VIEW_HOST_MISSING",a.id,["component_cuts"],a.host_id,view.component_cuts,a.source_ids)
    group:=UNIQUE(groups.items,a.id IN member_ids) ELSE RAISE("ANGLE_GROUP_MISSING",a.id,["groups"],"one actual angle group",a.id,a.source_ids)
    ids:=[]
    FOR physical IN a.path:
        projected:=PROJECT_ANALYTIC_CURVE(physical,cut.frame,view)
        FOR pc IN projected:
            pc.source_id:=a.id;pc.group_id:=group.id;pc.role:="SteelAccessory";pc.visibility:="Visible"
            APPEND out.curves pc;APPEND ids pc.id
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    role:=PARAM(r,"target_role","Text","none");t:=PARAM(r,"target_parameter","Number","dimensionless")
    IF t<0 OR t>1 THEN RAISE("TARGET_PARAMETER_OUTSIDE",a.id,["target_parameter"],"0..1",t,r.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    curve:=UNIQUE([c FOR c IN a.path WHERE c.role==role]) ELSE RAISE("ANGLE_TARGET_ROLE_AMBIGUOUS",a.id,["target_role"],"one physical curve",role,r.source_ids)
    point:=PROJECT(CURVE_POINT(curve,t),cut.frame)
    APPEND out.targets Target2V2(ENCODE(view.id,a.id,"Bar"),view.id,a.id,group.id,"Bar",point,ids,[],true)
    RETURN out
```

### H26-VISIBLE-REGIONS-AND-STEP-EDGES

```text
REGIONS_FOR_VIEW(view,g,openings,rules):
    result:=[]
    section_groups:=map(key=(assembly_id,material_id,actualplaneorientation/offset),values=component IDs+sectionloops) // 05B-F37
    projected_components:=[]
    FOR cut IN view.component_cuts:
        component:=UNIQUE(g.components,id=cut.component_id)
        IF cut.mode==Projection THEN APPEND projected_components component ELSE
            loops:=SECTION_CSG(component,openings,cut.frame,view.section_offset_mm)
            IF loops empty THEN CONTINUE ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            key:=(component.assembly_id,component.material_id,canonical actualcutplane)
            APPEND section_groups[key] (component.id,loops,cut.frame.id,component.material_role)
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    FOR key,items IN section_groups:
        loops:=REGION_BOOLEAN(items.loops,Union)
        role:=one actual material_role IF allsame ELSE "Concrete"
        APPEND result Region2V2(ENCODE(view.id,key,"Region"),view.id,key.assembly_id,key.material_id,items.component_ids,loops,
             canonical actualcutplane frame ID,null,role,"TrueSection",null)
    ENDFOR
    IF projected_components nonempty THEN
        # A plan is not a Z=0 section. Visible depth also preserves roof/neck terrace step edges.
        faces:=all projected actual exposed cap/side boundaries and opening boundary extrema of these components // 05B-F37
        candidates:=analytic projected line/arc boundaries;split at all intersections // 05B-F37
        cells:=closed planar arrangement cells from candidate boundaries;projected_region_cells:=empty map
        FOR cell IN cells:
            p:=POINT_INSIDE_REGION_FROM_FACE_CELLS(cell.loops)
            ray_origin:=view.frame.origin+p.x_mm*view.frame.axis_u+p.y_mm*view.frame.axis_v // 05B-F37
            spans:=[]
            FOR component IN projected_components:
                intervals:=RAY_OCCUPIED_INTERVALS(ray_origin,view.frame.normal,component,openings)
                FOR interval IN intervals:APPEND spans {component:component,t0:interval.start,t1:interval.end} ENDFOR
            ENDFOR
            IF spans empty THEN CONTINUE ELSE top:=span with greatest t1;equaldepth owners must be same cast/material or explicit interface ELSE RAISE("PROJECTED_SURFACE_OWNERSHIP_AMBIGUOUS",view.id,["components"],"unique visible surface",spans) ENDIF // 05B-F37
            key:=(top.component.assembly_id,top.component.material_id,top.actual_exposed_surface_id,top.component.material_role) # same coplanar source surface canonical key;not sampled midpoint depth
            APPEND projected_region_cells[key] cell.loops with contributingcomponentIDs
        ENDFOR
        FOR key,items IN projected_region_cells:
            loops:=REGION_BOOLEAN(items.loops,Union)
            APPEND result Region2V2(ENCODE(view.id,key,"VisibleRegion"),view.id,key.assembly_id,key.material_id,items.component_ids,loops,view.frame.id,actual constant surface depth IF flat ELSE null,key.material_role,"Projection",key.surface_id)
        ENDFOR
    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    RETURN result # different visible depths remain separate step boundaries;same coplanar material union removes internal seams

RAY_OCCUPIED_INTERVALS(origin,direction,component,openings):
    occupied:=[]
    FOR part IN component.solid_parts in stored order:
        # Transform ray to part local basis. Clip against depth_min..max and polygon halfplanes/analytic profile winding.
        local_o:=TO_LOCAL(part.frame,origin);local_d:=dot(direction,part.frame.U/V/N) // 05B-F37
        ts:=all ray crossings of local footprint Line/Arc extrusion sides and both depth caps // 05B-F37
        sortunique finite crossings;classify midpoint of each adjacent t interval by profile winding AND depth range;
        intervals:=all occupied classified spans
        occupied:=interval union/difference with intervals according part.operation // 05B-F37
    ENDFOR
    FOR opening WHERE component.id IN opening.host_ids:
        void_intervals:=same ray/extrusion algorithm over opening.concrete_cutout/depth // 05B-F37
        occupied:=occupied minus void_intervals
    ENDFOR
    RETURN occupied # no arbitrary ray sampling distances or static plan rectangles

POINT_INSIDE_REGION_FROM_FACE_CELLS(loops):
    events:=all endpoint/arc extrema Y;sortunique;for each positive interval choose midpointY; // 05B-F37
    intersect horizontal line analytically with loops;classify x intervals by winding;
    firstpositiveoccupiedinterval→POINT2(midX,midY);none→REGION_INTERIOR_POINT_MISSING.
```

```text
ANY/ALL/IN(values): ordinary finite Boolean quantifiers/exact membership;emptyANY=false,emptyALL=true,not a feature default.
SHA256(bytes): actual cryptographic SHA256 of supplied bytes,lowercase hexadecimal output,not filename hash.
EXACT_INDEX(list,value): unique exact occurrence index;missing/duplicate→CATALOG_VALUE_AMBIGUOUS.
DEDUP_BY(items,key): exact identity key,stable original order;different payload samekey→ID_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT.
UNION_ID_SETS(a,b): SORT_UNIQUE(a+b) ordinal IDs.
UNION_BOUNDS(boxes): min minX/minY,max maxX/maxY over nonempty boxes;empty returns absent envelope,consumer distinguishes requiredemptyview.
COMPLEMENT(intervals,support): H06 UNION_AND_COMPLEMENT output retained;all interval metadata retained.
SPLIT_EXACT_DIMENSION_SEPARATORS(token,separators): replace only literalx/X/× by one separator;split;trim boundary whitespace;empty component rejects TUPLE_SYNTAX;no splitting arbitrary letters/dashes.
EXACT_SUBJECT_FROM_TABLE(key,e,p,view):
    RETURN local record{id:ENCODE(e.id,key),world_start,world_end,expected_mm,axis,component,projection_frame,sources}.
    Cases with explicit world endpoints (all lengths mm,F26/F27/F28/F30/F43):
      BodyClearX: (-L/2,0,0)→(+L/2,0,0),expected L. // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      BodyClearY: (0,-B/2,0)→(0,+B/2,0),expected B. // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      BodyClearH: (0,0,BaseTop)→(0,0,RoofBottom),expected H. // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      BodyOuterX: (-L/2-wall,0,0)→(+L/2+wall,0,0),expected L+2wall. // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      BodyOuterY: (0,-B/2-wall,0)→(0,+B/2+wall,0),expected B+2wall. // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      BaseOuterX/Y: BodyOuter corresponding ends expanded by baseExpansion;expected L/B+2wall+2baseExpansion.
      PadOuterX/Y: BaseOuter expanded by padExpansion,onlypad>0. // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      BaseThickness: (outerX,outerY,BaseBottom)→(outerX,outerY,BaseTop),expectedbase_mm.
      RoofThickness: (outerX,outerY,RoofBottom)→(outerX,outerY,RoofTop),expectedroof_mm.
      NeckHeight: neckcentre atNeckBottom→NeckTop,expectedactualdatumdifference,not rawW whencontactcontractoverrides.
      NeckClearX/Y: neckcentre±neckclear/2 in chosenaxis,expectedneckclearX/Y. // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      NeckOuterX/Y: NeckClear expanded eachside byneckwall,expectedclear+2neckwall.
      OwnerFrameH: neckcentre FrameBottom→FrameTop,expected100 fromCONTRACTC01.
      Panel/{id}/X,Y,Thickness: exactComponentV2 boundsextrema and z_min/z_max;no extra count multiplication.
      Pipe/{id}/ClearWidth/ClearHeight: exactsourceOpening.inner profile analytical extrema anddimaxis;Invert:BaseTop→invert_mm onactualhostwallframe.
      Catch/OpenWidth/OpenHeight: exactopeningframecutwidth/height;ClearDepth:actualhostoutside→innerfront;
      Catch/ClearHeight: floorTop→hostTop;BaseThickness:floorBottom→floorTop;WallThickness:innerfront→outerfront.
    component and source_ids from those exact input/component/opening owners.
    projection_frame=recorded view.component_cuts exactownerframe;axis=X if projected difference onlyhorizontal,Y ifonlyvertical;
    oblique dimension without explicitalignedDIMrecipe→DIM_AXIS_BINDING_MISSING;unknownsubject→DIM_SUBJECT_UNKNOWN.
```
