### H28-FINITE-NATIVE-LABEL-PLACEMENT

```text
TRY_EXPLICIT_EXTENSION_LANES(lanes,collectors,ink,obstacles,view,scale,gap,recipe,port_native):
    FOR lane IN lanes in stored priority order:
        REQUIRE lane.id/side/anchor/direction/allowed_interval/preferred_target_projection present
            ELSE RAISE("ANNOTATION_EXTENSION_SCHEMA",view.id,["extension_lanes"],"complete lane fields",lane,recipe.source_ids,["NR-22"])
        forbidden:=PROJECT_OBSTACLES_TO_LANE(obstacles,lane,gap,ink,scale,recipe.rotation_rad,port_native)
        free:=COMPLEMENT(forbidden,lane.allowed_interval)
        candidates:=SORT_UNIQUE([lane.preferred_target_projection]+free.endpoints) // 05B-F25
        FOR coordinate IN candidates:
            IF coordinate NOT IN any free interval THEN CONTINUE ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            port:=LANE_POINT(lane,coordinate)
            insertion:=port-ROTATE(port_native*scale,recipe.rotation_rad) // 05B-F25
            candidate_ink:=TRANSFORM_INK(ink,insertion,scale,recipe.rotation_rad) //05B-F40
            routes:=CONNECT_COLLECTORS_TO_PORT(collectors,port,lane,recipe,view)
            IF INK_INTERSECTS_KEEP_OUT(candidate_ink,obstacles,gap) OR ROUTE_CROSSES_TEXT(routes,obstacles,[]) THEN CONTINUE
            ELSE RETURN {insertion:insertion,ink:candidate_ink,routes:routes,port:port} ENDIF
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    RETURN null # exhausted finite supplied lanes;caller raises named NoFit

ALLOCATE_SINGLE_LABEL(subject,asset,attrs,view,recipe,existing_ink):
    REQUIRE subject.id/point/source_ids/target_ids present AND subject.point IS NOT null
        ELSE RAISE("ANNOTATION_SUBJECT_ANCHOR_MISSING",view.id,["subject"],"complete actual projected subject",subject,recipe.source_ids)
    ink:=MEASURE_ASSET_INK(asset,attrs,assets,rules)
    denominator:=PARAM(recipe,"native_baseline_denominator","Number","dimensionless")
    IF denominator<=0 THEN RAISE("LABEL_BASELINE_INVALID",subject.id,["native_baseline_denominator"],">0",denominator,recipe.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    scale:=view.scale/denominator // 05B-F25
    gap:=PARAM(recipe,"min_ink_gap_paper_mm","Number","paper_mm")*view.scale //05B-F14
    IF gap<0 THEN RAISE("ANNOTATION_GAP_INVALID",subject.id,["min_ink_gap_paper_mm"],">=0",gap,recipe.source_ids,["NR-22"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    port_native:=asset_port(recipe)
    route_enabled:=PARAM(recipe,"route_enabled","Bool","none")
    collectors:=[{points:[subject.point],hits:[],target_ids:subject.target_ids}] IF route_enabled ELSE []
    obstacles:=INK_BOXES(existing_ink)
    lanes:=LANES_FROM_EXPLICIT_RECIPE(view,p,recipe,[subject.point])
    placed:=TRY_EXPLICIT_EXTENSION_LANES(lanes,collectors,ink,obstacles,view,scale,gap,recipe,port_native)
    IF placed IS null THEN placed:=TRY_EXPLICIT_EXTENSION_LANES(recipe.extension_lanes,collectors,ink,obstacles,view,scale,gap,recipe,port_native) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF placed IS null THEN RAISE("LAYOUT_ANNOTATION_NO_FIT",subject.id,["allowed_lanes","extension_lanes"],"valid finite label position",lanes,subject.source_ids,["NR-22"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    id:=ENCODE(view.id,subject.id,asset.name,"Label");route_items:=[]
    FOR (i,branch) IN ENUMERATE(placed.routes):
        rid:=ENCODE(id,i)
        APPEND route_items RouteV2(rid,view.id,null,branch.points,[],[id],"actual subject to finite native port")
    ENDFOR
    label:=LabelV2(id,view.id,null,subject.target_ids,asset.name,attrs,placed.insertion,port_native,scale,
                   recipe.rotation_rad,placed.ink,route_items.ids,SORT_UNIQUE(subject.source_ids+asset.source_ids+recipe.source_ids))
    RETURN {label:label,routes:route_items}

ROUTE_CROSSES_TEXT(routes,obstacles,exceptions):
    FOR route IN routes:
        FOR i=0..route.points.Count-2: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            a:=route.points[i];b:=route.points[i+1];d:=b-a // 05B-F25
            IF distance(a,b)==0 THEN CONTINUE ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            FOR obstacle IN obstacles WHERE obstacle.kind IN["Text","Dimension","Title","NativeAttribute"]:
                hit:=LINE_PARAMETER_INTERVAL_IN_BOX(a,d,obstacle.bounds,{start:0,end:1}) //05B-F31
                IF hit IS null THEN CONTINUE ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                # Empty exception set is intentionally strict. An exception must name exact obstacle and allowed interval.
                remaining:=COMPLEMENT([x.allowed_t_interval FOR x IN exceptions WHERE x.obstacle_id==obstacle.id],hit)
                IF any interval IN remaining where (end-start)*distance(a,b)>rules.length_tolerance_mm THEN RETURN true ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            ENDFOR
        ENDFOR
    ENDFOR
    RETURN false
```

### H29-REGISTERED-TITLE-AND-ELEVATION-SUBJECTS

```text
REGISTER_VIEW_TITLE_AND_ELEVATION_TARGETS(out,view,e,g,rules):
    r:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-22",e.profile,view.role,"AnnotationTargets")
    bounds:=EXACT_VIEW_GEOMETRY_BOUNDS(view,out)
    env:=ENV(e,null,null)+{view_min_x_mm:bounds.min_x_mm,view_min_y_mm:bounds.min_y_mm, // 05B-F25
                          view_max_x_mm:bounds.max_x_mm,view_max_y_mm:bounds.max_y_mm,view_scale:view.scale}
    FOR role IN [ViewTitle,BaseTopElevation,FinishedCoverTopElevation,PipeInvertElevation]:
        shown:=PARAM(r,"show."+role,"Bool","none") // 05B-F25
        IF !shown THEN CONTINUE ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        IF role==ViewTitle THEN
            x:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"title_anchor_x_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
            y:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"title_anchor_y_expr","Text","none"),env,{}).value
            APPEND out.targets Target2V2(ENCODE(view.id,role),view.id,view.id,null,"ViewTitle",POINT2(x,y),[],[],true)
        ELSE
            source_items:=[{id:ENCODE(e.id,"BaseTop"),z_mm:DATUM(e,"BaseTop"),wall:null}] IF role==BaseTopElevation
               ELSE [{id:ENCODE(e.id,"FinishedCoverTop"),z_mm:DATUM(e,"FinishedCoverTop"),wall:null}] IF role==FinishedCoverTopElevation
               ELSE [{id:pipe.id,z_mm:pipe.invert_mm,wall:pipe.wall} FOR pipe IN e.pipes]
            FOR item IN source_items:
                anchor_env:=env+{source_z_mm:item.z_mm,neck_center_x_mm:e.neck_center.x_mm,neck_center_y_mm:e.neck_center.y_mm} // 05B-F25
                IF item.wall IS NOT null THEN
                    wall_frame:=WALL_FRAME(item.wall,e.clear_x_mm,e.clear_y_mm,0) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    anchor_env:=anchor_env+{wall_origin_x_mm:wall_frame.origin.x_mm,wall_origin_y_mm:wall_frame.origin.y_mm} // 05B-F25
                ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                x:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"anchor_world_x_expr."+role,"Text","none"),anchor_env,{}).value // 05B-F25
                y:=EVAL(r,PARAM(r,"anchor_world_y_expr."+role,"Text","none"),anchor_env,{}).value // 05B-F25
                world:=POINT(x,y,item.z_mm)
                owner:="Base" IF role==BaseTopElevation ELSE "Frame" IF role==FinishedCoverTopElevation ELSE "Wall/"+item.wall // 05B-F25
                cut:=UNIQUE(view.component_cuts,component_id==UNIQUE(g.components,local_key=owner).id)
                    ELSE RAISE("ELEVATION_TARGET_FRAME_MISSING",item.id,["component_cuts"],owner,view.component_cuts,r.source_ids)
                point:=PROJECT(world,cut.frame)
                APPEND out.targets Target2V2(ENCODE(view.id,role,item.id),view.id,item.id,null,"Elevation",point,[],[],true)
            ENDFOR
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN out # exact IDs registered at S6;S7 never mutates carried projection

LABEL_SUBJECTS_FOR_VIEW(role,view,e,p,g,recipe):
    result:=[]
    IF role==Material THEN
        FOR target IN p.targets WHERE view_id==view.id AND kind==Material:
            region:=UNIQUE(p.regions,id=target.source_id)
            sources:=SORT_UNIQUE([sid FOR cid IN region.component_ids FOR sid IN UNIQUE(g.components,id=cid).source_ids])
            APPEND result {id:target.id,point:target.point,z_mm:null,surface:null,wall:null,
                           material_role:region.material_role,source_ids:sources,target_ids:[target.id]}
        ENDFOR
    ELSE IF role==ViewTitle THEN
        matches:=p.targets WHERE view_id==view.id AND kind==ViewTitle
        FOR target IN matches:
            APPEND result {id:target.id,point:target.point,z_mm:null,surface:null,wall:null,
                           material_role:null,source_ids:recipe.source_ids,target_ids:[target.id]}
        ENDFOR
    ELSE IF role IN[BaseTopElevation,FinishedCoverTopElevation,PipeInvertElevation] THEN
        matches:=p.targets WHERE view_id==view.id AND kind==Elevation AND id starts ENCODE(view.id,role)
        FOR target IN matches:
            IF role==PipeInvertElevation THEN
                pipe:=UNIQUE(e.pipes,id=target.source_id);z:=pipe.invert_mm;surface:="PipeInvert";wall:=pipe.wall;sources:=pipe.source_ids
            ELSE
                surface:="BaseTop" IF role==BaseTopElevation ELSE "FinishedCoverTop"
                datum:=UNIQUE(e.datums,surface_id=surface);z:=datum.z_mm;wall:=null;sources:=datum.source_ids
            ENDIF
            APPEND result {id:target.id,point:target.point,z_mm:z,surface:surface,wall:wall,
                           material_role:null,source_ids:sources,target_ids:[target.id]}
        ENDFOR
    ELSE RAISE("LABEL_SUBJECT_ROLE_UNKNOWN",view.id,["role"],"ViewTitle/Material/BaseTopElevation/FinishedCoverTopElevation/PipeInvertElevation",role,recipe.source_ids) ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
    # No matching target is allowed only when S6 show.<role> is false or there are no source pipes/material regions.
    expected:=PARAM(RULE(rules.entries,"NR-22",e.profile,view.role,"AnnotationTargets"),"show."+role,"Bool","none") IF role!=Material ELSE true // 05B-F25
    IF expected AND result empty AND !(role==PipeInvertElevation AND e.pipes empty) AND !(role==Material AND no regions in view) THEN
        RAISE("LABEL_SUBJECT_MISSING",view.id,[role],"registered S6 target",[],recipe.source_ids)
    ELSE RETURN result ENDIF
```

### H30-EXACT-PROJECTED-GROUP-TARGET

```text
TARGET_BY_RECIPE_ROLE(group,targetset,curves,recipe,rules):
    selection:=PARAM(recipe,"target_selection","Text","none")
    candidates:=[t FOR t IN targetset WHERE t.group_id==group.id AND t.visible]
    IF group.family==Tie THEN candidates:=[t FOR t IN candidates WHERE t.kind==TieNode] ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    candidates:=SORT(candidates,key=id)
    IF candidates empty THEN RAISE("LABEL_TARGET_MISSING",group.id,["targets"],"actual same-group visible target",[],group.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF selection==Unique THEN
        IF candidates.Count!=1 THEN RAISE("LABEL_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS",group.id,["target_selection"],"one actual target",candidates.ids,recipe.source_ids) ELSE target:=candidates[0] ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE IF selection==StableFirst THEN target:=candidates[0] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE IF selection==StableLast THEN target:=candidates.last
    ELSE RAISE("LABEL_TARGET_SELECTION_INVALID",group.id,["target_selection"],"Unique/StableFirst/StableLast",selection,recipe.source_ids,["NR-22"]) ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
    IF target.point IS null THEN
        role:=PARAM(recipe,"target_role","Text","none")
        matches:=[c FOR c IN curves WHERE c.id IN target.curve_ids AND c.role==role]
        curve:=UNIQUE(matches) ELSE RAISE("LABEL_TARGET_CURVE_AMBIGUOUS",target.id,["target_role"],"one actual projected curve",matches.ids,recipe.source_ids)
        t:=PARAM(recipe,"target_parameter","Number","dimensionless")
        IF t<0 OR t>1 THEN RAISE("TARGET_PARAMETER_OUTSIDE",target.id,["target_parameter"],"0..1",t,recipe.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        point:=CURVE_POINT(curve,t)
        RETURN Target2V2(target.id,target.view_id,target.source_id,target.group_id,target.kind,
                         POINT2(point.x_mm,point.y_mm),target.curve_ids,target.region_loop_ids,target.visible)
    ELSE RETURN target ENDIF
```

### H31-TYPED-LABEL-ATTRIBUTES-AND-TEXT-INK

```text
BOUND_ATTRIBUTES_FROM_TYPED_VALUES(values,group,recipe,rules):
    out:=[]
    FOR tag,text IN values in ordinal tag order:
        IF group.material_kind!=Angle AND tag==SH THEN kind:=Text;number:=null;unit:=none
        ELSE IF group.material_kind!=Angle AND tag==DK THEN kind:=Diameter;number:=group.diameter_mm;unit:=mm
        ELSE IF group.material_kind!=Angle AND tag==A THEN
            IF group.pitch_mm IS NOT null THEN kind:=Pitch;number:=group.pitch_mm;unit:=mm
            ELSE kind:=Count;number:=group.count;unit:=count ENDIF
        ELSE IF tag==NOTE THEN kind:=Text;number:=null;unit:=none
        ELSE
            field:=PARAM(recipe,"label_field."+tag,"Text","none") // 05B-F25
            IF field IN[DisplayMark,AngleCode,CombinedAngleNote] THEN kind:=Text;number:=null;unit:=none
            ELSE IF field==Count THEN kind:=Count;number:=group.count;unit:=count
            ELSE IF field==UnitMass AND group.material_kind==Angle THEN kind:=UnitMass;number:=group.unit_mass_kg_per_m;unit:=kg_per_m
            ELSE RAISE("LABEL_TYPED_FIELD_UNKNOWN",group.id,[tag,"label_field."+tag],"declared compatible typed field",field,recipe.source_ids) ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
        ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
        IF number IS NOT null AND !IS_FINITE(number) THEN RAISE("LABEL_RAW_VALUE_INVALID",group.id,[tag],"finite typed number",number,group.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        APPEND out BoundAttributeV2(tag,text,kind,number,unit,SORT_UNIQUE(group.source_ids+recipe.source_ids))
    ENDFOR
    RETURN out

MEASURE_TEXT_GLYPHS(text,style,height,width,assets):
    IF height<=0 OR width<=0 THEN RAISE("TEXT_METRIC_SCALE_INVALID",style,["height","width"],">0",[height,width]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    metadata:=UNIQUE(assets.font_styles,style_id=style) ELSE RAISE("FONT_STYLE_METRICS_MISSING",style,["font_styles"],"exact verified style",style,[],["NR-16"])
    text:=DECODE_APPROVED_ENCODING(text,metadata.encoding)
    text:=REPLACE_KNOWN_NATIVE_ESCAPES(text,{"%%c":"Ø","%%p":"±","%%d":"°"})
    IF contains unknown formatting escape THEN RAISE("TEXT_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED",style,["text"],"supported plain text",text,[],["NR-16"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    points:=[each Unicode scalar in text in original order];pen:=0;box:=absent;previous:=null // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    FOR cp IN points:
        glyph:=UNIQUE([g FOR g IN assets.glyphs WHERE g.style_id==style AND g.codepoint==cp])
            ELSE RAISE("FONT_GLYPH_METRICS_MISSING",style,["codepoint"],"measured glyph",cp,[],["NR-16"])
        IF glyph.reference_height_mm<=0 THEN RAISE("FONT_REFERENCE_HEIGHT_INVALID",style,["reference_height_mm"],">0",glyph.reference_height_mm) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        factor:=height/glyph.reference_height_mm //05B-F40
        IF previous IS NOT null THEN
            pairs:=[k FOR k IN assets.kerning WHERE k.style_id==style AND k.left_codepoint==previous AND k.right_codepoint==cp]
            IF pairs.Count==1 THEN pen:=pen+pairs[0].adjustment_native_mm*factor*width // 05B-F25
            ELSE IF pairs.Count>1 THEN RAISE("FONT_KERNING_DUPLICATE",style,["kerning"],"0/1 exact pair",pairs.Count) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            ELSE IF metadata.kerning_mode IN[None,SparseComplete] THEN NO_OP
            ELSE RAISE("FONT_KERNING_METRICS_MISSING",style,["kerning"],"queried exact pair",[previous,cp],[],["NR-16"]) ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        scaled:=SCALE_XY(glyph.ink,factor*width,factor)+POINT2(pen,0) // 05B-F25
        box:=UNION_BOUNDS([box if present,scaled]);pen:=pen+glyph.advance_native_mm*factor*width;previous:=cp //05B-F40/F42
    ENDFOR
    RETURN box # absent for empty text; caller must distinguish absent ink from a fake origin rectangle
    # Alignment/rotation is applied by the caller using the source ATTDEF/DIM style fields;no character-count estimate.
```

## 9. S0–S11 — pseudocode và contract tại chỗ

### S0 — Template/approval preflight

Signature: `Execute(EntryStateV2) → S0StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Application.TemplateContractValidator + AutoCAD.TemplateManifestReader/TemplateAssetImporter.

```text
S0(input:EntryStateV2) -> S0StateV2:
    context:=input.context;request:=input.request
    IF request.jobs empty THEN RAISE("REQUEST_JOBS_EMPTY",null,["request.jobs"],">0",0) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    current_job:=UNIQUE(request.jobs,job_id=context.job_id) ELSE RAISE("JOB_ID_NOT_FOUND",context.manhole_id,["context.job_id"],"one selected job",context.job_id)
    FOR job IN request.jobs:
        IF SHA256(job.workbook_bytes)!=job.workbook_sha256 THEN RAISE("WORKBOOK_SNAPSHOT_HASH_MISMATCH",job.job_id,["workbook_bytes"],job.workbook_sha256,SHA256(job.workbook_bytes)) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        IF job.targets empty OR any target.row_index<4 OR duplicate selected ManholeIds across jobs THEN RAISE("REQUEST_SELECTION_INVALID",job.job_id,["targets"],"nonempty unique IDs,row>=4",job.targets) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ENDFOR
    template_bytes:=READ_ALL_BYTES(request.template_manifest_path)
    rule_bytes:=READ_ALL_BYTES(request.rule_snapshot_path)
    IF SHA256(template_bytes)!=request.template_manifest_sha256 THEN RAISE("TEMPLATE_MANIFEST_HASH_MISMATCH",null,["template_manifest_sha256"],request.template_manifest_sha256,SHA256(template_bytes)) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF SHA256(rule_bytes)!=request.rule_snapshot_sha256 THEN RAISE("RULE_SNAPSHOT_HASH_MISMATCH",null,["rule_snapshot_sha256"],request.rule_snapshot_sha256,SHA256(rule_bytes)) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    assets:AssetsV2:=DECODE_EXACT_MANIFEST_SCHEMA(template_bytes) # schema is exactly AssetsV2, flat typed AttributeDefV2, not raw DXF attribute keys
    rules:RulesV2:=DECODE_RULES_V2(rule_bytes)
    FOR r IN rules.entries:
        IF duplicate (id,version,scope) OR expression cycle OR parameter not in declared key schema THEN RAISE("RULE_SCHEMA_INVALID",r.id,["parameters","expressions"],"declared acyclic typed payload",r,r.source_ids,[r.id]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        IF r.status=="Approved" AND (r.approver null OR r.approved_at_utc null OR r.source_ids empty) THEN RAISE("RULE_APPROVAL_INCOMPLETE",r.id,["approver","approved_at_utc","source_ids"],"signed approval",r,r.source_ids,[r.id]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    IF assets.units!="mm" THEN RAISE("TEMPLATE_UNITS_UNAPPROVED",null,["assets.units"],"explicit normalized mm",assets.units,[],["NR-15"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    visiting:=set();visited:=set()
    FOR a IN assets.definitions sorted exact name: LOAD_DEFINITION(a.name) ENDFOR
    LOAD_DEFINITION(name):
        IF name IN visited THEN RETURN ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        IF name IN visiting THEN RAISE("TEMPLATE_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE",name,["child_names"],"acyclic",visiting) ELSE visiting.ADD(name) ENDIF
        a:=UNIQUE(assets.definitions,name=name) ELSE RAISE("TEMPLATE_ASSET_MISSING",name,["definitions.name"],"exact asset",name)
        FOR child IN a.child_names:LOAD_DEFINITION(child) ENDFOR
        actual:=ports.template.ObserveActualNativeDefinition(a,context.sources)
        IF actual.content_hash!=a.content_hash OR actual.attributes.tags!=a.attributes.tags THEN RAISE("TEMPLATE_NATIVE_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH",name,["content_hash","attributes.tag"],[a.content_hash,a.attributes.tags],actual,a.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        IF duplicate a.attributes.tags THEN RAISE("TEMPLATE_DUPLICATE_TAG",name,["attributes.tag"],"unique",a.attributes.tags,a.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        visiting.REMOVE(name);visited.ADD(name)
    FOR product IN assets.products:
        FOR name IN[product.plan_asset,product.section_aa_asset,product.section_bb_asset]:EXACT_ASSET(assets,name) ENDFOR
        IF product.approved AND (product.aperture_x_mm<=0 OR product.aperture_y_mm<=0 OR product.contact_equations empty) THEN RAISE("PRODUCT_CONTRACT_INCOMPLETE",product.id,["aperture","contact_equations"],"measured positive aperture and datums",product,product.source_ids,["NR-23"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ENDFOR
    FOR style IN assets.font_styles:
        IF SHA256(actual font file bytes)!=style.font_hash THEN RAISE("FONT_FILE_HASH_MISMATCH",style.style_id,["font_hash"],style.font_hash,actual font hash,[],["NR-16"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        IF style.encoding NOT IN[Unicode,TCVN3,VNI] OR style.normalization NOT IN[None,NFC] THEN RAISE("FONT_POLICY_ENCODING_INVALID",style.style_id,["encoding","normalization"],"explicit approved codec",style,[],["NR-16"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RULE(rules.entries,"NR-15",current_job.profile,"Template","CanonicalBundle")
    RULE(rules.entries,"NR-16",current_job.profile,"Template","Font")
    IF assets.bundle_hash!=context.template_hash OR rules.snapshot_hash!=context.rule_set_hash THEN RAISE("RUN_SOURCE_SET_CHANGED",context.manhole_id,["template_hash","rule_set_hash"],[context.template_hash,context.rule_set_hash],[assets.bundle_hash,rules.snapshot_hash]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    RETURN S0StateV2(context,request,assets,rules)
```

Gate: assets/rules immutable exact signatures; approval header/source version consistent. Failure không được truyền như Ready sang stage tiếp theo.

### S1 — Excel snapshot

Signature: `Execute(S0StateV2) → S1StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Infrastructure.Excel.WorkbookImporter/Vhg32Schema.

```text
S1(input:S0StateV2) -> S1StateV2:
    job:=UNIQUE(input.request.jobs,job_id=input.context.job_id) ELSE RAISE("JOB_ID_NOT_FOUND",null,["context.job_id"],"selected job",input.context.job_id)
    workbook:=OPEN_OOXML_READONLY(job.workbook_bytes) # no Save() on original workbook
    IF missing exact profile main sheet OR CF.Ga/CF.Cong/CF.Data/VHGpro THEN
        RAISE("WORKBOOK_REQUIRED_SHEET_MISSING",job.job_id,["main_sheet"],required exact sheets,actual sheet names)
    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    marker:=RAW_TEXT(workbook["VHGpro"]["L2"])
    IF marker!="VHGpro 3.2" THEN RAISE("VERSION_UNSUPPORTED",job.job_id,["VHGpro!L2"],"VHGpro 3.2",marker) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF # EX-001, original workbook version marker
    raw:=RawV2(workbook_hash=job.workbook_sha256,profile=job.profile,main_sheet=job.main_sheet,
               selected_row_index=input.context.row_index,rows=[],config=[],catalog_rows=[],version_marker=marker)
    FOR row_index IN 4..LAST_POPULATED_ROW(workbook[job.main_sheet],columns B:AA): // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        IF all B:AA cells blank THEN CONTINUE ELSE
            IF B cell blank THEN RAISE("MAIN_ROW_NAME_MISSING",job.job_id,[job.main_sheet+"!B"+row_index],"nonblank name","blank") ELSE
                cells:=[]
                FOR binding IN INPUT_BINDINGS WHERE category=="Main":
                    cell:=workbook[job.main_sheet][binding.column+row_index] // 05B-F47
                    APPEND cells CAPTURE_RAW_CELL(binding.field_key,cell,job) # body below, no semantic parse yet
                ENDFOR
                APPEND raw.rows RawRowV2(row_index,RAW_TEXT(B),cells)
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    IF no row matching context.row_index THEN
        RAISE("SELECTED_ROW_NOT_FOUND",context.manhole_id,["row_index"],"present data row",context.row_index)
    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    FOR binding IN INPUT_BINDINGS WHERE category=="Config" AND job.profile IN binding.address_by_profile:
        source_address:=binding.address_by_profile[job.profile]
        APPEND raw.config CAPTURE_RAW_CELL(binding.field_key,workbook[source_address],job)
    ENDFOR
    FOR sheet IN["CF.Cong","CF.Data","DBTool.Covers"]:
        IF sheet absent AND sheet=="DBTool.Covers" THEN CONTINUE ELSE
            IF sheet absent THEN RAISE("CATALOG_SHEET_MISSING",job.job_id,[sheet],"present","missing") ELSE
                FOR row_index IN 4..last populated row across bound columns: // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    IF all bound columns blank THEN CONTINUE ELSE
                        values:=[CAPTURE_RAW_CELL(binding.field_key,workbook[sheet][binding.column+row_index],job) // 05B-F47
                                FOR binding IN catalog bindings for this exact sheet]
                        APPEND raw.catalog_rows RawCatalogRowV2(sheet,row_index,values)
                    ENDIF
                ENDFOR
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN S1StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules,raw=raw)

CAPTURE_RAW_CELL(key,cell,job):
    source:=SOURCE_FROM_BYTES_AND_CELL(job.workbook_sha256,job.workbook_path,cell.sheet,cell.address,cell.raw_text)
    note_ids:=note refs in frozen INPUT_BINDINGS for this exact profile/key; preserve note/value cell distinction // 05B-F47
    kind:=Blank/Number/Text/Bool/Formula/Error decoded from OOXML type/formula presence // 05B-F47
    IF kind=="Formula" THEN
        formula:=cell.formula;cache_kind:=cell.cache_kind;cache_text:=cell.cache_text
        verified:=HAS_MATCHING_RECALCULATION_RECEIPT(job,cell) # receipt matches bytes/formula/cache engine; timestamp not evidence // 05B-F47
    ELSE formula:=null;cache_kind:=null;cache_text:=null;verified:=false ENDIF
    RETURN RawCellV2(key,cell.sheet,cell.address,kind,cell.raw_text_if_text,cell.numeric_lexical_if_number,
                     cell.bool_if_boolean,formula,cache_kind,cache_text,verified,
                     false,source.id,note_ids)
    # active=false is captured-undecided. S2 writes activity only into ParsedFieldV2, raw source stays immutable.
```

### S2 — Effective inputs/datums

Signature: `Execute(S1StateV2) → S2StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Application.ManholeValidator + AccessoryInputMapper.

```text
S2(input:S1StateV2) -> S2StateV2:
    raw:=input.raw;request:=input.request;rules:=input.rules
    row:=UNIQUE(raw.rows,row_index=input.context.row_index)
    parsed:=[]
    # Explicit acyclic dependencies are embedded in the input binding table; parse controls before dependents.
    FOR binding IN TOPOLOGICAL_INPUT_BINDINGS(raw.profile) WHERE category IN["Main","Config"]:
        active,reason:=INPUT_ACTIVITY(binding.field,parsed,raw.profile,request)
        cell:=EXACT_RAW_CELL(raw,row,binding.field)
        IF active THEN APPEND parsed PARSE_FIELD(cell,binding,true)
        ELSE APPEND parsed INACTIVE_PARSED_FIELD(cell,binding,reason) ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    # Catalog rows parse separately by exact (sheet,row_index,key), not first matching field key across all rows.
    APPEND_ALL parsed PARSE_CATALOG_ROWS(raw.catalog_rows,INPUT_BINDINGS)
    e:=NEW EffectiveV2 with all named fields assigned below; no constructor defaults
    e.id:=input.context.manhole_id;e.display_name:=row.name_raw;e.profile:=raw.profile
    e.clear_x_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"Length");e.clear_y_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"Width");e.clear_h_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"Height")
    e.base_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"BaseThickness");e.wall_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"WallThickness");e.roof_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"RoofThickness")
    e.base_expansion_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"BaseExpansion");e.pad_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"PadThickness");e.pad_expansion_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"PadExpansion")
    e.base_haunch_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"BaseHaunch")
    IF e.profile=="GaThamLienKhoi" THEN e.top_haunch_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"TopHaunch");e.bedding_mortar_mm:=0 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ELSE e.top_haunch_mm:=0;e.bedding_mortar_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"BeddingMortar") ENDIF # explicit source profile applicability, not missing-as-zero // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    e.neck_height_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"NeckHeight");e.neck_wall_mm:=NUMBER(parsed,"NeckThickness")
    e.neck_active:=e.neck_height_mm>0;e.neck_reinforced:=TEXT(parsed,"NeckStructure")=="BTCT" IF e.neck_active ELSE false // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    e.cover_kind:=COVER_KIND_EXACT(TEXT(parsed,"CoverType")) # Gang/composite=>Purchased, BTCT=>Panel, explicit Không=>None; other error // 05B-F28
    e.cover_code:=TEXT(parsed,"CoverBlock") IF e.cover_kind=="Purchased" ELSE null
    IF FIELD_ACTIVE(parsed,"NeckSize") THEN e.neck_raw_clear_x_mm,e.neck_raw_clear_y_mm:=TUPLE(parsed,"NeckSize",2) ELSE e.neck_raw_clear_x_mm:=null;e.neck_raw_clear_y_mm:=null ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF e.cover_kind=="Purchased" THEN
        product:=UNIQUE(input.assets.products,code=e.cover_code AND approved=true)
        ELSE RAISE("COVER_APERTURE_CONTRACT_MISSING",e.id,["CoverBlock"],"approved exact aperture/contact contract",e.cover_code,[],["NR-15"])
    ELSE IF e.cover_kind=="Panel" THEN
        contract_id:=PARAM(RULE(rules.entries,"NR-23",e.profile,"Panel","DesignedPanel"),"selected_contract_id","Text","none")
        product:=UNIQUE(input.assets.products,id=contract_id AND approved=true)
        ELSE RAISE("PANEL_APERTURE_CONTRACT_MISSING",e.id,["PanelAssemblyContract"],"selected approved contract",contract_id,[],["NR-23"])
    ELSE contract_id:=PARAM(RULE(rules.entries,"NR-23",e.profile,"Aperture","NoCover"),"selected_contract_id","Text","none");product:=UNIQUE(input.assets.products,id=contract_id AND approved=true) ELSE RAISE("APERTURE_CONTRACT_MISSING",e.id,["selected_contract_id"],"source-backed aperture/contact contract",contract_id,[],["NR-23"]) ENDIF ENDIF // 05B-F28
    e.product_rotation_rad:=product.rotation_rad
    IF product.rotation_rad not in approved supported orientation set for product.id THEN
        RAISE("ROTATION_UNSUPPORTED",e.id,["product_rotation_rad"],"approved orientation",product.rotation_rad,product.source_ids)
    ELSE
        e.neck_clear_x_mm,e.neck_clear_y_mm:=AXIS_EXTENTS_OF_APPROVED_APERTURE(product,e.product_rotation_rad) //05B-F29; rotate once
        # Product actual contour is retained separately. Cast neck remains rectangle as Excel AxB/NeckSpec defines.
        RECORD effective override SourceV2 Derived if raw NeckSize differs; never overwrite raw.
    ENDIF
    e.neck_position:=NECK_POSITION_EXACT(TEXT(parsed,"NeckPosition")) # nine literals and coordinates table,05B-F29
    e.neck_center:=NECK_CENTER(e.neck_position,e.clear_x_mm,e.clear_y_mm,e.neck_clear_x_mm,e.neck_clear_y_mm)
    e.frame_outer_x_mm:=e.neck_clear_x_mm+2*e.neck_wall_mm;e.frame_outer_y_mm:=e.neck_clear_y_mm+2*e.neck_wall_mm // 05B-F28
    e.frame_height_mm:=100 //05B-F02; CONTRACT C01 owner13/10; never replace product native thickness
    e.elevation_mode:=request.elevation_mode_override IF not null ELSE TEXT(parsed,"Elevation.C")
    e.base_elevation_m:=NUMBER(parsed,"BaseElevationM") IF e.elevation_mode=="Absolute" ELSE optional parsed AA
    e.body_scale:=request.body_scale
    e.panel_scale:=request.panel_scale IF not null ELSE INTEGER(parsed,"Panel.CoverRatioPercent") IF e.cover_kind=="Panel" ELSE null # M15 denominator,EX-059
    e.note_style:=NOTE_STYLE_EXACT(TEXT(parsed,"Annotation.NoteStyle")) # Kiểu 1=>NoteStyle1,Kiểu 2=>NoteStyle2 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    e.pitch_symbol:=TEXT_LITERAL(parsed,"Annotation.PitchSymbol")
    e.parsed_fields:=parsed
    e.contact_equations:=[("BaseTop","ReferenceZero",0), ("BaseBottom","BaseTop",-e.base_mm), // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
      ("RoofBottom","BaseTop",e.clear_h_mm),("RoofTop","RoofBottom",e.roof_mm),
      ("WallTop","RoofBottom",-e.bedding_mortar_mm),("NeckBottom","RoofTop",0)] //05B-F13/F28
    IF e.pad_mm>0 THEN APPEND e.contact_equations("PadBottom","BaseBottom",-e.pad_mm) ELSE no PadBottom datum ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    IF !e.neck_active OR BOOL(parsed,"NeckHaunchFlag")==false THEN APPEND e.contact_equations("NeckTop","RoofTop",e.neck_height_mm)
    ELSE
        # W/recess/native legacy disagree; never silently choose whether W includes seat height.
        APPEND_ALL e.contact_equations APPROVED_SURFACE_EQUATIONS("NR-IO-003",product,parsed,rules)
    ENDIF
    APPEND e.contact_equations("FrameBottom","NeckTop",0) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    APPEND e.contact_equations("FrameTop","FrameBottom",e.frame_height_mm) //CONTRACT C01,05B-F02/F28
    APPEND_ALL e.contact_equations product.contact_equations
    e.datums:=SOLVE_DATUM_GRAPH(e.contact_equations,anchor ReferenceZero=0,rules) # H14, finite graph contradiction/unresolved checks // 05B-F28
    ASSERT FinishedCoverTop resolved ELSE RAISE("FINISHED_TOP_UNRESOLVED",e.id,["datums"],"product actual top",e.datums,product.source_ids,["NR-IO-003"])
    e.panel:=MAKE_PANEL_SPEC(parsed,e,product,rules) # each PanelSpec field from named mapping table, no guessed support_mode
    e.catch:=MAKE_CATCH_SPEC(parsed,e,product,rules) # fields Catch.C..M; body/neck center override explicit // 05B-F28
    e.pipes:=[]
    FOR wall,code_key,invert_key,offset_key IN[(T1,PipeCodeT1,InvertT1,PipeOffsetT1),(T2,PipeCodeT2,InvertT2,PipeOffsetT2),
                                               (T3,PipeCodeT3,InvertT3,PipeOffsetT3),(T4,PipeCodeT4,InvertT4,PipeOffsetT4)]:
        IF code blank AND invert blank THEN CONTINUE ELSE
            IF exactly one blank THEN RAISE("PIPE_PAIR_INCOMPLETE",e.id,[code_key,invert_key],"both present/both blank",actual raw values)
            ELSE
                entry:=EXACT_PIPE_CATALOG_ENTRY(code,parsed) ELSE RAISE("PIPE_CATALOG_MISSING",e.id,[code_key],"exact catalog",code)
                APPEND e.pipes PipeSpecV2(id=ENCODE(e.id,wall,"Pipe"),wall=wall,catalog_code=code,kind=entry.kind,
                  invert_mm=NUMBER(parsed,invert_key),offset_u_mm=NUMBER(parsed,offset_key),
                  inner_width_mm=entry.round_diameter IF Round ELSE entry.box_width,
                  inner_height_mm=entry.round_diameter IF Round ELSE entry.box_height,
                  wall_thickness_mm=entry.wall_thickness,mortar_mm=NUMBER(parsed,"PipeMortar"),
                  chamfer_x_mm=entry.chamfer_x IF Box/DoubleBox ELSE 0,chamfer_y_mm=entry.chamfer_y IF Box/DoubleBox ELSE 0, // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                  web_mm=APPROVED_WEB(entry,"NR-20") IF DoubleBox ELSE null,source_ids=all code/invert/offset/catalog/mortar refs)
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    e.members:=EXPAND_MEMBER_BINDING_TABLE(parsed,e,rules) # H14 table expands each row/host/face/layer/direction explicitly // 05B-F28
    e.source_ids:=SORT_UNIQUE(all parsed source IDs + product source IDs + datum equation source IDs) // 05B-F28
    IF any active thickness<=0 OR negative expansion/cover/gap OR effective neck does not fit body THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        RAISE("EFFECTIVE_GEOMETRY_INVALID",e.id,exact offending fields,"positive/contained effective geometry",actual values,e.source_ids)
    ELSE RETURN S2StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw,effective=e) ENDIF
```

### S3 — Concrete assemblies/openings

Signature: `Execute(S2StateV2) → S3StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Application.GeometryStageAdapter + Domain.Geometry.

```text
S3(input:S2StateV2) -> S3StateV2:
    e:EffectiveV2 := input.effective
    M:string := e.id
    tol:double := REQUIRE_TOLERANCE(input.rules,"geometry_tolerance_mm","NR-18")
    g:GeometryV2 := GeometryV2(components=[],openings=[],joints=[],physical_hash="",products=[])
    half_x:double := e.clear_x_mm/2;half_y:double := e.clear_y_mm/2  // 05B-F27
    outer_x:double := half_x+e.wall_mm;outer_y:double := half_y+e.wall_mm  // 05B-F27
    base_x:double := outer_x+e.base_expansion_mm;base_y := outer_y+e.base_expansion_mm  // 05B-F27
    pad_x:double := base_x+e.pad_expansion_mm;pad_y := base_y+e.pad_expansion_mm  // 05B-F27
    base_bottom:double := DATUM(e,"BaseBottom");roof_bottom:=DATUM(e,"RoofBottom")
    roof_top:double := DATUM(e,"RoofTop");wall_top:=DATUM(e,"WallTop")
    plan:FrameV2 := FRAME(ENCODE(M,"Plan"),POINT(0,0,0),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(0,0,1)) // 05B-F25/F26
    IF e.profile=="GaThamLienKhoi" THEN
        body_assembly := ENCODE(M,"Monolithic");roof_assembly:=body_assembly
    ELSE
        body_assembly := ENCODE(M,"Body");roof_assembly:=ENCODE(M,"Roof")
    ENDIF
    IF e.pad_mm>0 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ADD_PRISM(g,"Pad","Pad",ENCODE(M,"Pad"),"Bedding",plan,
                  [RECT_LOOP("Pad/Outer",-pad_x,-pad_y,pad_x,pad_y,0,"Outer")], // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                  base_bottom-e.pad_mm,base_bottom,SOURCES(e,["PadThickness","PadExpansion"])) // 05B-F27
    ELSE
        ASSERT e.pad_mm==0 ELSE RAISE("PAD_THICKNESS_NEGATIVE",M,["effective.pad_mm"],">=0",e.pad_mm) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        # No component, no hatch, no PadBottom label. BaseBottom unchanged.
    ENDIF
    ADD_PRISM(g,"Base","Base",body_assembly,"Concrete",plan,
              [RECT_LOOP("Base/Outer",-base_x,-base_y,base_x,base_y,0,"Outer")], // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
              base_bottom,0,SOURCES(e,["BaseThickness","BaseExpansion"])) // 05B-F27
    strips := [  # current ChamberGeometryBuilder corner ownership, not four overlapping full walls
      ("Wall/T1",-outer_x,half_y,outer_x,outer_y),
      ("Wall/T2",half_x,-half_y,outer_x,half_y),
      ("Wall/T3",-outer_x,-outer_y,outer_x,-half_y),
      ("Wall/T4",-outer_x,-half_y,-half_x,half_y)] // 05B-F27
    FOR (key,x0,y0,x1,y1) IN strips:
        ADD_PRISM(g,key,"Wall",body_assembly,"Concrete",plan,
                  [RECT_LOOP(key+"/Outer",x0,y0,x1,y1,0,"Outer")],0,wall_top, // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                  SOURCES(e,["Length","Width","Height","WallThickness","BeddingMortar"]))
    ENDFOR
    IF e.profile!="GaThamLienKhoi" THEN
        joint_id := ENCODE(M,"Body-Roof-Joint")
        IF e.bedding_mortar_mm>0 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            mortar := ADD_PRISM(g,"Wall/Mortar","Mortar",ENCODE(M,"JointMortar"),"BeddingMortar",plan, // 05B-F27
                  [RECT_LOOP("Mortar/Outer",-outer_x,-outer_y,outer_x,outer_y,0,"Outer"), // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                   RECT_LOOP("Mortar/Inner",-half_x,-half_y,half_x,half_y,0,"Inner")], // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                  wall_top,roof_bottom,SOURCES(e,["BeddingMortar"])) // 05B-F13/F27
            mortar_id := mortar.id
        ELSE mortar_id := null ENDIF
        APPEND g.joints JointV2(joint_id,body_assembly,roof_assembly,roof_bottom,mortar_id,
                                FIELD_BOOL(e,"HasDowel"),SOURCES(e,["HasDowel","BeddingMortar"]))
    ELSE
        # Monolithic has no artificial wall-roof joint/mortar/dowel family.
        IF FIELD_BOOL_IF_PRESENT(e,"HasDowel")==true THEN
            RAISE("DOWEL_PROFILE_CONFLICT",M,["HasDowel","profile"],"type2/3",e.profile,[],[]) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDIF
    roof := ADD_PRISM(g,"Roof","Roof",roof_assembly,"Concrete",plan,
        [RECT_LOOP("Roof/Blank",-outer_x,-outer_y,outer_x,outer_y,0,"Outer")], // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        roof_bottom,roof_top,SOURCES(e,["RoofThickness","Height"]))
    nx0:=e.neck_center.x_mm-e.neck_clear_x_mm/2;nx1:=e.neck_center.x_mm+e.neck_clear_x_mm/2 // 05B-F27
    ny0:=e.neck_center.y_mm-e.neck_clear_y_mm/2;ny1:=e.neck_center.y_mm+e.neck_clear_y_mm/2 // 05B-F29
    hole_loop := RECT_LOOP("Roof/Access",nx0,ny0,nx1,ny1,0,"Inner") // 05B-F27
    IF !CONTAINS(roof.loops[0],hole_loop,tol) THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        RAISE("ROOF_ACCESS_OUTSIDE",roof.id,["neck_center","neck_clear_x_mm","neck_clear_y_mm"],
              "aperture within roof",[nx0,ny0,nx1,ny1],e.source_ids,[])
    ELSE
        access := OpeningV2(ENCODE(M,"RoofAccess"),"RoofAccess",[roof.id],plan,[hole_loop],[],
                            [hole_loop],roof_bottom,roof_top,null,null,e.source_ids)
        APPEND g.openings access;APPEND roof.void_ids access.id
        # Occupied blank and registered void: subtract exactly once. Inner contour not another duplicate subtraction.
    ENDIF
    IF e.neck_active THEN
        ox0:=nx0-e.neck_wall_mm;ox1:=nx1+e.neck_wall_mm // 05B-F27
        oy0:=ny0-e.neck_wall_mm;oy1:=ny1+e.neck_wall_mm // 05B-F27/F29
        IF ox0 < -outer_x-tol OR ox1>outer_x+tol OR oy0 < -outer_y-tol OR oy1>outer_y+tol THEN
            RAISE("NECK_SUPPORT_OUTSIDE",ENCODE(M,"Neck"),["neck_wall_mm","neck_center"],"inside roof support",[ox0,oy0,ox1,oy1],e.source_ids,[])
        ELSE
            neck := ADD_PRISM(g,"Neck","Neck",roof_assembly,"Concrete",plan,
                  [RECT_LOOP("Neck/Outer",ox0,oy0,ox1,oy1,0,"Outer"),hole_loop], // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                  roof_top,DATUM(e,"NeckTop"),SOURCES(e,["NeckThickness","NeckHeight","NeckSize"]))
            ADD_SEAT_CUT_IF_ACTIVE(neck,e) # H03: explicit Step/Slope/None branches, below
        ENDIF
    ELSE
        # W=0 means no neck solid; selected cover/access contract still determines roof opening.
        ASSERT e.neck_height_mm==0 ELSE RAISE("NECK_ACTIVITY_MISMATCH",M,["neck_active","neck_height_mm"],"0",e.neck_height_mm) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
    ENDIF
    ADD_FRAME_AND_SELECTED_COVER(g,e,input.assets) # H03, frame height owner100, product distinct
    ADD_PURCHASED_COLLAR_IF_ACTIVE(g,e,input.rules) # sourceEX042 Gang-only flag;contact/geometry bound,not ignored
    ADD_PANEL_INSTANCES(g,e)                     # H03, no fixed panel dimensions
    ADD_HAUNCHES(g,e)                            # H03, triangular prisms+same-pour union
    FOR p:PipeSpecV2 IN e.pipes:
        host := UNIQUE(g.components,local_key="Wall/"+p.wall) // 05B-F27
                ELSE RAISE("PIPE_HOST_MISSING",p.id,["wall"],"existing wall",p.wall,p.source_ids)
        f := WALL_FRAME(p.wall,e.clear_x_mm,e.clear_y_mm,0) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        (inner,outer,cutout) := PIPE_CONTOURS(p)  # H04 and 05B-F06/F31
        opening_frame := FRAME(ENCODE(p.id,"OpeningPlane"),f.origin,f.axis_u,f.normal,f.axis_v)
        opening := OpeningV2(p.id,p.kind,[host.id],opening_frame,inner,outer,cutout,
                             0,e.wall_mm,p.invert_mm,"NR-01",p.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        owned := PARTITION_OWNERS(g,opening)     # H04, actual contour/depth tests, no bbox assumption // 05B-F27
        IF owned.Count==0 THEN RAISE("OPENING_NO_OWNER",p.id,["concrete_cutout"],"positive host overlap","empty",p.source_ids) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        ELSE opening.host_ids:=owned.ids;APPEND g.openings opening;FOR owner IN owned:APPEND owner.void_ids opening.id ENDFOR ENDIF
        ADD_PIPE_SHELL_AND_MORTAR(g,p,opening)
    ENDFOR
    IF e.catch IS NOT null THEN ADD_CATCH(g,e) ELSE
        IF e.profile=="GaThamThuNapRoi" THEN RAISE("CATCH_REQUIRED_BUT_INACTIVE",e.id,["catch.active"],"true for type3",false,e.source_ids)
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDIF # H05
    FOR c IN g.components:
        CHECK_CLOSED_LOOPS(c.loops,tol)
        IF !HAS_OCCUPIED_INTERIOR(c,g.openings) THEN
            RAISE("COMPONENT_EMPTY_AFTER_VOIDS",c.id,["solid_parts","void_ids"],"nonempty occupied region","empty",c.source_ids)
        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // H06/05B-F37, true CSG sections; no volume invented
    ENDFOR
    g.physical_hash := HASH_PHYSICAL_GEOMETRY(g) // 05B-F46, excludes name/layout/handles
    RETURN S3StateV2(input.context,input.request,input.assets,input.rules,input.raw,e,g)
```

| OUT | state.geometry.products[].rotation_rad | double | rad | S3 mới tính payload geometry; leaf derivations và pseudocode trong cùng mục. / Native product placements at physical1:1; never replace actual product by an outside-bounds prism. / Pass-through approved product registration rotation, not sheet mirror. |
| OUT | state.geometry.products[].physical_scale | double | dimensionless | S3 mới tính payload geometry; leaf derivations và pseudocode trong cùng mục. / Native product placements at physical1:1; never replace actual product by an outside-bounds prism. / 1 exactly after native unit normalization; CONTRACT C01/05B-F25, not annotation scale. |

Gate: owned voids,optional Pad,joints,catch and frame100; real loops/depths. Failure không được truyền như Ready sang stage tiếp theo.

### S4 — Physical steel/canonical

Signature: `Execute(S3StateV2) → S4StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Application.FullRebarStage + Domain.Rebar planners.

```text
S4(input:S3StateV2) -> S4StateV2:
    e:=input.effective;g:=input.geometry;rules:=input.rules
    result:RebarV2 := RebarV2(occurrences=[],clip_ledger=[],features=[],dowel_pairs=[],canonical=[],
                               physical_hash="",angles=[],fabrication_geometry_hash="")
    IF input.request.draw_scope=="GeometryOnly" THEN
        FOR s IN e.members:APPEND result.features FeatureStateV2(s.id,"Inactive","REQUEST_GEOMETRY_ONLY",[],[]) ENDFOR
        result.physical_hash:=HASH_PHYSICAL_REBAR(result)
        result.fabrication_geometry_hash:=g.physical_hash
        RETURN S4StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw, effective=input.effective, geometry=input.geometry,rebar=result)
    ELSE
        # Exact iteration order keeps dowels straight: main meshes -> clip -> hooks -> accessories -> dowels.
        ordered_specs:=SORT(e.members,key=(family_order,host_id,face,layer,direction,id))
        # family_order is semantic enum order in this spec, not a numeric source fixture.
        FOR s:MemberSpecV2 IN ordered_specs WHERE s.family!="Dowel":
            IF !s.active THEN
                APPEND result.features FeatureStateV2(s.id,"Inactive",s.suppression_reason,[],[])
            ELSE
                TRY
                    host:=UNIQUE(g.components,id=s.host_id) ELSE RAISE("REBAR_HOST_MISSING",s.id,["host_id"],"existing host",s.host_id,s.source_ids)
                    IF s.family=="Angle" THEN
                        frames:=BUILD_ANGLE_ITEMS(s,e,host,rules)  # H07, exact catalog kg/m // 05B-F32
                        APPEND_ALL result.angles frames
                        APPEND result.features FeatureStateV2(s.id,"Ready","physical angle frames",frames.ids,[])
                    ELSE
                        recipe:=FIND_SHAPE_RECIPE(rules,s.shape_recipe_id,e.profile,s.component_kind,s.family)
                        # FIND_SHAPE_RECIPE scans exact ID in Approved rules, checks one match/scope/source; no fallback shape.
                        support:=SUPPORT_FRAME_AND_BOUNDS(host,s,rules) # H07 uses approved NR19 normal offsets
                        stations:=MEMBER_STATIONS(s,e,support,rules)   # H07 explicit family branches
                        made:=[]
                        IF stations.Count==0 THEN // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                            APPEND result.features FeatureStateV2(s.id,"Inactive","approved pitch/feature suppression",[],[])
                        ELSE
                            FOR station IN stations:
                                parent_id:=ENCODE(e.id,s.host_id,s.face,s.layer,s.direction,s.family,station.original_index)
                                IF s.family=="MainMesh" THEN
                                    parent:=STRAIGHT_SUPPORT_RUN(s,support,station) # H07 endpoints & length
                                    cuts:=[]
                                    FOR opening IN g.openings WHERE s.host_id IN opening.host_ids:
                                        IF INTERSECTS_DEPTH(parent,support,opening)==false THEN CONTINUE ELSE
                                            clearance:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-01",e.profile,s.component_kind,"OpeningClearance")
                                            convention:=PARAM(clearance,"convention","Text","none")
                                            hole_cover:=FIELD_NUM(e,"Protect.H")
                                            IF convention=="Surface" THEN q:=hole_cover+s.diameter_mm/2 // 05B-F32
                                            ELSE IF convention=="Centreline" THEN q:=hole_cover
                                            ELSE RAISE("HOLE_CLEARANCE_CONVENTION_INVALID",parent_id,["NR01.convention"],"Surface/Centreline",convention,clearance.source_ids,["NR-01"]) ENDIF ENDIF
                                            exclusions:=OFFSET_CONTOUR(opening.concrete_cutout,q,"Outer") //05B-F07/F36
                                            intervals:=INTERSECT_RUN_REGION(parent,opening.frame,exclusions) //H06/05B-F31/F32
                                            APPEND_ALL cuts intervals tagged opening.id
                                        ENDIF
                                    ENDFOR
                                    (removed,retained):=UNION_AND_COMPLEMENT(cuts,[0,parent.length_mm]) //05B-F32
                                    ids:=[]
                                    FOR (ordinal,interval) IN ENUMERATE(retained sorted by start):
                                        a:=POINT_AT_DISTANCE(parent,interval.start);b:=POINT_AT_DISTANCE(parent,interval.end) //05B-F31
                                        role:=REGION_FROM_END_ROLES(parent,interval,cuts,s.direction) # H07, never source display string
                                        path,role_values:=BUILD_PHYSICAL_SHAPE(recipe,s,e,support,station,a,b,rules) # H08, hooks after clipping
                                        bar:=MAKE_OCCURRENCE(parent_id,ordinal,s,station,host,interval.opening_ids,role,path,role_values,recipe,e,rules)
                                        collision:=CHECK_BAR_SUPPORT_AND_VOIDS(bar,g,rules) # H07;includes every leg/arc // 05B-F32
                                        IF collision IS NOT null THEN RAISE("MAIN_BAR_OPENING_COLLISION",bar.id,["path","opening_ids"],"full physical path outside voids",collision,bar.source_ids,["NR-01","NR-19"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                                        APPEND result.occurrences bar;APPEND made bar.id;APPEND ids bar.id
                                    ENDFOR
                                    err:=parent.length_mm-SUM_INTERVAL_LENGTHS(removed)-SUM_INTERVAL_LENGTHS(retained) //05B-F32
                                    IF abs(err)>rules.length_tolerance_mm THEN
                                        RAISE("CLIP_CONSERVATION_FAILED",parent_id,["removed","retained"],parent.length_mm,err,s.source_ids,["NR-18"])
                                    ELSE APPEND result.clip_ledger ClipLedgerV2(parent_id,DISTINCT(cuts.opening_ids),parent.length_mm,
                                           FLATTEN_PAIRS(removed),FLATTEN_PAIRS(retained),ids,err) ENDIF
                                ELSE
                                    # Tie/Ladder/Haunch/Lifting/Anchor/OpeningReinforcement/Catch use approved ordered corner expressions.
                                    path,role_values:=BUILD_PHYSICAL_SHAPE(recipe,s,e,support,station,null,null,rules)
                                    bar:=MAKE_OCCURRENCE(parent_id,0,s,station,host,[],"Uncut",path,role_values,recipe,e,rules) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                                    collision:=CHECK_BAR_SUPPORT_AND_VOIDS(bar,g,rules)
                                    IF collision IS NOT null THEN
                                        action:=APPROVED_COLLISION_ACTION(bar,collision,rules) # NR21/NR03: exact scoped source rule // 05B-F32
                                        IF action=="Reject" THEN RAISE("ACCESSORY_OPENING_COLLISION",bar.id,["path","opening_ids"],"no clash",collision.ids,bar.source_ids,["NR-21"])
                                        ELSE IF action=="SuppressStation" AND s.family=="Tie" THEN
                                            APPEND input.context.diagnostics DiagnosticV2("TIE_STATION_SUPPRESSED","S4",e.id,bar.id,
                                              ["station_index"],"approved suppression",station.original_index,s.source_ids,["NR-03"],"Info")
                                        ELSE IF action=="Relocate" THEN
                                            relocated:=RELOCATE_WITH_APPROVED_CANDIDATES(bar,collision,rules) # finite NR21 list, recheck all support/voids // 05B-F32
                                            APPEND result.occurrences relocated;APPEND made relocated.id
                                        ELSE RAISE("COLLISION_ACTION_UNAPPROVED",bar.id,["action"],"approved exact action",action,s.source_ids,["NR-21"]) ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
                                    ELSE APPEND result.occurrences bar;APPEND made bar.id ENDIF
                                ENDIF
                            ENDFOR
                            APPEND result.features FeatureStateV2(s.id,"Ready","all stations accounted",made,[])
                        ENDIF
                    ENDIF
                CATCH StageFault fault
                    APPEND input.context.diagnostics DIAGNOSTIC_FROM(fault,"S4")
                    APPEND result.features FeatureStateV2(s.id,"BindingMissing" IF fault.code CONTAINS "MISSING" OR fault.code CONTAINS "UNRESOLVED" ELSE "Invalid",
                                           fault.code,[],fault.nr)
                ENDTRY
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
        FOR s IN ordered_specs WHERE s.family=="Dowel":
            IF !s.active THEN APPEND result.features FeatureStateV2(s.id,"Inactive",s.suppression_reason,[],[]) ELSE
                TRY
                    bars,pairs:=BUILD_DOWEL_PAIRS(s,e,g,rules) # H09, straight, after all hook handling
                    APPEND_ALL result.occurrences bars;APPEND_ALL result.dowel_pairs pairs
                    APPEND result.features FeatureStateV2(s.id,"Ready","one physical bar/hole per approved station",bars.ids,[])
                CATCH StageFault fault
                    APPEND input.context.diagnostics DIAGNOSTIC_FROM(fault,"S4")
                    APPEND result.features FeatureStateV2(s.id,"BindingMissing" IF fault.code CONTAINS "MISSING" OR fault.code CONTAINS "UNRESOLVED" ELSE "Invalid",fault.code,[],fault.nr)
                ENDTRY
            ENDIF
        ENDFOR
        ASSERT_UNIQUE_IDS(result.occurrences + result.angles + result.dowel_pairs)
        # Main prototype panel specs expand against actual g.components Panel instances BEFORE accounting, exactly once.
        IF any requested feature has state BindingMissing/Unsupported/Invalid THEN
            PERSIST result as PartialPreview with exact feature states, no Ready S4State
            RAISE("REBAR_REQUIRED_FEATURE_BLOCKED",e.id,["rebar.features"],"all active features Ready",result.features,
                  e.source_ids,DISTINCT(result.features.needsrule_ids))
        ELSE
            PERSIST result as PhysicalPreview before accounting;missing mass data must not erase computed physical paths
            result.canonical:=BUILD_CANONICAL(result.occurrences,rules) # H10, identical lengths only
            result.physical_hash:=HASH_PHYSICAL_REBAR(result) //05B-F46
            result.fabrication_geometry_hash:=HASH_GEOMETRY_WITH_HOLES(g,result.dowel_pairs) //05B-F46; S3 carry remains immutable
            RETURN S4StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw, effective=input.effective, geometry=input.geometry,rebar=result)
        ENDIF
    ENDIF
```

Bảng dưới chứa mọi field IN và field OUT mới. Các OUT carry có cùng path/type/unit như IN và được gán tường minh trong constructor; không có root ẩn.

| Hướng | Tên field | Kiểu | Đơn vị | Nguồn / tính từ / pass-through |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IN | state.context.run_id | string | — | S3.OUT state.context.run_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Request RunId đã tạo trước S0; immutable cả batch. |
| IN | state.context.job_id | string | — | S3.OUT state.context.job_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / ID job workbook hiện tại từ request.jobs[].job_id. |
| IN | state.context.manhole_id | string | — | S3.OUT state.context.manhole_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / ID target hiện tại, không dựa G400/G500/name similarity. |
| IN | state.context.row_index | int | row | S3.OUT state.context.row_index; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Target row_index hiện tại; >=4 theo Vhg32Schema. |
| IN | state.context.build_hash | string | — | S3.OUT state.context.build_hash; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Hash assembly/source build được host thực load, pass-through request. |
| IN | state.context.template_hash | string | — | S3.OUT state.context.template_hash; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Hash bundle S0 đã kiểm, pass-through request.templates bundle hash. |
| IN | state.context.rule_set_hash | string | — | S3.OUT state.context.rule_set_hash; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Hash approved+proposal snapshots, 05B-F46; không sửa giữa batch. |
| IN | state.context.cancel_requested | bool | — | S3.OUT state.context.cancel_requested; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Snapshot cancellation state tại entry/exit stage. |

Gate: every requested feature Ready or explicit failure; full-path support; pair holes; length conservation. Failure không được truyền như Ready sang stage tiếp theo.

### S5 — Presentation groups

Signature: `Execute(S4StateV2) → S5StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Drawing.PresentationGroupPlanner + Application stage adapter.

```text
S5(input:S4StateV2) -> S5StateV2:
    e:=input.effective;r:=input.rebar;out:=GroupsV2(items=[],registry_hash="")
    accounting_items:=[]
    FOR b IN r.occurrences:
        IF b.length_status!="Known" OR b.fabrication_length_mm IS null THEN
            RAISE("GROUP_MEMBER_LENGTH_UNRESOLVED",b.id,["length_status","fabrication_length_mm"],"known physical length",b.length_status,b.source_ids)
        ELSE
            recipe:=FIND_SHAPE_RECIPE(input.rules,b.shape_recipe_id,e.profile,component_kind(b.host_id),b.family)
            IF recipe.presentation_length_basis=="Fabrication" THEN li:=b.fabrication_length_mm
            ELSE IF recipe.presentation_length_basis=="Schedule" THEN li:=b.schedule_length_mm
            ELSE RAISE("GROUP_LENGTH_BASIS_UNAPPROVED",b.id,["presentation_length_basis"],"Fabrication/Schedule",recipe.presentation_length_basis,b.source_ids,["NR-02"]) ENDIF ENDIF
            APPEND accounting_items {id:b.id,material_kind:"RoundBar",bar:b,length_mm:li,recipe:recipe,
                diameter_mm:b.diameter_mm,angle_code:null,unit_mass_kg_per_m:null}
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    FOR a IN r.angles:
        APPEND accounting_items {id:a.id,material_kind:"Angle",angle:a,length_mm:a.total_length_mm,
              recipe:FIND_ANGLE_RECIPE(a.shape_recipe_id),diameter_mm:null,angle_code:a.catalog_code,unit_mass_kg_per_m:a.unit_mass_kg_per_m}
    ENDFOR
    accounting_items:=[NORMALIZE_ACCOUNTING_ITEM(item,e,g) FOR item IN accounting_items]
    partitions:=GROUP_BY_EXACT(accounting_items,key=(e.id,item.material_kind,host_id,assembly_id,
      face,layer,direction,family,shape topology,diameter_mm,angle_code,unit_mass_kg_per_m,
      measurement_basis,presentation_length_basis,requested_pitch_mm,hook_policy_id,region_role,SORT(opening_ids),ordered role-name set))
    # host/face/layer/direction/family for angle: exact frame scope from angle source MemberSpec, not RoundBar defaults.
    assigned:=set<string>()
    FOR partition IN SORT(partitions,canonical key):
        members:=SORT(partition,key=(host station coordinates,id));ids:=members.ids
        IF any id IN assigned OR ids.Count!=DISTINCT(ids).Count THEN
            RAISE("GROUP_MEMBER_DUPLICATE",partition.key,["member_ids"],"one primary accounting group",ids)
        ELSE assigned.ADD_ALL(ids) ENDIF
        N:int:=ids.Count
        IF N==0 THEN CONTINUE ELSE // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            lengths:double[]:=members.length_mm;sum_mm:=SUM_COMPENSATED(lengths);mean_mm:=sum_mm/N //05B-F04
            role_means:=[]
            FOR role IN ordered compatible role-name set:
                IF any member missing role THEN RAISE("GROUP_ROLE_MISSING",partition.key,[role],"same roles in every member",members.ids)
                ELSE APPEND role_means RoleValueV2(role,SUM_COMPENSATED(members.role[role])/N,DISTINCT(members.role[role].source_ids)) ENDIF //05B-F05
            ENDFOR
            member:=members[0] // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            prefix:=PREFIX_FOR_EXACT_FACE_LAYER(e,member) # S2 binding table C:J; roof top G, roof bottom H
            IF member.region_role=="Left" THEN suffix:="1A"
            ELSE IF member.region_role=="Right" THEN suffix:="1B"
            ELSE IF member.region_role=="Above" THEN suffix:="2A"
            ELSE IF member.region_role=="Below" THEN suffix:="2B"
            ELSE IF member.region_role IN["Middle","Multiple"] THEN
                suffix:=EXACT_APPROVED_NAMING("NR-12",partition.key,input.rules) # deterministic explicit map/expression; no automatic T1C/D // 05B-F49
            ELSE suffix:=EXACT_APPROVED_UNCUT_MARK_SUFFIX(member.recipe,member.family,member.direction) ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
            mark:=prefix+suffix // 05B-F49
            alias:=EXACT_SCOPED_ALIAS_IF_ANY(mark,member.host_id,member.face,member.layer,input.rules)
            IF alias exists THEN mark:=alias.display_mark ELSE KEEP mark ENDIF # NR10/11 only approved aliases, no edit-distance/fuzzy join // 05B-F49
            mass:=SUM_ACTUAL_MEMBER_MASSES(ids,r.canonical,r.angles) # canonical allocated per exact physical member, not mean*N shortcut // 05B-F04
            APPEND out.items GroupV2(id=HASH(partition.key+SORT(ids)),host_id=member.host_id,face=member.face,
                layer=member.layer,direction=member.direction,family=member.family,region_role=member.region_role,
                opening_ids=member.opening_ids,shape_recipe_id=member.recipe.id,diameter_mm=member.diameter_mm,
                member_ids=ids,canonical_ids=CANONICAL_IDS_FOR(ids,r.canonical),member_lengths_mm=lengths,count=N,
                raw_sum_mm=sum_mm,mean_mm=mean_mm,min_mm=min(lengths),max_mm=max(lengths),mean_roles=role_means,
                display_mark=mark,pitch_mm=member.requested_pitch_mm,mass_kg=mass,measurement_basis=member.measurement_basis,
                source_ids=DISTINCT(members.source_ids+alias.source_ids if alias exists),material_kind=member.material_kind,
                angle_code=member.angle_code,unit_mass_kg_per_m=member.unit_mass_kg_per_m,
                member_length_basis=member.recipe.presentation_length_basis,length_policy_id=member.recipe.id)
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    IF assigned!=SET(r.occurrences.ids+r.angles.ids) THEN
        RAISE("GROUP_COVERAGE_MISMATCH",e.id,["member_ids"],r.occurrences.ids+r.angles.ids,assigned)
    ELSE
        ASSERT_NO_MARK_COLLISION_WITHIN_SCOPE(out.items) # same display mark allowed across different scoped views/components, never ambiguous same scope
        out.registry_hash:=HASH_GROUPS(out)
        RETURN S5StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw, effective=input.effective, geometry=input.geometry, rebar=input.rebar,groups=out)
    ENDIF
```

Bảng dưới chứa mọi field IN và field OUT mới. Các OUT carry có cùng path/type/unit như IN và được gán tường minh trong constructor; không có root ẩn.

| Hướng | Tên field | Kiểu | Đơn vị | Nguồn / tính từ / pass-through |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IN | state.context.run_id | string | — | S4.OUT state.context.run_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Request RunId đã tạo trước S0; immutable cả batch. |
| IN | state.context.job_id | string | — | S4.OUT state.context.job_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / ID job workbook hiện tại từ request.jobs[].job_id. |
| IN | state.context.manhole_id | string | — | S4.OUT state.context.manhole_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / ID target hiện tại, không dựa G400/G500/name similarity. |
| IN | state.context.row_index | int | row | S4.OUT state.context.row_index; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Target row_index hiện tại; >=4 theo Vhg32Schema. |
| IN | state.context.build_hash | string | — | S4.OUT state.context.build_hash; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Hash assembly/source build được host thực load, pass-through request. |
| IN | state.context.template_hash | string | — | S4.OUT state.context.template_hash; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Hash bundle S0 đã kiểm, pass-through request.templates bundle hash. |

Gate: one primary accounting group per member;exact compatibility;rawsum/mean and scoped marks. Failure không được truyền như Ready sang stage tiếp theo.

### S6 — Projection/targets

Signature: `Execute(S5StateV2) → S6StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Drawing.ViewBuilder/PlanProjector/SectionProjector/CatchAssemblyProjector/AssemblyBoundaryEmitter.

```text
S6(input:S5StateV2) -> S6StateV2:
    e:=input.effective;g:=input.geometry;r:=input.rebar
    out:=ProjectionV2(views=[],curves=[],targets=[],opening_map=[],regions=[],native_references=[])
    holes:=DOWEL_PAIRS_TO_OPENINGS(r.dowel_pairs,g,e)
    FOR role IN EXPAND_VIEW_ROLE_TABLE(e,input.request.draw_scope):
        frame,cuts:=MAKE_VIEW_FRAMES(role,e,g)
        S:=e.panel_scale IF role starts Panel ELSE e.body_scale
        view:=ViewV2(ENCODE(e.id,role),role,VIEW_OWNER_ID(role,e),frame,SECTION_OFFSET(role,e),S,MIRROR_FLAG(role),true,null,cuts)
        APPEND out.views view
        regions:=REGIONS_FOR_VIEW(view,g,g.openings+holes,rules) // 05B-F38
        APPEND_ALL out.regions regions
        FOR region IN regions:
            FOR loop IN region.loops:FOR c IN loop.curves:
                APPEND out.curves PROJECTED_CURVE_FROM_VIEW_LOCAL(c,view,region.id,null,"Sectioned" IF region.representation_kind=="TrueSection" ELSE "Visible","Geometry",region.projection_frame_id)
            ENDFOR ENDFOR
            target_point:=POINT_INSIDE_REGION_FROM_FACE_CELLS(region.loops)
            APPEND out.targets Target2V2(ENCODE(view.id,region.id,"Material"),view.id,region.id,null,"Material",target_point,CURVE_IDS(region.loops),region.loops.ids,true)
        ENDFOR
        FOR opening IN g.openings+holes:
            FOR cut IN cuts WHERE component_id IN opening.host_ids:
                IF cut.mode=="Projection" THEN rep:="ProjectedOpening";loops:=SIDE_OPENING_PROFILE(opening,cut.frame)
                ELSE IF OPENING_INTERSECTS_SECTION(opening,cut.frame,view.section_offset_mm) THEN rep:="SectionContour";loops:=SECTION_PART(OPENING_AS_EXTRUSION(opening),cut.frame,view.section_offset_mm)
                ELSE rep:="SideHidden";loops:=SIDE_OPENING_PROFILE(opening,cut.frame) ENDIF ENDIF
                ids:=EMIT_PROJECTED_LOOPS(out.curves,loops,view.id,opening.id,null,"Opening",cut.frame.id)
                APPEND out.opening_map ProjectedOpeningV2(opening.id,view.id,cut.component_id,rep,ids,cut.frame.id)
                APPEND out.targets Target2V2(ENCODE(view.id,opening.id,cut.component_id),view.id,opening.id,null,"Opening",null,ids,loops.ids,rep!="SideHidden")
            ENDFOR
        ENDFOR
        FOR b IN r.occurrences:
            IF !ROLE_SHOWS_MEMBER(role,b,e) THEN CONTINUE ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            group:=UNIQUE(input.groups.items,b.id IN member_ids) ELSE RAISE("PROJECTED_GROUP_MISSING",b.id,["groups"],"exact member group",b.id,b.source_ids)
            cut:=CUT_FOR_MEMBER(view,b.host_id,g)
            FOR c IN b.path:
                pcs:=PROJECT_ANALYTIC_CURVE(c,cut.frame,view)
                FOR pc IN pcs: pc.source_id:=b.id;pc.group_id:=group.id;pc.role:="SteelMain" IF b.family=="MainMesh" ELSE "SteelAccessory";pc.visibility:=MEMBER_VISIBILITY_FROM_DEPTH(b,cut,view);APPEND out.curves pc ENDFOR
            ENDFOR
            target:=APPROVED_MEMBER_TARGET_POINT(b,view,cut,input.rules)
            APPEND out.targets Target2V2(ENCODE(view.id,b.id,"TieNode" IF b.family=="Tie" ELSE "Bar"),view.id,b.id,group.id,"TieNode" IF b.family=="Tie" ELSE "Bar",target,out.curves WHERE source_id==b.id .ids,[],true)
        ENDFOR
        FOR a IN r.angles:EMIT_ANGLE_PROJECTION_AND_TARGET(out,a,view,input.groups,input.rules) ENDFOR
        FOR product IN g.products:EMIT_SOURCE_PRODUCT_REFERENCE(out,product,view,1) ENDFOR // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        REGISTER_VIEW_TITLE_AND_ELEVATION_TARGETS(out,view,e,g,input.rules)
    ENDFOR
    FOR map IN out.opening_map:
        original:=UNIQUE(g.openings+holes,id=map.opening_id) // 05B-F38
        measured:=INVERSE_PROJECT_WITH(map.projection_frame_id,out.curves WHERE id IN map.curve_ids)
        IF source representation under recorded frame differs THEN RAISE("OPENING_CROSSVIEW_MISMATCH",map.opening_id,["opening_map"],original,measured,original.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN S6StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw, effective=input.effective, geometry=input.geometry, rebar=input.rebar, groups=input.groups,projection=out)
```

Flat surface depth may be scalar, sloped/curved surface depth is evaluated by this surface, never one midpoint depth for all points. |

| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.code | string | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Mã RAISE được ghi trực tiếp trong pseudocode. |
