Gate: exact source IDs/frames,real member targets,shared material regions. Failure không được truyền như Ready sang stage tiếp theo.

### S7 — Annotation/ink

Signature: `Execute(S6StateV2) → S7StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Drawing.AnnotationLaneAllocator + DIM/collector/material planners.

```text
S7(input:S6StateV2) -> S7StateV2:
    p:=input.projection;e:=input.effective;assets:=input.assets;rules:=input.rules
    output:AnnotationsV2 := AnnotationsV2(labels=[],routes=[],dimensions=[],ticks=[],view_ink=[],hatches=[])
    FOR view:ViewV2 IN p.views:
        IF !view.required THEN
            ASSERT view.na_reason IS NOT null ELSE RAISE("VIEW_NA_REASON_MISSING",view.id,["na_reason"],"input reason",null)
        ELSE
            # Place dimensions/material/CT/title subjects before steel labels, all become shared obstacles.
            dims:=MAKE_DIMENSIONS(view,e,p,rules) # H13, explicit subjects/endpoints from table // 05B-F39
            base_labels,base_routes:=MAKE_CAO_DO_MATERIAL_TITLE(view,e,p,assets,rules) # H13
            APPEND_ALL output.dimensions dims;APPEND_ALL output.labels base_labels;APPEND_ALL output.routes base_routes
            obstacles:=INK_BOXES(dims,base_labels,p.curves WHERE view_id==view.id AND role in approved geometry keepout roles)
            groups:=SORT(input.groups.items with projected targets in view,
                         key=(host_id,face,layer,direction,region_role,id))
            FOR group:GroupV2 IN groups:
                targets:=p.targets WHERE view_id==view.id AND group_id==group.id
                IF targets empty THEN RAISE("LABEL_GROUP_TARGET_MISSING",group.id,["projection.targets"],"real projected target",[],group.source_ids)
                ELSE
                    recipe:=LABEL_RECIPE(rules,view.role,group.family,group.region_role,group.material_kind)
                    # LABEL_RECIPE is exact approved parameter map H11; not type selection by first/longest path.
                    IF group.family=="MainMesh" THEN
                        collectors:=BUILD_COLLECTORS(group,targets,p.curves,view,recipe,rules) # H11 actual member crossings
                    ELSE
                        target:=TARGET_BY_RECIPE_ROLE(group,targets,p.curves,recipe,rules) # exact curve-role/parameter or TieNode // 05B-F39
                        IF target.point IS null THEN RAISE("LABEL_TARGET_POINT_MISSING",target.id,["point"],"actual projected anchor",null,group.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                        collectors:=[{points:[target.point],hits:[{member_id:target.source_id,point:target.point}],target_ids:[target.id]}]
                    ENDIF
                    IF group.material_kind=="Angle" THEN
                        asset_name:=PARAM(recipe,"angle_label_asset","Text","none")
                        values:=BIND_ANGLE_LABEL(group,asset_name,assets,rules) # NOTE=mark-angleCode; never %%c<kg/m> // 05B-F39
                    ELSE
                        IF e.note_style=="NoteStyle1" THEN
                            asset_name:="BLT1" IF recipe.side=="Right" ELSE "BLT2"
                            values:={"SH":group.display_mark,"DK":"%%c"+FORMAT(group.diameter_mm,"Diameter",rules), // 05B-F39
                                     "A":e.pitch_symbol+FORMAT(group.pitch_mm,"Pitch",rules) IF group.pitch_mm IS NOT null
                                          ELSE COUNT_LABEL_FROM_APPROVED_RECIPE(group,recipe)} //05B-F44; exact tags source BLT1/2
                        ELSE IF e.note_style=="NoteStyle2" THEN
                            asset_name:="BLT3" IF recipe.side=="Right" ELSE "BLT4"
                            values:={"NOTE":group.display_mark+"-%%c"+FORMAT(group.diameter_mm,"Diameter",rules)} //05B-F44; no SH/DK/A tags on BLT3/4
                        ELSE RAISE("NOTE_STYLE_INVALID",group.id,["effective.note_style"],"NoteStyle1/2",e.note_style,group.source_ids) ENDIF ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    ENDIF
                    IF group.family=="Tie" THEN
                        # BLTC target marker references a real projected TieNode; ordinary text label still uses selected side/style.
                        tie_target:=UNIQUE(targets,kind="TieNode",recipe target-role match)
                        ELSE RAISE("TIE_NODE_TARGET_MISSING",group.id,["targets"],"physical TieNode",targets.ids,group.source_ids,["NR-04"])
                        EMIT_PHYSICAL_TIE_MARKER(tie_target,"BLTC",assets,view,output)
                    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                    asset:=UNIQUE(assets.definitions,name=asset_name) ELSE RAISE("LABEL_ASSET_MISSING",group.id,["asset_name"],"exact native definition",asset_name,group.source_ids)
                    IF SORT(values.keys)!=SORT(asset.attributes.tags) THEN
                        RAISE("LABEL_TAG_SCHEMA_MISMATCH",group.id,["attributes"],asset.attributes.tags,values.keys,asset.source_ids)
                    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                    bound:=BOUND_ATTRIBUTES_FROM_TYPED_VALUES(values,group,recipe,rules) # every field tag/text/raw_number/unit/source_ids populated // 05B-F39
                    native_ink:=MEASURE_ASSET_INK(asset,bound,assets,rules) # H12: decode/metrics/kerning/alignment // 05B-F39
                    denominator:=PARAM(recipe,"native_baseline_denominator","Number","dimensionless")
                    IF denominator<=0 THEN RAISE("LABEL_BASELINE_INVALID",group.id,["native_baseline_denominator"],">0",denominator,recipe.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    scale:=view.scale/denominator //05B-F14;source100 only when selected asset recipe says100
                    gap_model:=PARAM(recipe,"min_ink_gap_paper_mm","Number","paper_mm")*view.scale //05B-F14
                    IF gap_model<0 THEN RAISE("ANNOTATION_GAP_INVALID",group.id,["min_ink_gap_paper_mm"],">=0",gap_model,recipe.source_ids,["NR-22"]) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                    allowed_lanes:=LANES_FROM_EXPLICIT_RECIPE(view,p,recipe,[hit.point FOR branch IN collectors FOR hit IN branch.hits]) # H11 interval bounds from current actual ink
                    placed:=null;rejected:=[]
                    FOR lane IN allowed_lanes in approved priority order:
                        intervals:=PROJECT_OBSTACLES_TO_LANE(obstacles,lane,gap_model,native_ink,scale,recipe.rotation_rad,asset_port(recipe)) //05B-F39/F40
                        free:=COMPLEMENT(intervals,lane.allowed_interval)
                        candidates:=SORT_UNIQUE([lane.preferred_target_projection]+free.endpoints) // 05B-F39
                        FOR coordinate IN candidates:
                            IF coordinate NOT IN any free interval THEN CONTINUE ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                            port_world:=LANE_POINT(lane,coordinate)
                            insertion:=port_world-ROTATE(asset_port(recipe)*scale,recipe.rotation_rad) //05B-F40
                            candidate_ink:=TRANSFORM_INK(native_ink,insertion,scale,recipe.rotation_rad)
                            branch_routes:=CONNECT_COLLECTORS_TO_PORT(collectors,port_world,lane,recipe,view) # finite exact elbows H11
                            IF INK_INTERSECTS_KEEP_OUT(candidate_ink,obstacles,gap_model) OR
                               ROUTE_CROSSES_TEXT(branch_routes,obstacles,[]) THEN
                                APPEND rejected {lane_id:lane.id,coordinate:coordinate,obstacle_ids:intersected IDs}
                            ELSE
                                placed:={insertion:insertion,ink:candidate_ink,routes:branch_routes,port:port_world}
                                BREAK coordinate loop
                            ENDIF
                        ENDFOR
                        IF placed IS NOT null THEN BREAK lane loop ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                    ENDFOR
                    IF placed IS null THEN
                        # Exactly one finite extension set, supplied by approved recipe; never while-true moving X/Y.
                        placed:=TRY_EXPLICIT_EXTENSION_LANES(recipe.extension_lanes,collectors,native_ink,obstacles,view,scale,gap_model,recipe,asset_port(recipe))
                        IF placed IS null THEN
                            RAISE("LAYOUT_ANNOTATION_NO_FIT",group.id,["allowed_lanes","ink"],"one valid finite candidate",rejected,group.source_ids,["NR-22"])
                        ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                    ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
                    label_id:=ENCODE(view.id,group.id,"BarLabel")
                    route_ids:=[]
                    FOR (branch_index,branch) IN ENUMERATE(placed.routes):
                        rid:=ENCODE(label_id,branch_index)
                        intersections:=VALID_MEMBER_INTERSECTIONS(branch,group,p.curves,p.opening_map)
                        APPEND output.routes RouteV2(rid,view.id,group.id,branch.points,intersections,[label_id],"finite lane allocator")
                        APPEND route_ids rid
                        FOR intersection IN (intersections IF group.family=="MainMesh" ELSE []):
                            APPEND output.ticks TickV2(ENCODE(rid,intersection.occurrence_id,intersection.point),view.id,"Gach",
                                                        intersection.occurrence_id,intersection.point,scale)
                        ENDFOR
                    ENDFOR
                    APPEND output.labels LabelV2(label_id,view.id,group.id,targets.ids,asset_name,bound,
                             placed.insertion,asset_port(recipe),scale,recipe.rotation_rad,placed.ink,route_ids,group.source_ids+asset.source_ids)
                    APPEND obstacles {id:label_id,bounds:placed.ink,kind:"Text"}
                ENDIF
            ENDFOR
            hatch_intents:=MAKE_HATCH_INTENTS(view,p.regions,e,assets,rules) # H13, same outer+inner region IDs // 05B-F39
            APPEND_ALL output.hatches hatch_intents
            ink:=UNION_BOUNDS(all geometry curve stroke envelopes + actual physical native product reference asset ink transformed in this view + output labels/dims/ticks/routes in this view) //05B-F42
            APPEND output.view_ink ViewInkV2(view.id,ink)
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    # Whole-view audit after every label exists; allocator does not hide labels to make itself pass.
    IF any label without target OR any Gach without exact member crossing OR required label count differs from required semantic subjects THEN
        RAISE("ANNOTATION_COMPLETENESS_FAILED",e.id,["labels","routes","ticks"],"all target associations present",output,[],[])
    ELSE
        IF any non-permitted ink overlap under approved paper tolerance THEN
            RAISE("ANNOTATION_INK_COLLISION",e.id,["labels.ink","dimensions.ink"],"no forbidden overlap",collision pairs,[],["NR-22"])
        ELSE RETURN S7StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw, effective=input.effective, geometry=input.geometry, rebar=input.rebar, groups=input.groups, projection=input.projection,annotations=output) ENDIF
    ENDIF
```

Bảng dưới chứa mọi field IN và field OUT mới. Các OUT carry có cùng path/type/unit như IN và được gán tường minh trong constructor; không có root ẩn.

| Hướng | Tên field | Kiểu | Đơn vị | Nguồn / tính từ / pass-through |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IN | state.context.run_id | string | — | S6.OUT state.context.run_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Request RunId đã tạo trước S0; immutable cả batch. |
| IN | state.context.job_id | string | — | S6.OUT state.context.job_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / ID job workbook hiện tại từ request.jobs[].job_id. |
| IN | state.context.manhole_id | string | — | S6.OUT state.context.manhole_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / ID target hiện tại, không dựa G400/G500/name similarity. |
| IN | state.context.row_index | int | row | S6.OUT state.context.row_index; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Target row_index hiện tại; >=4 theo Vhg32Schema. |
| IN | state.context.build_hash | string | — | S6.OUT state.context.build_hash; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Hash assembly/source build được host thực load, pass-through request. |
| IN | state.context.template_hash | string | — | S6.OUT state.context.template_hash; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Hash bundle S0 đã kiểm, pass-through request.templates bundle hash. |
| IN | state.context.rule_set_hash | string | — | S6.OUT state.context.rule_set_hash; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Hash approved+proposal snapshots, 05B-F46; không sửa giữa batch. |
| IN | state.context.cancel_requested | bool | — | S6.OUT state.context.cancel_requested; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Snapshot cancellation state tại entry/exit stage. |
| IN | state.context.sources[].id | string | — | S6.OUT state.context.sources[].id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Nguồn gốc+Derived append-only, ID không trùng khác nội dung. / SHA256(canonical source descriptor); 05B-F46. |

| OUT | state.annotations.hatches[].angle_rad | double | rad | S7 mới tính payload annotations; leaf derivations và pseudocode trong cùng mục. / Requested material hatch intents use the SAME projected region IDs. / Approved hatch role/source angle, not arbitrary zero if missing. |
| OUT | state.annotations.hatches[].layer_id | string | — | S7 mới tính payload annotations; leaf derivations và pseudocode trong cùng mục. / Requested material hatch intents use the SAME projected region IDs. / Exact native semantic layer binding, preflight S0. |
| OUT | state.annotations.hatches[].source_ids[] | string[] | — | S7 mới tính payload annotations; leaf derivations và pseudocode trong cùng mục. / Requested material hatch intents use the SAME projected region IDs. / CF.Ga/CF.Data/material mapping/approval evidence. |
| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.code | string | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Mã RAISE được ghi trực tiếp trong pseudocode. |
| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.stage | string | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / S0..S11 hoặc PRECHECK. |
| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.manhole_id | string? | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Pass-through context.manhole_id nếu đã có. |
| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.subject_id | string? | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Component/occurrence/group/view/field bị lỗi; null chỉ lỗi trước xác định subject. |
| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.field_paths[] | string[] | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Paths cụ thể đã kiểm, không một thông báo chung. |
| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.expected_text | string | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Literal invariant/expected field value từ phép kiểm. |
| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.actual_text | string | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Serialize actual values bị lỗi, culture invariant. |
| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.source_ids[] | string[] | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / IDs của các input gây lỗi, tra context.sources[]. |
| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.needsrule_ids[] | string[] | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / NR-01..23 hoặc NR-IO-* liên quan; không tự tạo numeric fallback. |
| FAIL | failure.diagnostic.severity | string | — | RAISE payload; Concrete RAISE payload; no Ready data on failure. / Block/Warning/Info từ call RAISE/REPORT, không đổi khi render. |
| FAIL | failure.receipt.stage | string | — | RAISE payload; Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Tên stage vừa thực hiện. |
| FAIL | failure.receipt.run_id | string | — | RAISE payload; Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Pass-through context.run_id. |
| FAIL | failure.receipt.manhole_id | string | — | RAISE payload; Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Pass-through context.manhole_id. |
| FAIL | failure.receipt.status | string | — | RAISE payload; Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Ready/Partial/Blocked/Cancelled theo diagnostic và cancellation. |
| FAIL | failure.receipt.input_hash | string | — | RAISE payload; Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Hash canonical input state trước stage, 05B-F46. |
| FAIL | failure.receipt.output_hash | string? | — | RAISE payload; Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Hash ready payload; lỗi trước payload = null. |
| FAIL | failure.receipt.started_utc | string | UTC | RAISE payload; Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Clock UTC lúc bắt đầu; không dùng làm freshness workbook. |
| FAIL | failure.receipt.finished_utc | string | UTC | RAISE payload; Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Clock UTC lúc kết thúc stage, ghi kể cả lỗi. |

Gate: all labels target real members;finite fit;true native ink,not char-count estimates. Failure không được truyền như Ready sang stage tiếp theo.

### S8 — Native TK/bending

Signature: `Execute(S7StateV2) → S8StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Drawing.NativeSteelSchedulePlanner/SchematicPresentationPlanner.

```text
S8(input:S7StateV2) -> S8StateV2:
    e:=input.effective;rules:=input.rules;assets:=input.assets
    out:=SchedulesV2(rows=[],captions=[],summaries=[],ink=[],headings=[])
    IF input.request.draw_scope=="GeometryOnly" THEN RETURN S8StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw, effective=input.effective, geometry=input.geometry, rebar=input.rebar, groups=input.groups, projection=input.projection, annotations=input.annotations,schedules=out) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    bucket_members:=GROUP_BY_EXACT(input.groups.items,key=PHYSICAL_OWNER_BUCKET(group,input.geometry,rules))
    FOR bucket IN SORT(bucket_members,key=exact owner bucket ID):
        schedule_view:=ENCODE(e.id,"Schedule",bucket.key);bending_view:=ENCODE(e.id,"Bending",bucket.key)
        S:=e.panel_scale IF bucket.key=="Panel" ELSE e.body_scale
        scale:=S/100 //05B-F14/F15; native TK source baseline100, not physical product scale
        layout_rule:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-22",e.profile,bucket.key,"ScheduleLayout")
        cursor_y:=PARAM(layout_rule,"first_row_y_native_mm","Number","mm")*scale;bending_x:=0;bending_y:=0 // 05B-F44
        rows:=SORT(bucket.groups,key=(host_id,face,layer,direction,region_role,id))
        FOR (index,group) IN ENUMERATE(rows):
            IF group.count<=0 OR group.member_ids.Count!=group.count THEN RAISE("SCHEDULE_GROUP_COUNT_INVALID",group.id,["count","member_ids"],">0 and equal",group.count,group.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            recipe:=FIND_SHAPE_RECIPE(rules,group.shape_recipe_id,e.profile,component_kind(group.host_id),group.family)
            asset:=EXACT_ASSET(assets,recipe.native_asset)
            IF asset.content_hash!=recipe.fixed_glyph_hash THEN RAISE("SCHEDULE_GLYPH_SIGNATURE_CHANGED",group.id,["fixed_glyph_hash"],recipe.fixed_glyph_hash,asset.content_hash,recipe.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            attrs:=[]
            FOR binding IN recipe.tag_bindings:
                IF binding.operation=="Literal" THEN value:=binding.literal;raw:=null;unit:="none"
                ELSE IF binding.operation=="Mark" THEN value:=group.display_mark;raw:=null;unit:="none"
                ELSE IF binding.operation=="Diameter" THEN raw:=group.diameter_mm;unit:="mm";value:=FORMAT_VALUE(raw,unit,rules,"Diameter")
                ELSE IF binding.operation=="RoleMean" THEN raw:=UNIQUE(group.mean_roles,role=binding.role).value_mm;unit:="mm";value:=FORMAT_VALUE(raw,unit,rules,"Leg")
                ELSE IF binding.operation=="MeanLength" THEN raw:=group.mean_mm;unit:="mm";value:=FORMAT_VALUE(raw,unit,rules,"DAI")
                ELSE IF binding.operation=="Count" THEN raw:=group.count;unit:="count";value:=INVARIANT_INTEGER(raw)
                ELSE IF binding.operation=="RawSumM" THEN raw:=group.raw_sum_mm/1000;unit:="m";value:=FORMAT_VALUE(raw,unit,rules,"TDAI") // 05B-F01
                ELSE IF binding.operation=="MassKg" THEN raw:=group.mass_kg;unit:="kg";value:=FORMAT_VALUE(raw,unit,rules,"KL")
                ELSE IF binding.operation=="OwnerLabel" THEN value:=BUCKET_TITLE_LITERAL(bucket.key,rules) IF index==0 ELSE "";raw:=null;unit:="none" // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
                ELSE IF binding.operation=="AngleCode" THEN value:=group.angle_code;raw:=null;unit:="none"
                ELSE IF binding.operation=="UnitMass" THEN raw:=group.unit_mass_kg_per_m;unit:="kg/m";value:=FORMAT_VALUE(raw,unit,rules,"AngleUnitMass") // 05B-F44
                ELSE RAISE("TK_TAG_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED",group.id,[binding.tag],"closed tag operation",binding.operation,recipe.source_ids) ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
                APPEND attrs BoundAttributeV2(tag=binding.tag,text=value,value_kind="Text" IF raw IS null ELSE "Number",raw_number=raw,unit=unit,source_ids=group.source_ids+recipe.source_ids)
            ENDFOR
            IF SORT(attrs.tags)!=SORT(asset.attributes.tags) THEN RAISE("TK_TAG_SCHEMA_MISMATCH",group.id,["attributes"],asset.attributes.tags,attrs.tags,asset.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            # Tenluoi stays on the first native row that owns it; do not add a free-floating duplicate header.
            local_ink:=MEASURE_ASSET_INK(asset,attrs,assets,rules)
            insertion:=POINT2(0,cursor_y);ink:=TRANSFORM_INK(local_ink,insertion,scale,0) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            APPEND out.rows ScheduleRowV2(id=ENCODE(schedule_view,group.id),group_id=group.id,native_asset=asset.name,
                 attributes=attrs,glyph_hash=asset.content_hash,insertion=insertion,scale=scale,ink=ink,view_id=schedule_view)
            IF index==0 THEN EMIT_SCHEDULE_HEADINGS(out,schedule_view,bending_view,group,bucket.key,insertion,scale,layout_rule,assets,rules) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            cursor_y:=cursor_y-500*scale //05B-F15, exact source row increment; ink containment still uses actual envelope
            caption_rule:=RULE(rules.entries,"NR-22",e.profile,group.family,"Bending")
            glyph:=PARAM(caption_rule,"glyph_asset","Text","none")
            text:=group.display_mark+"-%%c"+FORMAT_VALUE(group.diameter_mm,"mm",rules,"Diameter") IF group.material_kind=="RoundBar" ELSE group.display_mark+"-"+group.angle_code // 05B-F44
            text:=text+(" Ltb=" IF group.min_mm!=group.max_mm ELSE " L=")+FORMAT_VALUE(group.mean_mm,"mm",rules,"DAI") // 05B-F04
            bend_insert:=POINT2(bending_x,bending_y)
            cap_ink:=MEASURE_BENDING_INK(glyph,group.mean_roles,text,bend_insert,scale,assets,caption_rule)
            underline_y:=cap_ink.min_y_mm-PARAM(caption_rule,"underline_gap_paper_mm","Number","paper_mm")*S // 05B-F44
            under_a:=POINT2(cap_ink.min_x_mm,underline_y);under_b:=POINT2(cap_ink.max_x_mm,underline_y)
            cap_ink:=UNION_BOUNDS(cap_ink,STROKE_BOUNDS(under_a,under_b,caption_rule,assets))
            APPEND out.captions CaptionV2(group_id=group.id,glyph_asset=glyph,text=text,role_values=group.mean_roles,
                 underline_start=under_a,underline_end=under_b,ink=cap_ink,view_id=bending_view,insertion=bend_insert,asset_scale=scale)
            bending_x:=cap_ink.max_x_mm+PARAM(caption_rule,"next_gap_paper_mm","Number","paper_mm")*S //05B-F14/F17/F41
        ENDFOR

    ENDFOR
    FOR summary_scope IN[Main,Panel,Catch]:
        included:=input.groups.items WHERE PHYSICAL_OWNER_BUCKET(group,input.geometry,rules) IN ([Body,Neck] IF summary_scope==Main ELSE [summary_scope])
        IF included empty THEN CONTINUE ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        view_id:=ENCODE(e.id,"Schedule",Body IF summary_scope==Main AND Body groups nonempty ELSE Neck IF summary_scope==Main ELSE summary_scope)
        S:=e.panel_scale IF summary_scope==Panel ELSE e.body_scale;scale:=S/100 // 05B-F14
        asset_name:={Main:"TK.THKL",Panel:"TK.THKLNAP",Catch:"TK.THKL.CT"}[summary_scope]
        asset:=EXACT_ASSET(assets,asset_name)
        r:=RULE(entries,"NR-14",e.profile,summary_scope,"Summary")
        small:=SUM(included.mass_kg WHERE material_kind==RoundBar AND diameter_mm<=10) // 05B-F44
        large:=SUM(included.mass_kg WHERE material_kind==RoundBar AND diameter_mm>10) // 05B-F44
        attrs:=BIND_SUMMARY_TAGS(asset,small,large,included,r,rules)
        previous:=all rows/headings in same view // 05B-F44
        pos:=POINT2(min(previous.ink.min_x_mm),min(previous.ink.min_y_mm)-PARAM(r,"summary_gap_paper_mm","Number","paper_mm")*S) // 05B-F44
        ink:=TRANSFORM_INK(MEASURE_ASSET_INK(asset,attrs,assets,rules),pos,scale,0) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        APPEND out.summaries SummaryV2(ENCODE(view_id,"Summary"),summary_scope,asset_name,attrs,small,large,view_id,pos,scale,ink)
    ENDFOR
    FOR view_id IN SORT_UNIQUE(rows.view_id+captions.view_id+headings.view_id+summaries.view_id):
        APPEND out.ink ViewInkV2(view_id,UNION_BOUNDS(all rows/captions/headings/summaries WHERE view_id .ink))
    ENDFOR
    IF SET(out.rows.group_id)!=SET(input.groups.items.id) OR SET(out.captions.group_id)!=SET(input.groups.items.id) THEN
        RAISE("SCHEDULE_GROUP_COVERAGE",e.id,["rows.group_id","captions.group_id"],input.groups.items.ids,[out.rows.group_id,out.captions.group_id])
    ELSE RETURN S8StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw, effective=input.effective, geometry=input.geometry, rebar=input.rebar, groups=input.groups, projection=input.projection, annotations=input.annotations,schedules=out) ENDIF
```

Bảng dưới chứa mọi field IN và field OUT mới. Các OUT carry có cùng path/type/unit như IN và được gán tường minh trong constructor; không có root ẩn.

| Hướng | Tên field | Kiểu | Đơn vị | Nguồn / tính từ / pass-through |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IN | state.context.run_id | string | — | S7.OUT state.context.run_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Request RunId đã tạo trước S0; immutable cả batch. |
| IN | state.context.job_id | string | — | S7.OUT state.context.job_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / ID job workbook hiện tại từ request.jobs[].job_id. |
| IN | state.context.manhole_id | string | — | S7.OUT state.context.manhole_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / ID target hiện tại, không dựa G400/G500/name similarity. |
| IN | state.context.row_index | int | row | S7.OUT state.context.row_index; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Target row_index hiện tại; >=4 theo Vhg32Schema. |
| IN | state.context.build_hash | string | — | S7.OUT state.context.build_hash; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Hash assembly/source build được host thực load, pass-through request. |

| IN | state.context.rule_set_hash | string | — | S7.OUT state.context.rule_set_hash; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Hash approved+proposal snapshots, 05B-F46; không sửa giữa batch. |

| IN | state.context.sources[].formula_id | string? | — | S7.OUT state.context.sources[].formula_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Nguồn gốc+Derived append-only, ID không trùng khác nội dung. / ID 05B của phép biến đổi; pass-through/source literal null. |
| IN | state.context.diagnostics[].code | string | — | S7.OUT state.context.diagnostics[].code; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Diagnostic của các stage đã chạy, append-only. / Mã RAISE được ghi trực tiếp trong pseudocode. |
| IN | state.context.diagnostics[].stage | string | — | S7.OUT state.context.diagnostics[].stage; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Diagnostic của các stage đã chạy, append-only. / S0..S11 hoặc PRECHECK. |
| IN | state.context.diagnostics[].manhole_id | string? | — | S7.OUT state.context.diagnostics[].manhole_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Diagnostic của các stage đã chạy, append-only. / Pass-through context.manhole_id nếu đã có. |
| IN | state.context.diagnostics[].subject_id | string? | — | S7.OUT state.context.diagnostics[].subject_id; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Diagnostic của các stage đã chạy, append-only. / Component/occurrence/group/view/field bị lỗi; null chỉ lỗi trước xác định subject. |
| IN | state.context.diagnostics[].field_paths[] | string[] | — | S7.OUT state.context.diagnostics[].field_paths[]; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Diagnostic của các stage đã chạy, append-only. / Paths cụ thể đã kiểm, không một thông báo chung. |

| IN | state.context.diagnostics[].actual_text | string | — | S7.OUT state.context.diagnostics[].actual_text; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Diagnostic của các stage đã chạy, append-only. / Serialize actual values bị lỗi, culture invariant. |
| IN | state.context.diagnostics[].source_ids[] | string[] | — | S7.OUT state.context.diagnostics[].source_ids[]; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Diagnostic của các stage đã chạy, append-only. / IDs của các input gây lỗi, tra context.sources[]. |
| IN | state.context.diagnostics[].needsrule_ids[] | string[] | — | S7.OUT state.context.diagnostics[].needsrule_ids[]; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Diagnostic của các stage đã chạy, append-only. / NR-01..23 hoặc NR-IO-* liên quan; không tự tạo numeric fallback. |
| IN | state.context.diagnostics[].severity | string | — | S7.OUT state.context.diagnostics[].severity; giữ nguyên type/unit/nullability; Pass-through từ input state, immutable; chỉ append context receipts/diagnostics/sources. / Diagnostic của các stage đã chạy, append-only. / Block/Warning/Info từ call RAISE/REPORT, không đổi khi render. |

| FAIL | failure.receipt.finished_utc | string | UTC | RAISE payload; Failed stage receipt, output_hash=null; cancellation explicit. / Clock UTC lúc kết thúc stage, ghi kể cả lỗi. |

Gate: exact INSERT/ATTRIB tags;raw quantity aggregation;fixed schematic glyph. Failure không được truyền như Ready sang stage tiếp theo.

### S9 — Sheet pagination

Signature: `Execute(S8StateV2) → S9StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Drawing.SheetLayoutPlanner.

```text
S9(input:S8StateV2) -> S9StateV2:
    e:=input.effective;out:=SheetV2(frames=[],geometry_hash_before=input.rebar.fabrication_geometry_hash,
                                     rebar_hash_before=input.rebar.physical_hash,sheet_hash="")
    bundles:=EXACT_VIEW_BUNDLES(input.projection.views,input.annotations.view_ink,input.schedules.ink)
    # Every required ViewId occurs once in the recipe; no view is omitted to make a sheet fit.
    recipe:=RULE(input.rules.entries,"NR-22",e.profile,"Sheet","Pagination")
    FOR role IN SHEET_ROLE_ORDER(e):
        candidates:=bundles WHERE assigned sheet_role==role
        S:=e.panel_scale IF role=="CoverConstruction" ELSE e.body_scale
        frame_asset:=EXACT_ASSET(input.assets,PARAM(recipe,"frame_asset."+role,"Text","none")) // 05B-F41
        page:int:=1;frame:=NEW_FRAME(role,page,S,frame_asset,recipe,e) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        cursor_x:=frame.content.min_x_mm;cursor_y:=frame.content.max_y_mm;row_height:=0 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
        FOR b IN SORT(candidates,key=recipe ordinal then stable ViewId):
            width:=b.ink.max_x_mm-b.ink.min_x_mm;height:=b.ink.max_y_mm-b.ink.min_y_mm //05B-F41/F42
            available_w:=frame.content.max_x_mm-frame.content.min_x_mm;available_h:=frame.content.max_y_mm-frame.content.min_y_mm
            IF width>available_w OR height>available_h THEN
                IF input.request.scale_mode=="Auto" THEN
                    # Stages do not mutate carried payload to retry. Raise a typed retry request to root orchestrator.
                    scales:=APPROVED_FINITE_SCALE_LIST(recipe,e.profile,role)
                    next:=FIRST candidate >S not yet attempted
                    IF next exists THEN RAISE("LAYOUT_REBUILD_AT_SCALE",b.view_id,["request.body_scale","request.panel_scale"],next,[width,height],recipe.source_ids,["NR-22"])
                    ELSE RAISE("LAYOUT_SINGLE_VIEW_NO_FIT",b.view_id,["ink","content"],[available_w,available_h],[width,height],recipe.source_ids,["NR-22"]) ENDIF
                ELSE RAISE("LAYOUT_SINGLE_VIEW_NO_FIT",b.view_id,["ink","content"],[available_w,available_h],[width,height],recipe.source_ids,["NR-22"]) ENDIF
            ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            gap_x:=PARAM(recipe,"view_gap_x_paper_mm","Number","paper_mm")*S // 05B-F41
            gap_y:=PARAM(recipe,"view_gap_y_paper_mm","Number","paper_mm")*S // 05B-F41
            IF cursor_x+width>frame.content.max_x_mm THEN cursor_x:=frame.content.min_x_mm;cursor_y:=cursor_y-row_height-gap_y;row_height:=0 ELSE NO_OP ENDIF // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            IF cursor_y-height<frame.content.min_y_mm THEN
                IF frame.placements empty THEN RAISE("LAYOUT_EMPTY_PAGE_LOOP",b.view_id,["placements"],"nonempty page before pagination",frame.id) ELSE APPEND out.frames frame ENDIF
                page:=page+1;frame:=NEW_FRAME(role,page,S,frame_asset,recipe,e) // 05B-F41
                cursor_x:=frame.content.min_x_mm;cursor_y:=frame.content.max_y_mm;row_height:=0 // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            translation:=POINT2(cursor_x-b.ink.min_x_mm,cursor_y-b.ink.max_y_mm)
            transformed:=b.ink+translation // 05B-F41
            IF !CONTAINS_BOUNDS(frame.content,transformed,input.rules.paper_tolerance_mm*S) THEN RAISE("LAYOUT_INK_OUTSIDE",b.view_id,["ink_after"],frame.content,transformed,recipe.source_ids) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            APPEND frame.placements PlacementV2(b.view_id,frame.id,translation,0,S,transformed) // 05B-F25: mathematical identity/topology, not an engineering default
            cursor_x:=cursor_x+width+gap_x;row_height:=max(row_height,height) // 05B-F41
        ENDFOR
        IF frame.placements nonempty THEN APPEND out.frames frame ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    assigned:=all out.frames.placements.view_id
    IF sorted assigned!=sorted bundles.required_ids THEN RAISE("LAYOUT_REQUIRED_VIEW_COVERAGE",e.id,["placements.view_id"],bundles.required_ids,assigned) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    IF HASH_PHYSICAL_GEOMETRY(input.geometry)!=input.geometry.physical_hash OR HASH_PHYSICAL_REBAR(input.rebar)!=out.rebar_hash_before THEN RAISE("LAYOUT_CHANGED_PHYSICAL_MODEL",e.id,["geometry","rebar"],"unchanged physical payload","changed") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    out.sheet_hash:=HASH_STATE(out)
    RETURN S9StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw, effective=input.effective, geometry=input.geometry, rebar=input.rebar, groups=input.groups, projection=input.projection, annotations=input.annotations, schedules=input.schedules,sheet=out)
```

Gate: every required view placed once;all ink contained;scale change rebuilds pure stages. Failure không được truyền như Ready sang stage tiếp theo.

### S10 — DWG write/readback

Signature: `Execute(S9StateV2) → S10StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: AutoCAD.CadGenerationWriter/NativeReadbackVerifier.

```text
S10(input:S9StateV2) -> S10StateV2:
    intents:=FLATTEN_NATIVE_INTENTS(input) # H16 exact map of every DTO variant, no rendering-time physical calculations
    expected_hash:=HASH_NORMALIZED_INTENTS(intents)
    request:=input.request;M:=input.context.manhole_id
    IF request.target_dwg_path is original source DWG OR outside approved output directory THEN RAISE("OUTPUT_PATH_SOURCE_CONFLICT",M,["target_dwg_path"],"output copy",request.target_dwg_path) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    current_target:=UNIQUE(current_job.targets,manhole_id=M AND row_index=context.row_index)
    committed:=false;saved:=false;reopened:=false
    before:=READ_UNTOUCHED_GENERATION_MANIFESTS(target_document,excluded_id=M)
    PREFLIGHT_NATIVE_ASSETS_AND_OWNERSHIP(intents,input.assets,request)
    TRY
        USING document lock AND one write transaction:
            IF request.generation_mode=="Replace" THEN
                owned:=repository.ReadGeneration(current_target.expected_generation_id)
                IF owned absent OR owned.InputHash!=current_target.expected_input_hash THEN RAISE("GENERATION_STALE",M,["ExpectedGenerationId","ExpectedInputHash"],"matching owned generation",owned) ELSE repository.EraseGeneration(owned.id) ENDIF
            ELSE IF request.generation_mode=="Create" THEN
                IF repository generation ID exists THEN RAISE("GENERATION_ALREADY_EXISTS",M,["generation_id"],"new unique ID",M) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
            ELSE RAISE("GENERATION_MODE_INVALID",M,["generation_mode"],"Create/Replace",request.generation_mode) ENDIF ENDIF
            handle_map:=[]
            FOR intent IN intents in stable semantic ID order:
                entity:=WRITE_EXACT_INTENT(intent,current transaction) # H16; nested ATTRIBs copied from ATTDEF then all values set
                repository.TagOwned(entity,M,intent.semantic_id,input.context.run_id,input.context.build_hash)
                APPEND handle_map {semantic_id:intent.semantic_id,handle:entity.Handle}
            ENDFOR
            CHECK_NATIVE_INTENT_COUNT_AND_TAG_VALUES(handle_map,intents,transaction)
            repository.StoreGenerationManifest(M,input.geometry.physical_hash,input.rebar.physical_hash,input.sheet.sheet_hash)
            transaction.Commit();committed:=true
        ENDUSING # no DBObject stored outside transaction; handle strings are retained
        SAVE_OUTPUT_COPY(request.target_dwg_path);saved:=true
        row_snapshot:=context.artifact_directory+"/native/"+ENCODE(M,context.run_id)+".dwg" // 05B-F46
        COPY_ACTUAL_SAVED_BYTES(request.target_dwg_path,row_snapshot)
        REOPEN_SAVED_DATABASE_READONLY(row_snapshot);reopened:=true
        actual:=READBACK_EXACT_INTENTS(handle_map,read-only transaction) # reopen every handle and nested attribute; no read from original in-memory DTO
        checks:=COMPARE_NATIVE_FIELDS(intents,actual,input.rules)
        IF any check Failed/Blocked THEN PERSIST checks;RAISE("NATIVE_READBACK_MISMATCH",M,["checks"],"all measured fields match",checks) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        after:=READ_UNTOUCHED_GENERATION_MANIFESTS(reopened database,excluded_id=M)
        IF before!=after THEN RAISE("UPDATE_MODIFIED_OTHER_MANHOLE",M,["unchanged_generation_manifests"],before,after) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        native:=NativeV2(saved_dwg_path=row_snapshot,saved_dwg_sha256=SHA256(actual saved bytes),
             handles=[HandleV2(x.semantic_id,x.handle,x.actual_block_name,x.actual_attribute_tags,x.actual_attribute_values,x.owner_manhole_id) FOR x IN actual],
             normalized_geometry_hash=HASH_NORMALIZED_NATIVE(actual geometry),normalized_rebar_hash=HASH_NORMALIZED_NATIVE(actual projected steel),
             repository_version=actual reopened schema version,write_status="Committed",readback_status="Passed",
             unchanged_manhole_ids=before.ids,unchanged_before_hashes=before.hashes,unchanged_after_hashes=after.hashes,
             domain_geometry_hash=input.rebar.fabrication_geometry_hash,expected_projection_hash=expected_hash,commit_state="Reopened")
        RETURN S10StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw, effective=input.effective, geometry=input.geometry, rebar=input.rebar, groups=input.groups, projection=input.projection, annotations=input.annotations, schedules=input.schedules, sheet=input.sheet,native=native)
    CATCH Exception fault:
        state:="Reopened" IF reopened ELSE "Saved" IF saved ELSE "Committed" IF committed ELSE "NotCommitted"
        PERSIST recovery receipt {commit_state:state,exception_type:fault.type,message:fault.message,output_path:request.target_dwg_path,
                                 actual_handles:handle_map or [],rollback_confirmed:!committed}
        IF committed THEN RAISE("NATIVE_FAILURE_AFTER_COMMIT",M,["commit_state","target_dwg_path"],"save/readback completed",state+":"+fault.message)
        ELSE RAISE("NATIVE_WRITE_ROLLED_BACK",M,["commit_state"],"transaction committed",fault.message) ENDIF
    ENDTRY
```

Gate: owned transaction commit state accurate;save/reopen actual native checks;UpdateB preservesA. Failure không được truyền như Ready sang stage tiếp theo.

### S11 — Plot/acceptance/batch

Signature: `Execute(S10StateV2) → S11StateV2 | FailureV2`. Owner: Application.AcceptanceEvidenceAssembler/BatchGenerationOrchestrator.

```text
S11(input:S10StateV2) -> S11StateV2:
    M:=input.context.manhole_id;checks:=[];pages:=[]
    IF input.native.readback_status!="Passed" THEN RAISE("ACCEPTANCE_NATIVE_NOT_READY",M,["native.readback_status"],"Passed",input.native.readback_status) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    reference:=EXACT_REFERENCE_BUNDLE(input.request.reference_bundle_ids,input.effective.profile,input.context.sources)
    # Fixture reference identity selects presentation evidence only; actual numerical expected values come from this row's Excel/effective fields.
    FOR subject IN REQUIRED_ACCEPTANCE_SUBJECTS(input):
        expected:=SOURCE_EXPECTED_VALUE(subject,input.effective,input.geometry,input.rebar,input.groups,input.rules)
        actual,handles,evidence:=READ_ACTUAL_SAVED_NATIVE_SUBJECT(subject,input.native)
        tolerance:=EXACT_UNIT_TOLERANCE(subject.unit,input.rules)
        IF actual absent OR evidence empty THEN verdict:="NotRun";reason:="missing actual saved native evidence"
        ELSE IF numerical expected THEN verdict:="Passed" IF abs(actual-expected)<=tolerance ELSE "Failed";reason:=null IF verdict==Passed ELSE "outside approved unit tolerance"
        ELSE verdict:="Passed" IF exact actual_text==expected_text ELSE "Failed";reason:=null IF verdict==Passed ELSE "semantic mismatch" ENDIF ENDIF
        APPEND checks AcceptanceCheckV2(subject.name,subject.id,expected.number,actual.number,expected.text,actual.text,subject.unit,
             "NR-18" IF subject numerical ELSE null,subject.source_ids,handles,evidence,verdict,reason)
    ENDFOR
    IF input.context.plot_session_id IS null THEN RAISE("PLOT_SESSION_MISSING",M,["context.plot_session_id"],"one shared healthy plot host","null") ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    FOR frame IN input.sheet.frames:
        result:=PLOT_REGISTERED_FRAME(input.native.saved_dwg_path,frame,input.request.plot_profile_id,input.context.plot_session_id)
        IF result.host_session_id!=input.context.plot_session_id OR result.frame_id!=frame.id THEN RAISE("PLOT_FRAME_SESSION_IDENTITY",frame.id,["frame_id","host_session_id"],[frame.id,input.context.plot_session_id],result) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
        pdf_mapping:=MEASURE_PDF_MAPPING(result.pdf,frame.window,frame.scale_denominator) //05B-F48; vector geometry/calibration subjects, not fit-to-page assumption
        reviewed:=LOAD_ACTUAL_VISUAL_REVIEW(result.pdf_sha256,reference,frame.id)
        status:="NotRun" IF reviewed absent ELSE "Failed" IF any required region Failed ELSE "Passed" IF required regions all reviewed Passed ELSE "NotRun"
        APPEND pages PlotPageV2(frame.id,result.pdf_path,SHA256(actual PDF bytes),result.page_index,result.host_session_id,
            result.actual_pstylemode,input.request.plot_profile_id,frame.scale_denominator,pdf_mapping.actual_scale,
            result.transcript_path,status,reviewed.reviewer IF exists ELSE null,reviewed.region_ids IF exists ELSE [])
        APPEND_ALL checks PDF_AND_VISUAL_CHECK_RECORDS(frame,result,pdf_mapping,reviewed,reference,input.rules)
    ENDFOR
    IF any check Failed THEN row_status:="Failed" ELSE IF any check Blocked THEN row_status:="Blocked" ELSE IF any check NotRun OR any page.visual_status!=Passed THEN row_status:="Partial" ELSE row_status:="Complete" ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF
    row:=RowVerdictV2(input.context.job_id,input.context.row_index,M,row_status,input.sheet.frames.ids,checks,input.context.diagnostics)
    rows:=input.context.prior_row_results+[row];all_pages:=input.context.prior_plot_pages+pages // 05B-F48
    IF duplicate rows (job_id,row_index,manhole_id) THEN RAISE("BATCH_RECEIPT_DUPLICATE",M,["rows"],"one receipt per selected row",rows) ELSE NO_OP ENDIF
    selected_ids:=all input.request.jobs.targets IDs
    batch_status:="Complete" IF SET(rows.manhole_id)==SET(selected_ids) AND every row.status==Complete ELSE "Partial"
    path:=input.context.artifact_directory+"/delivery-manifest.json" // 05B-F48
    out:=BatchV2(rows,all_pages,batch_status,path,input.request.target_dwg_path,SHA256(actual aggregate saved DWG bytes))
    WRITE_ACTUAL_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST(path,out,input.context.sources,input.context.receipts)
    RETURN S11StateV2(context=input.context, request=input.request, assets=input.assets, rules=input.rules, raw=input.raw, effective=input.effective, geometry=input.geometry, rebar=input.rebar, groups=input.groups, projection=input.projection, annotations=input.annotations, schedules=input.schedules, sheet=input.sheet, native=input.native,batch=out)
```

## 10. Ánh xạ VHGpro giữ từ bản đã bàn giao

Không thực hiện verify độc lập mapping trong lượt này, theo yêu cầu chủ nhiệm.


Nguồn là **HDSD VHGpro 3.2.pdf**, số trang in trên tài liệu. Đây là mapping hành vi, không tái sử dụng DLL/license của VHGpro.

| Bước VHGpro | Nguồn | Bước DBTool / owner class / gate |
|---|---|---|
| Chuẩn bị copy workbook theo 3 loại | p6 | S1 WorkbookImporter/profile; snapshot không sửa nguồn; G1 |
| Nhập sheet main dimensions/rebar/pipes/neck/elevation | p6–7 | S1 typed rows → S2 validation → S3/S4; 05A/EX rules; G1–G4 |
| CF.Ga pad/base/wall/roof/neck/cover | p8–12 | S2 specs/datums, S3 geometry, S4 mesh/accessories; G2–G4 |
| CF.Ga catch/cover/hook/ties/ladder/openings/material/hatch | p13–18 | S2 owner/frame → S3 owned voids → S4 physical → S5 groups → S7/S8; G2–G8 |
| CF.Cong,CF.Data extend catalog | p18–20 | S1 CatalogReader/S2 exact profiles/S0 dependencies; G0–G2 |
| Netload/chạy | p21–22 | HoGaCommands/HostCompatibilityChecker/Dispatcher; build/host hash; không suy AutoCAD2013 support cho DBTool net8 |
| Chọn loại → mở Excel → chọn 1/nhiều ga → điểm chèn | p22–23 B1–B3 | SharedGenerationRequest/BatchOrchestrator, anchor placement S9/S10; G1/G9–G11 |
| Save CF rồi vẽ lại; đổi main cần reload | p23 B4 | DBTool luôn snapshot/hash mới; source change detect, updater theo ManholeId; G1/G10 |
| Vẽ/không vẽ thép | p24 | Explicit scope request; geometry-only output không quảng bá FullRebarFinal; G4/G9 completeness |
| Xuất Excel chiết tính tùy chọn | p24 | Existing export use cases/writers giữ ngoài ưu tiên; TK trên DWG vẫn bắt buộc tại S8 |
| Tỷ lệ manual/auto | p24–25 | PresentationRequest/S9 approved scales; M15 panel riêng; G9/G11 |
| Nhóm 2/3 cột, spacing/view/sheet/ga, Khung | p25 | SheetRecipe/InkLayout/FrameRegistry; sourceoptions typed mm, không lookup ga cố định; G9 |
| Font Unicode/TCVN3/VNI, width factor | p26 | Versioned FontPolicy/S0/S10 ink readback; NR16; G0/G10/G11 |
| KL HG/THKL | p27–28 | Giữ quantity scope/writers; không override geometry từ quantity; EX123–174 |
| Customize blocks/styles/layers/dims giữ tên/tag | p29–31 | S0 exact signatures + versioned migration; G0/G10 |
| Chọn template phù hợp hatch/plot styles | p32–33 | Host/template/PlotProfile tường minh; PSTYLEMODE; G0/G11 |
| In hàng loạt ATPPlotter | p5 | FrameRegistry+batch plot tool một host, actual PDF/transcript; G11 |

## 12. Gate triển khai và nghiệm thu

Compilation/schema/coverage chỉ xác nhận hợp đồng phần mềm. Product Passed cần actual saved/reopened DWG, vector PDF, expected/actual cùng đơn vị/tolerance, source hashes, native handles và visual review regions. Chưa chạy giữ NotRun. Feature ON thiếu binding giữ Blocked, không thành OFF/N/A. S10 commit rồi save/readback lỗi giữ trạng thái Committed/Saved và recovery receipt, không nhận đã rollback.
